A4_A9Comments: IN GEORGIA, ALL TRANSACTIONS THAT OCCUR AT THE DEPARTMENT OF DRIVER SERVICES (DDS) ARE UTILIZED FOR VOTER REGISTRATION PURPOSES UNLESS THE VOTER AFFIRMATIVELY OPTS OUT OR IS NOT ELIGIBLE (I.E. A3 - THE TOTAL OF A3A IS THE SUM OF A3B, A3D, AND A3E. MARYLAND DOES NOT CONSIDER THE REGISTRATION CHANGES LISTED IN A3F AND A3G AS REGISTRATIONS, AND THEREFORE THE SOURCE OF THESE CHANGES IS NOT RECORDED. FOR A3C, INDIVIDUALS CAN REGISTER TO VOTE STARTING AT AGE 16, HOWEVER THEY ARE NOT CONSIDERED "PRE-PREGISTERED." 16 AND 17 YEAR OLDS ARE CONSIDERED REGISTERED VOTERS, THEY JUST CAN NOT VOTE UNTIL THEIR 18TH BIRTHDAY

REGISTRATIONS COMPLETED BY "REGISTRATION DRIVES FROM ADVOCACY GROUPS OR POLITICAL PARTIES" AS LISTED IN A5J ARE INCLUDED WITH THE REGISTRATION SOURCE OF "VOLUNTEER" AS LISTED IN A5L.

A1Comments: VOTERS REPORTED IN A1 ARE ELIGIBLE TO VOTE. THOSE DEFINED AS “INACTIVE” NEED ONLY TO CONFIRM THEIR ADDRESS BEFORE RECEIVING A BALLOT. PARTICIPATION IN PAST ELECTIONS IS NOT A FACTOR IN DEFINING ELIGIBILITY.
A2Comments: THE VALUES REPORTED IN A2 REFLECT THE NUMBER OF REGISTRATIONS RECEIVED WITHIN THE 14 DAYS PRIOR TO ELECTION DAY AND ON ELECTION DAY.
A3Comments: THE VAST MAJORITY OF DUPLICATE TRANSACTIONS ARE MOTOR VEHICLE TRANSACTIONS WHERE THE VOTER IS ALREADY REGISTERED AT THE CURRENT ADDRESS, BUT THE TRANSACTION IS USED TO UPDATE THE DIGITAL SIGNATURE IMAGE ON FILE WITH A NEWER VERSION OF THE SIGNATURE IF ONE IS PROVIDED DURING THE TRANSACTION. REGARDING PREGREGISTRATIONS IN A3C, MICHIGAN USED TO COUNTE PRE-REGISTRATIONS AS THOSE WHO REGISTERED AT AGE 17.5 OR OLDER WHEN THEY WOULD BE 18 FOR THE UPCOMING ELECTION (THE ONLY TYPE OF PRE-REGISTRATION PREVIOUSLY ALLOWED). UNDER A NEW LAW ENACTED FOR THE 2024 ELECTION CYCLE, 16 AND 17 YEAR OLDS CAN PRE REGISTER EVEN IF THEY WILL NOT YET BE 18 IN AN UPCOMING ELECTION, AND BECOME REGISTERED WHEN ELIGIBLE. FOR THIS YEAR'S SURVEY, MICHIGAN IS REPORTING THE NEW TYPE OF PRE-REGISTRATION FIGURE, WHICH LEADS TO THE LOWER FIGURE. REGISTRATIONS FOR VOTERS BETWEEN 17.5 AND 18 YEARS OF ARE NOW CONSIDERED REGISTERED, BUT INELIGIBLE TO VOTE UNTIL THEIR 18TH BIRTHDAY.
A4_A9Comments: REGISTRATIONS REPORTED IN A4C AND A5C REFLECT INDIVIDUALS WHO REGISTERED ONLINE USING THE MICHIGAN VOTER INFORMATION CENTER WEBSITE. REGARDING REGISTRATIONS THROUGH AUTOMATIC VOTER REGISTRATIONS IN A4D, MICHIGAN DATA DOES NOT SEPARATE REGISTRATIONS RECEIVED FROM THE SECRETARY OF STATE TRANSACTION (DMV) BASED ON WHETHER IT IS AN AVR TRANSACTION OR ANOTHER REGISTRATION RECEIVED AT THE SECRETARY OF STATE; THE VAST MAJORITY OF REGISTRATIONS THROUGH THE SECRETARY OF STATE ARE AVR TRANSACTIONS. IN 2022, THE VOTER REGISTRATION FIGURE INCLUDED CHANGES OF ADDRESSES; THESE ARE NO LONGER INCLUDED IN 2024, WHICH IS WHY THE FIGURE IS LOWER.
A10Comments: IN 2021, THE MICHIGAN BUREAU OF ELECTIONS PROCESSED UNDELIVERABLE MAIL FROM THE FIRST STATEWIDE ELECTIONS MAILING IN 10 YEARS, TRIGGERING A SIGNIFICANTLY LARGER AMOUNT OF CANCELLATION NOTICES MAILED THAN IN THE PAST. THE NUMBERS IN THIS SURVEY REFLECT NORMAL OPERATIONS.
A12i_Other: CLERK DETERMINED THAT VOTER DID NOT MEET EITHER AGE, CITIZENSHIP, OR RESIDENCY REQUIREMENT.
B11_B16Comments: MICHIGAN DOES NOT CAPTURE THE MODE BY WHICH A VOTER RETURNS THEIR BALLOT.

C4_C5Comments: THE SAME MAIL BALLOT DROP BOXES USED DURING EARLY VOTING ARE USED ON ELECTION DAY IN MICHIGAN.
D8Comments: MISINFORMATION AND SAFETY CONCERNS POSED A CHALLENGE FOR RECRUITMENT. WE KNOW THAT THE DIVISIVE ENVIRONMENT AND THREATS TO THE DEMOCRATIC PROCESS WERE A KEY CONSIDERATION IN SOME WORKERS CHOOSING TO NOT SERVE AS A POLL WORKER. TO HELP, THE MICHIGAN SECRETARY OF STATE'S OFFICE CONTINUED THE STATEWIDE RECRUITMENT PROGRAM FROM 2020, DEMOCRACY MVP, TO HELP CONNECT INDIVIDUALS WITH LOCAL ELECTION OFFICIALS WHO WERE IN NEED OF WORKERS. CLERKS AND ELECTION WORKERS WERE ALSO PROVIDED WITH INFORMATION AND RECOMMENDATIONS ON SAFETY AND DE-ESCALATION TECHNIQUES.

A1Comments: VOTERS REPORTED IN A1 ARE ELIGIBLE TO VOTE. THOSE DEFINED AS “INACTIVE” NEED ONLY TO CONFIRM THEIR ADDRESS BEFORE RECEIVING A BALLOT. PARTICIPATION IN PAST ELECTIONS IS NOT A FACTOR IN DEFINING ELIGIBILITY.
A2Comments: THE VALUES REPORTED IN A2 REFLECT THE NUMBER OF REGISTRATIONS RECIEVED WITHIN THE 14 DAYS PRIOR TO ELECTION DAY AND ON ELECTION DAY.
A3Comments: THE VAST MAJORITY OF DUPLICATE TRANSACTIONS ARE MOTOR VEHICLE TRANSACTIONS WHERE THE VOTER IS ALREADY REGISTERED AT THE CURRENT ADDRESS, BUT THE TRANSACTION IS USED TO UPDATE THE DIGITAL SIGNATURE IMAGE ON FILE WITH A NEWER VERSION OF THE SIGNATURE IF ONE IS PROVIDED DURING THE TRANSACTION. REGARDING PREGREGISTRATIONS IN A3C, MICHIGAN USED TO COUNTE PRE-REGISTRATIONS AS THOSE WHO REGISTERED AT AGE 17.5 OR OLDER WHEN THEY WOULD BE 18 FOR THE UPCOMING ELECTION (THE ONLY TYPE OF PRE-REGISTRATION PREVIOUSLY ALLOWED). UNDER A NEW LAW ENACTED FOR THE 2024 ELECTION CYCLE, 16 AND 17 YEAR OLDS CAN PRE REGISTER EVEN IF THEY WILL NOT YET BE 18 IN AN UPCOMING ELECTION, AND BECOME REGISTERED WHEN ELIGIBLE. FOR THIS YEAR'S SURVEY, MICHIGAN IS REPORTING THE NEW TYPE OF PRE-REGISTRATION FIGURE, WHICH LEADS TO THE LOWER FIGURE. REGISTRATIONS FOR VOTERS BETWEEN 17.5 AND 18 YEARS OF ARE NOW CONSIDERED REGISTERED, BUT INELIGIBLE TO VOTE UNTIL THEIR 18TH BIRTHDAY.
A4_A9Comments: REGISTRATIONS REPORTED IN A4C AND A5C REFLECT INDIVIDUALS WHO REGISTERED ONLINE USING THE MICHIGAN VOTER INFORMATION CENTER WEBSITE. REGARDING REGISTRATIONS THROUGH AUTOMATIC VOTER REGISTRATIONS IN A4D, MICHIGAN DATA DOES NOT SEPARATE REGISTRATIONS RECEIVED FROM THE SECRETARY OF STATE TRANSACTION (DMV) BASED ON WHETHER IT IS AN AVR TRANSACTION OR ANOTHER REGISTRATION RECEIVED AT THE SECRETARY OF STATE; THE VAST MAJORITY OF REGISTRATIONS THROUGH THE SECRETARY OF STATE ARE AVR TRANSACTIONS. IN 2022, THE VOTER REGISTRATION FIGURE INCLUDED CHANGES OF ADDRESSES; THESE ARE NO LONGER INCLUDED IN 2024, WHICH IS WHY THE FIGURE IS LOWER.
A10Comments: IN 2021, THE MICHIGAN BUREAU OF ELECTIONS PROCESSED UNDELIVERABLE MAIL FROM THE FIRST STATEWIDE ELECTIONS MAILING IN 10 YEARS, TRIGGERING A SIGNIFICANTLY LARGER AMOUNT OF CANCELLATION NOTICES MAILED THAN IN THE PAST. THE NUMBERS IN THIS SURVEY REFLECT NORMAL OPERATIONS.
A12i_Other: CLERK DETERMINED THAT VOTER DID NOT MEET EITHER AGE, CITIZENSHIP, OR RESIDENCY REQUIREMENT.
B11_B16Comments: MICHIGAN DOES NOT CAPTURE THE MODE BY WHICH A VOTER RETURNS THEIR BALLOT.

C4_C5Comments: THE SAME MAIL BALLOT DROP BOXES USED DURING EARLY VOTING ARE USED ON ELECTION DAY IN MICHIGAN.
D8Comments: MISINFORMATION AND SAFETY CONCERNS POSED A CHALLENGE FOR RECRUITMENT. WE KNOW THAT THE DIVISIVE ENVIRONMENT AND THREATS TO THE DEMOCRATIC PROCESS WERE A KEY CONSIDERATION IN SOME WORKERS CHOOSING TO NOT SERVE AS A POLL WORKER. TO HELP, THE MICHIGAN SECRETARY OF STATE'S OFFICE CONTINUED THE STATEWIDE RECRUITMENT PROGRAM FROM 2020, DEMOCRACY MVP, TO HELP CONNECT INDIVIDUALS WITH LOCAL ELECTION OFFICIALS WHO WERE IN NEED OF WORKERS. CLERKS AND ELECTION WORKERS WERE ALSO PROVIDED WITH INFORMATION AND RECOMMENDATIONS ON SAFETY AND DE-ESCALATION TECHNIQUES.

CLERKS AND ELECTION WORKERS WERE ALSO PROVIDED WITH INFORMATION AND RECOMMENDATIONS ON SAFETY AND DE-ESCALATION TECHNIQUES.

A1Comments: VOTERS REPORTED IN A1 ARE ELIGIBLE TO VOTE. THOSE DEFINED AS “INACTIVE” NEED ONLY TO CONFIRM THEIR ADDRESS BEFORE RECEIVING A BALLOT. PARTICIPATION IN PAST ELECTIONS IS NOT A FACTOR IN DEFINING ELIGIBILITY.
A2Comments: THE VALUES REPORTED IN A2 REFLECT THE NUMBER OF REGISTRATIONS RECIEVED WITHIN THE 14 DAYS PRIOR TO ELECTION DAY AND ON ELECTION DAY.
A3Comments: THE VAST MAJORITY OF DUPLICATE TRANSACTIONS ARE MOTOR VEHICLE TRANSACTIONS WHERE THE VOTER IS ALREADY REGISTERED AT THE CURRENT ADDRESS, BUT THE TRANSACTION IS USED TO UPDATE THE DIGITAL SIGNATURE IMAGE ON FILE WITH A NEWER VERSION OF THE SIGNATURE IF ONE IS PROVIDED DURING THE TRANSACTION. REGARDING PREGREGISTRATIONS IN A3C, MICHIGAN USED TO COUNTE PRE-REGISTRATIONS AS THOSE WHO REGISTERED AT AGE 17.5 OR OLDER WHEN THEY WOULD BE 18 FOR THE UPCOMING ELECTION (THE ONLY TYPE OF PRE-REGISTRATION PREVIOUSLY ALLOWED). UNDER A NEW LAW ENACTED FOR THE 2024 ELECTION CYCLE, 16 AND 17 YEAR OLDS CAN PRE REGISTER EVEN IF THEY WILL NOT YET BE 18 IN AN UPCOMING ELECTION, AND BECOME REGISTERED WHEN ELIGIBLE. FOR THIS YEAR'S SURVEY, MICHIGAN IS REPORTING THE NEW TYPE OF PRE-REGISTRATION FIGURE, WHICH LEADS TO THE LOWER FIGURE. REGISTRATIONS FOR VOTERS BETWEEN 17.5 AND 18 YEARS OF ARE NOW CONSIDERED REGISTERED, BUT INELIGIBLE TO VOTE UNTIL THEIR 18TH BIRTHDAY.
A4_A9Comments: REGISTRATIONS REPORTED IN A4C AND A5C REFLECT INDIVIDUALS WHO REGISTERED ONLINE USING THE MICHIGAN VOTER INFORMATION CENTER WEBSITE. REGARDING REGISTRATIONS THROUGH AUTOMATIC VOTER REGISTRATIONS IN A4D, MICHIGAN DATA DOES NOT SEPARATE REGISTRATIONS RECEIVED FROM THE SECRETARY OF STATE TRANSACTION (DMV) BASED ON WHETHER IT IS AN AVR TRANSACTION OR ANOTHER REGISTRATION RECEIVED AT THE SECRETARY OF STATE; THE VAST MAJORITY OF REGISTRATIONS THROUGH THE SECRETARY OF STATE ARE AVR TRANSACTIONS. IN 2022, THE VOTER REGISTRATION FIGURE INCLUDED CHANGES OF ADDRESSES; THESE ARE NO LONGER INCLUDED IN 2024, WHICH IS WHY THE FIGURE IS LOWER.
A10Comments: IN 2021, THE MICHIGAN BUREAU OF ELECTIONS PROCESSED UNDELIVERABLE MAIL FROM THE FIRST STATEWIDE ELECTIONS MAILING IN 10 YEARS, TRIGGERING A SIGNIFICANTLY LARGER AMOUNT OF CANCELLATION NOTICES MAILED THAN IN THE PAST. THE NUMBERS IN THIS SURVEY REFLECT NORMAL OPERATIONS.
A12i_Other: CLERK DETERMINED THAT VOTER DID NOT MEET EITHER AGE, CITIZENSHIP, OR RESIDENCY REQUIREMENT.
B11_B16Comments: MICHIGAN DOES NOT CAPTURE THE MODE BY WHICH A VOTER RETURNS THEIR BALLOT.

A1Comments: VOTERS REPORTED IN A1 ARE ELIGIBLE TO VOTE. THOSE DEFINED AS “INACTIVE” NEED ONLY TO CONFIRM THEIR ADDRESS BEFORE RECEIVING A BALLOT. PARTICIPATION IN PAST ELECTIONS IS NOT A FACTOR IN DEFINING ELIGIBILITY.
A2Comments: THE VALUES REPORTED IN A2 REFLECT THE NUMBER OF REGISTRATIONS RECIEVED WITHIN THE 14 DAYS PRIOR TO ELECTION DAY AND ON ELECTION DAY.
A3Comments: THE VAST MAJORITY OF DUPLICATE TRANSACTIONS ARE MOTOR VEHICLE TRANSACTIONS WHERE THE VOTER IS ALREADY REGISTERED AT THE CURRENT ADDRESS, BUT THE TRANSACTION IS USED TO UPDATE THE DIGITAL SIGNATURE IMAGE ON FILE WITH A NEWER VERSION OF THE SIGNATURE IF ONE IS PROVIDED DURING THE TRANSACTION. REGARDING PREGREGISTRATIONS IN A3C, MICHIGAN USED TO COUNTE PRE-REGISTRATIONS AS THOSE WHO REGISTERED AT AGE 17.5 OR OLDER WHEN THEY WOULD BE 18 FOR THE UPCOMING ELECTION (THE ONLY TYPE OF PRE-REGISTRATION PREVIOUSLY ALLOWED). UNDER A NEW LAW ENACTED FOR THE 2024 ELECTION CYCLE, 16 AND 17 YEAR OLDS CAN PRE REGISTER EVEN IF THEY WILL NOT YET BE 18 IN AN UPCOMING ELECTION, AND BECOME REGISTERED WHEN ELIGIBLE. FOR THIS YEAR'S SURVEY, MICHIGAN IS REPORTING THE NEW TYPE OF PRE-REGISTRATION FIGURE, WHICH LEADS TO THE LOWER FIGURE. REGISTRATIONS FOR VOTERS BETWEEN 17.5 AND 18 YEARS OF ARE NOW CONSIDERED REGISTERED, BUT INELIGIBLE TO VOTE UNTIL THEIR 18TH BIRTHDAY.
A4_A9Comments: REGISTRATIONS REPORTED IN A4C AND A5C REFLECT INDIVIDUALS WHO REGISTERED ONLINE USING THE MICHIGAN VOTER INFORMATION CENTER WEBSITE. REGARDING REGISTRATIONS THROUGH AUTOMATIC VOTER REGISTRATIONS IN A4D, MICHIGAN DATA DOES NOT SEPARATE REGISTRATIONS RECEIVED FROM THE SECRETARY OF STATE TRANSACTION (DMV) BASED ON WHETHER IT IS AN AVR TRANSACTION OR ANOTHER REGISTRATION RECEIVED AT THE SECRETARY OF STATE; THE VAST MAJORITY OF REGISTRATIONS THROUGH THE SECRETARY OF STATE ARE AVR TRANSACTIONS. IN 2022, THE VOTER REGISTRATION FIGURE INCLUDED CHANGES OF ADDRESSES; THESE ARE NO LONGER INCLUDED IN 2024, WHICH IS WHY THE FIGURE IS LOWER.
A10Comments: IN 2021, THE MICHIGAN BUREAU OF ELECTIONS PROCESSED UNDELIVERABLE MAIL FROM THE FIRST STATEWIDE ELECTIONS MAILING IN 10 YEARS, TRIGGERING A SIGNIFICANTLY LARGER AMOUNT OF CANCELLATION NOTICES MAILED THAN IN THE PAST. THE NUMBERS IN THIS SURVEY REFLECT NORMAL OPERATIONS.
A12i_Other: CLERK DETERMINED THAT VOTER DID NOT MEET EITHER AGE, CITIZENSHIP, OR RESIDENCY REQUIREMENT.
B11_B16Comments: MICHIGAN DOES NOT CAPTURE THE MODE BY WHICH A VOTER RETURNS THEIR BALLOT.
B28_Other: OTHER REASONS FOR REJECTION UNDER MI ELECTION LAW
C4_C5Comments: THE SAME MAIL BALLOT DROP BOXES USED DURING EARLY VOTING ARE USED ON ELECTION DAY IN MICHIGAN.
D8Comments: MISINFORMATION AND SAFETY CONCERNS POSED A CHALLENGE FOR RECRUITMENT. WE KNOW THAT THE DIVISIVE ENVIRONMENT AND THREATS TO THE DEMOCRATIC PROCESS WERE A KEY CONSIDERATION IN SOME WORKERS CHOOSING TO NOT SERVE AS A POLL WORKER. TO HELP, THE MICHIGAN SECRETARY OF STATE'S OFFICE CONTINUED THE STATEWIDE RECRUITMENT PROGRAM FROM 2020, DEMOCRACY MVP, TO HELP CONNECT INDIVIDUALS WITH LOCAL ELECTION OFFICIALS WHO WERE IN NEED OF WORKERS. CLERKS AND ELECTION WORKERS WERE ALSO PROVIDED WITH INFORMATION AND RECOMMENDATIONS ON SAFETY AND DE-ESCALATION TECHNIQUES.

A1Comments: VOTERS REPORTED IN A1 ARE ELIGIBLE TO VOTE. THOSE DEFINED AS “INACTIVE” NEED ONLY TO CONFIRM THEIR ADDRESS BEFORE RECEIVING A BALLOT. PARTICIPATION IN PAST ELECTIONS IS NOT A FACTOR IN DEFINING ELIGIBILITY.
A2Comments: THE VALUES REPORTED IN A2 REFLECT THE NUMBER OF REGISTRATIONS RECIEVED WITHIN THE 14 DAYS PRIOR TO ELECTION DAY AND ON ELECTION DAY.
A3Comments: THE VAST MAJORITY OF DUPLICATE TRANSACTIONS ARE MOTOR VEHICLE TRANSACTIONS WHERE THE VOTER IS ALREADY REGISTERED AT THE CURRENT ADDRESS, BUT THE TRANSACTION IS USED TO UPDATE THE DIGITAL SIGNATURE IMAGE ON FILE WITH A NEWER VERSION OF THE SIGNATURE IF ONE IS PROVIDED DURING THE TRANSACTION. REGARDING PREGREGISTRATIONS IN A3C, MICHIGAN USED TO COUNTE PRE-REGISTRATIONS AS THOSE WHO REGISTERED AT AGE 17.5 OR OLDER WHEN THEY WOULD BE 18 FOR THE UPCOMING ELECTION (THE ONLY TYPE OF PRE-REGISTRATION PREVIOUSLY ALLOWED). UNDER A NEW LAW ENACTED FOR THE 2024 ELECTION CYCLE, 16 AND 17 YEAR OLDS CAN PRE REGISTER EVEN IF THEY WILL NOT YET BE 18 IN AN UPCOMING ELECTION, AND BECOME REGISTERED WHEN ELIGIBLE. FOR THIS YEAR'S SURVEY, MICHIGAN IS REPORTING THE NEW TYPE OF PRE-REGISTRATION FIGURE, WHICH LEADS TO THE LOWER FIGURE. REGISTRATIONS FOR VOTERS BETWEEN 17.5 AND 18 YEARS OF ARE NOW CONSIDERED REGISTERED, BUT INELIGIBLE TO VOTE UNTIL THEIR 18TH BIRTHDAY.
A4_A9Comments: REGISTRATIONS REPORTED IN A4C AND A5C REFLECT INDIVIDUALS WHO REGISTERED ONLINE USING THE MICHIGAN VOTER INFORMATION CENTER WEBSITE. REGARDING REGISTRATIONS THROUGH AUTOMATIC VOTER REGISTRATIONS IN A4D, MICHIGAN DATA DOES NOT SEPARATE REGISTRATIONS RECEIVED FROM THE SECRETARY OF STATE TRANSACTION (DMV) BASED ON WHETHER IT IS AN AVR TRANSACTION OR ANOTHER REGISTRATION RECEIVED AT THE SECRETARY OF STATE; THE VAST MAJORITY OF REGISTRATIONS THROUGH THE SECRETARY OF STATE ARE AVR TRANSACTIONS. IN 2022, THE VOTER REGISTRATION FIGURE INCLUDED CHANGES OF ADDRESSES; THESE ARE NO LONGER INCLUDED IN 2024, WHICH IS WHY THE FIGURE IS LOWER.
A10Comments: IN 2021, THE MICHIGAN BUREAU OF ELECTIONS PROCESSED UNDELIVERABLE MAIL FROM THE FIRST STATEWIDE ELECTIONS MAILING IN 10 YEARS, TRIGGERING A SIGNIFICANTLY LARGER AMOUNT OF CANCELLATION NOTICES MAILED THAN IN THE PAST. THE NUMBERS IN THIS SURVEY REFLECT NORMAL OPERATIONS.
A12i_Other: CLERK DETERMINED THAT VOTER DID NOT MEET EITHER AGE, CITIZENSHIP, OR RESIDENCY REQUIREMENT.
B11_B16Comments: MICHIGAN DOES NOT CAPTURE THE MODE BY WHICH A VOTER RETURNS THEIR BALLOT.

D8Comments: MISINFORMATION AND SAFETY CONCERNS POSED A CHALLENGE FOR RECRUITMENT. WE KNOW THAT THE DIVISIVE ENVIRONMENT AND THREATS TO THE DEMOCRATIC PROCESS WERE A KEY CONSIDERATION IN SOME WORKERS CHOOSING TO NOT SERVE AS A POLL WORKER. TO HELP, THE MICHIGAN SECRETARY OF STATE'S OFFICE CONTINUED THE STATEWIDE RECRUITMENT PROGRAM FROM 2020, DEMOCRACY MVP, TO HELP CONNECT INDIVIDUALS WITH LOCAL ELECTION OFFICIALS WHO WERE IN NEED OF WORKERS. CLERKS AND ELECTION WORKERS WERE ALSO PROVIDED WITH INFORMATION AND RECOMMENDATIONS ON SAFETY AND DE-ESCALATION TECHNIQUES.

F13: POLLING PLACE, ALTERNATIVE ELECTION OFFICE, AND CENTRAL COUNT ELECTION OBSERVERS WERE A HINDERANCE TO THE ELECTION PROCESS AT MOST LOCATIONS.  THEY GENERALLY DIDN'T FOLLOW THE GUIDELINES OUTLINED IN OUR HANDOUTS, BUT OUR WORKERS WERE TOO INUDATED WITH WORK TO DO MUCH ABOUT IT.  I HAD NUMEROUS COMPLAINTS FROM ELECTION JUDGES THROUGHOUT THE DAY.  MANY GROUPS WERE SENDING THREE OBSERVERS TO EACH PRECINCT.  WE DON'T HAVE ROOM FOR ALL OF THESE PEOPLE, ALONG WITH VOTERS AND JUDGES.  I THINK THE ATMOSPHERE AT THE POLLING LOCATIONS BECAME TENSE AND UNCOMFORTABLE DUE TO THE OBERVERS AND THIS ISN'T THE ATMOSPHERE I WANT FOR VOTERS OR MY WORKERS.  I'M AFFRAID THAT I WILL BE LOOSING A LARGE NUMBER OF MY VETERAN ELECTION JUDGES DUE TO THIS ELECTION.  WE ALREADY STRUGGLE WITH STAFFING POLLING PLACES.  WE ALSO HAD AN ISSUE WITH OUR DS450 READING ABOUT 200 BALLOTS THAT WERE ORDERED AFTER THE ORIGINAL BATCH OF BALLOTS DUE TO AN UNATICIPATED INFLUX OF VOTER REGISTRATION CARDS FROM GROUPS ON THE RESERVATION.  THAT ADDED ABOUT 6 HOURS TO OUR NIGHT OF COUNTING THAT WAS UNPLANNED AND NOT BUDGET FOR.  I BELIEVE THIS WAS THE HIGHEST TURNOUT BLAINE COUNTY HAS EVER SEEN WITH 82.7% OF ABSENTEE BALLOTS RETURNED AND AN OVERALL TURNOUT OF 71% BEFORE PROVISIONALS ARE COUNTED.  ALL OF OUR PRECINCTS WERE NEARLY 60% PARTICIPATION AND OUR ALTERNATIVE SITE USAGE WAS UP AS WELL.

ONE OF THE RURAL POLLING PLACE HEAT TOOK ABOUT 2 HOURS TO HEAT UP,  AND FINALLY NOT ENOUGH BALLOTS WERE HELD BACK AT THE ELECTION OFFICE TO REGISTER NEW VOTERS, WE WERE SHORT BY 5 OR SO FOR 2 PRECINCTS WHICH WAS EASILY FIXED BY GOING TO THE POLLS AND GETTING MORE.  IN THE ELECTIONS OFFICE WE HAD TO REISSUE ABSENTEE BALLOTS FOR VOTERS THAT DID NOT BRING IN THE BALLOTS RECEIVED IN THE MAIL, BECAUSE THEY WANTED TO VOTE IN PERSON.  WE HAD MORE THAN 10  PEOPLE DO THIS.

A10Comments: AT THIS TIME, THE STATE OF OKLAHOMA TRACKS HOW MANY CONFIRMATION NOTICES ARE SENT, HOW MANY ARE RETURNED FROM VOTERS INSIDE THE COUNTY, HOW MANY ARE RETURNED FROM VOTERS OUTSIDE THE COUNTY, AND HOW MANY ARE RETURNED UNDELIVERABLE OR NOT RETURNED. A11Comments: VOTERS MAY RECEIVE A CONFIRMATION NOTICE FOR MORE THAN ONE REASON, SO THE TOTAL NUMBER OF REASONS CONFIRMATION NOTICES WERE SENT IS HIGHER THAN THE NUMBER OF CONFIRMATION NOTICES SENT. AT THIS TIME, THERE IS NOT A WAY TO ASSIGN A PRIMARY REASON FOR SENDING A CONFIRMATION NOTICE TO A VOTER. IF A VOTER IS DETERMINED TO RECEIVE A CONFIRMATION NOTICE FOR MORE THAN ONE REASON, THE STATE DOES NOT DETERMINE ONE REASON TO BE MORE IMPORTANT THAN ANY OTHER. IN 2023, OKLAHOMA LAW CHANGED TO ALLOW THE SURRENDING OF AN OKLAHOMA DRIVER'S LICENSE IN ANOTHER STATE AS A REASON TO CANCEL A VOTER REGISTRATION. THE CONFIRMATION NOTICES WERE SENT FOR THE PERIOD BEFORE THE LAW WAS PASSED. THE POLICY SURVEY INDICATED THIS CHANGE UNDER OTHER REASONS LISTED IN 26 O.S. SECTION 4+120.2: "THE SURRENDERING OF THE VOTER'S OKLAHOMA DRIVER LICENSE TO SERVICE OKLAHOMA UPON BEING ISSUED A DRIVER LICENSE IN ANOTHER STATE."

A10Comments: AT THIS TIME, THE STATE OF OKLAHOMA TRACKS HOW MANY CONFIRMATION NOTICES ARE SENT, HOW MANY ARE RETURNED FROM VOTERS INSIDE THE COUNTY, HOW MANY ARE RETURNED FROM VOTERS OUTSIDE THE COUNTY, AND HOW MANY ARE RETURNED UNDELIVERABLE OR NOT RETURNED. THERE IS NOT CURRENTLY A WAY TO TRACK HOW MANY ARE RETURNED WITH OR WITHOUT CHANGES TO THE VOTER'S ADDRESS.
A11Comments: VOTERS MAY RECEIVE A CONFIRMATION NOTICE FOR MORE THAN ONE REASON, SO THE TOTAL NUMBER OF REASONS CONFIRMATION NOTICES WERE SENT IS HIGHER THAN THE NUMBER OF CONFIRMATION NOTICES SENT. AT THIS TIME, THERE IS NOT A WAY TO ASSIGN A PRIMARY REASON FOR SENDING A CONFIRMATION NOTICE TO A VOTER. IF A VOTER IS DETERMINED TO RECEIVE A CONFIRMATION NOTICE FOR MORE THAN ONE REASON, THE STATE DOES NOT DETERMINE ONE REASON TO BE MORE IMPORTANT THAN ANY OTHER. IN 2023, OKLAHOMA LAW CHANGED TO ALLOW THE SURRENDING OF AN OKLAHOMA DRIVER'S LICENSE IN ANOTHER STATE AS A REASON TO CANCEL A VOTER REGISTRATION. THE CONFIRMATION NOTICES WERE SENT FOR THE PERIOD BEFORE THE LAW WAS PASSED. THE POLICY SURVEY INDICATED THIS CHANGE UNDER OTHER REASONS LISTED IN 26 O.S. SECTION 4+120.2: "THE SURRENDERING OF THE VOTER'S OKLAHOMA DRIVER LICENSE TO SERVICE OKLAHOMA UPON BEING ISSUED A DRIVER LICENSE IN ANOTHER STATE."

A4_A9Comments: THE FIGURES PROVIDED IN AD. (REGISTRATION TRANSACTIONS RECEIVED THROUGH AN AUTOMATIC REGISTRATION PROGRAM) REPRESENT INITIAL VOTER REGISTRATION APPLICATIONS MADE THROUGH THE PENNSYLVANIA DEPARTMENT OF TRANSPORTATION'S MOTOR-VOTER PROGRAM. WHILE THE MOTOR-VOTER PROGRAM WAS CHANGED FROM AN “OPT-IN” TO AN “OPT-OUT” BASED SYSTEM IN 2023, THE DEPARTMENT OF STATE HAS INCLUDED ALL INITIAL APPLICATIONS RECEIVED FROM THE MOTOR-VOTER PROGRAM DURING THE APPLICABLE TWO-YEAR PERIOD.
A10Comments: THE FIGURE REPORTED IN A10A INCLUDES, BUT IS NOT LIMITED TO, INITIAL NOTICES SENT TO VOTERS WHO APPEAR TO HAVE MOVED BASED UPON INFORMATION RECEIVED PURSUANT TO THE NATIONAL CHANGE OF ADDRESS PROGRAM AND NOTICES SENT TO VOTERS WHOSE VOTER REGISTRATION CARD IS RETURNED AS UNDELIVERABLE.
A11l_Other: THE NUMBER OF CONFIRMATION NOTICES SENT TO VOTERS WHO APPEAR TO HAVE MOVED BASED UPON INFORMATION RECEIVED PURSUANT TO THE NATIONAL CHANGE OF ADDRESS PROGRAM.
A11m_Other: THE NUMBER OF CONFIRMATION NOTICES SENT FOR ANY REASON OTHER THAN THOSE REASONS IDENTIFIED IN A11I, A11K, A11L, AND ALLN.
A11n_Other: THE NUMBER OF CONFIRMATION NOTICES SENT DUE TO CORRESPONDENCE SENT BY AN ELECTION OFFICE BEING RETURNED AS UNDELIVERABLE OR DUE TO FAILURE OF THE VOTER TO RESPOND TO AN INITIAL CONFIRMATION NOTICE SENT FOR THE REASON IDENTIFIED IN A11L (INITIAL NCOA NOTICE).
A11Comments:
AS REPORTED IN THE COMMENTS TO A10, PENNSYLVANIA COUNTIES SEND CONFIRMATION NOTICES FOR A VARIETY OF REASONS. DUE TO LIMITATIONS IN THE VOTER REGISTRATION SYSTEM, THE PENNSYLVANIA DEPARTMENT OF STATE IS UNABLE TO PROVIDE FIGURES FOR A11A, A11B, A11E, OR A11G.

PENNSYLVANIA COUNTIES DO NOT SEND CONFIRMATION NOTICES SOLELY FOR FAILURE ON THE PART OF THE VOTER TO VOTE IN THE TWO MOST RECENT FEDERAL ELECTIONS. INSTEAD, PENNSYLVANIA COUNTIES SEND CONFIRMATION NOTICES TO VOTERS WHO HAVE NOT VOTED, APPEARED TO VOTE, OR CONTACTED A COUNTY ELECTIONS OFFICE, IN THE PERIOD BEGINNING FIVE YEARS BEFORE THE DATE OF THE NOTICE AND ENDING ON THE DATE OF THE NOTICE. THE NUMBER OF SAID CONFIRMATION NOTICES SENT APPEARS IN A11I.

WHILE PENNSYLVANIA LAW CONTEMPLATES A MASS CONFIRMATION MAILING AS DESCRIBED IN A11J, PENNSYLVANIA COUNTIES DO NOT TYPICALLY UTILIZE THAT PROGRAM.

PENNSYLVANIA PARTICIPATES IN THE ELECTRONIC REGISTRATION INFORMATION CENTER’S (ERIC) DUPLICATE PROGRAM. THE NUMBER OF NOTICES SENT PURSUANT TO THAT PROGRAM APPEARS IN A11K.

A11Comments:
AS REPORTED IN THE COMMENTS TO A10, PENNSYLVANIA COUNTIES SEND CONFIRMATION NOTICES FOR A VARIETY OF REASONS. DUE TO LIMITATIONS IN THE VOTER REGISTRATION SYSTEM, THE PENNSYLVANIA DEPARTMENT OF STATE IS UNABLE TO PROVIDE FIGURES FOR A11A, A11B, A11E, OR A11G.

PENNSYLVANIA COUNTIES DO NOT SEND CONFIRMATION NOTICES SOLELY FOR FAILURE ON THE PART OF THE VOTER TO VOTE IN THE TWO MOST RECENT FEDERAL ELECTIONS. INSTEAD, PENNSYLVANIA COUNTIES SEND CONFIRMATION NOTICES TO VOTERS WHO HAVE NOT VOTED, APPEARED TO VOTE, OR CONTACTED A COUNTY ELECTIONS OFFICE, IN THE PERIOD BEGINNING FIVE YEARS BEFORE THE DATE OF THE NOTICE AND ENDING ON THE DATE OF THE NOTICE. THE NUMBER OF SAID CONFIRMATION NOTICES SENT APPEARS IN A11I.

WHILE PENNSYLVANIA LAW CONTEMPLATES A MASS CONFIRMATION MAILING AS DESCRIBED IN A11J, PENNSYLVANIA COUNTIES DO NOT TYPICALLY UTILIZE THAT PROGRAM.

PENNSYLVANIA PARTICIPATES IN THE ELECTRONIC REGISTRATION INFORMATION CENTER’S (ERIC) DUPLICATE PROGRAM. THE NUMBER OF NOTICES SENT PURSUANT TO THAT PROGRAM APPEARS IN A11K.

INSTEAD, PENNSYLVANIA COUNTIES SEND CONFIRMATION NOTICES TO VOTERS WHO HAVE NOT VOTED, APPEARED TO VOTE, OR CONTACTED A COUNTY ELECTIONS OFFICE, IN THE PERIOD BEGINNING FIVE YEARS BEFORE THE DATE OF THE NOTICE AND ENDING ON THE DATE OF THE NOTICE. THE NUMBER OF SAID CONFIRMATION NOTICES SENT APPEARS IN A11I.

A11l_Other: THE NUMBER OF CONFIRMATION NOTICES SENT TO VOTERS WHO APPEAR TO HAVE MOVED BASED UPON INFORMATION RECEIVED PURSUANT TO THE NATIONAL CHANGE OF ADDRESS PROGRAM.
A11m_Other: THE NUMBER OF CONFIRMATION NOTICES SENT FOR ANY REASON OTHER THAN THOSE REASONS IDENTIFIED IN A11I, A11K, A11L, AND ALLN.
A11n_Other: THE NUMBER OF CONFIRMATION NOTICES SENT DUE TO CORRESPONDENCE SENT BY AN ELECTION OFFICE BEING RETURNED AS UNDELIVERABLE OR DUE TO FAILURE OF THE VOTER TO RESPOND TO AN INITIAL CONFIRMATION NOTICE SENT FOR THE REASON IDENTIFIED IN A11L (INITIAL NCOA NOTICE).
A11Comments:
AS REPORTED IN THE COMMENTS TO A10, PENNSYLVANIA COUNTIES SEND CONFIRMATION NOTICES FOR A VARIETY OF REASONS. DUE TO LIMITATIONS IN THE VOTER REGISTRATION SYSTEM, THE PENNSYLVANIA DEPARTMENT OF STATE IS UNABLE TO PROVIDE FIGURES FOR A11A, A11B, A11E, OR A11G.

PENNSYLVANIA COUNTIES DO NOT SEND CONFIRMATION NOTICES SOLELY FOR FAILURE ON THE PART OF THE VOTER TO VOTE IN THE TWO MOST RECENT FEDERAL ELECTIONS. INSTEAD, PENNSYLVANIA COUNTIES SEND CONFIRMATION NOTICES TO VOTERS WHO HAVE NOT VOTED, APPEARED TO VOTE, OR CONTACTED A COUNTY ELECTIONS OFFICE, IN THE PERIOD BEGINNING FIVE YEARS BEFORE THE DATE OF THE NOTICE AND ENDING ON THE DATE OF THE NOTICE. THE NUMBER OF SAID CONFIRMATION NOTICES SENT APPEARS IN A11I.

WHILE PENNSYLVANIA LAW CONTEMPLATES A MASS CONFIRMATION MAILING AS DESCRIBED IN A11J, PENNSYLVANIA COUNTIES DO NOT TYPICALLY UTILIZE THAT PROGRAM.

PENNSYLVANIA PARTICIPATES IN THE ELECTRONIC REGISTRATION INFORMATION CENTER’S (ERIC) DUPLICATE PROGRAM. THE NUMBER OF NOTICES SENT PURSUANT TO THAT PROGRAM APPEARS IN A11K.

PENNSYLVANIA COUNTIES DO NOT SEND CONFIRMATION NOTICES SOLELY FOR FAILURE ON THE PART OF THE VOTER TO VOTE IN THE TWO MOST RECENT FEDERAL ELECTIONS. INSTEAD, PENNSYLVANIA COUNTIES SEND CONFIRMATION NOTICES TO VOTERS WHO HAVE NOT VOTED, APPEARED TO VOTE, OR CONTACTED A COUNTY ELECTIONS OFFICE, IN THE PERIOD BEGINNING FIVE YEARS BEFORE THE DATE OF THE NOTICE AND ENDING ON THE DATE OF THE NOTICE. THE NUMBER OF SAID CONFIRMATION NOTICES SENT APPEARS IN A11I.

WHILE PENNSYLVANIA LAW CONTEMPLATES A MASS CONFIRMATION MAILING AS DESCRIBED IN A11J, PENNSYLVANIA COUNTIES DO NOT TYPICALLY UTILIZE THAT PROGRAM.

A1Comments: IN PUERTO RICO, VOTERS CLASSIFIED AS INACTIVE MUST FIRST REACTIVATE THEIR VOTER STATUS BEFORE BEING ALLOWED TO CAST A BALLOT. THIS PROCESS REQUIRES THE VOTER TO VERIFY THEIR ADDRESS AND UPDATE THEIR REGISTRATION INFORMATION WITH THE PUERTO RICO STATE ELECTIONS COMMISSION (CEE). DEPENDING ON THE CIRCUMSTANCES, REACTIVATION MAY INVOLVE COMPLETING A SPECIFIC FORM OR PROVIDING A DOCUMENT THAT CONFIRMS THEIR RESIDENCE. ONCE THEIR STATUS IS UPDATED, THE VOTER IS ALLOWED TO VOTE IN THEIR ASSIGNED PRECINCT WITHOUT RESTRICTIONS. THIS PROCESS DIFFERS FROM THE CLASSIFICATION UNDER THE NATIONAL VOTER REGISTRATION ACT (NVRA) IN THE UNITED STATES, WHICH REFERS TO VOTERS WHO ARE STILL ELIGIBLE BUT REQUIRE ADDRESS VERIFICATION BEFORE VOTING. UNDER NVRA PROVISIONS, THESE VOTERS MAY BE ALLOWED TO VOTE BY SIGNING A RESIDENCY AFFIRMATION ON ELECTION DAY WITHOUT NEEDING TO GO THROUGH A PRIOR REACTIVATION PROCESS. FOR THE 2024 ELECTIONS IN PUERTO RICO, THE VOTER REGISTRATION DEADLINE WAS SEPTEMBER 21, 2024. ANY VOTER WHO DID NOT UPDATE THEIR REGISTRATION BEFORE THIS DATE WOULD REMAIN CLASSIFIED UNDER THEIR PREVIOUS STATUS UNTIL THE NEXT REGISTRATION PERIOD.

E3Comments: ON NOVEMBER 5TH, A MAN THAT WAS A REGISTERED TO VOTE IN CORPUS CHRISI WAS TOLD BY OUR VOTER REGISTRAR’S OFFICE THAT HE COULD VOTE HERE IN LOVING COUNTY PROVISIONALLY.  I ASK HIM ALL THE QUESTIONS.  ARE YOU REGISTERED HERE?  “NO.”  DO YOU LIVE HERE?  “NO”.  HAVE YOU MOVED HERE RECENTLY?  “NO.”  WHY ARE YOU HERE IN LOVING COUNTY?  “I AM HERE WORKING.”  WHERE ARE YOU REGISTERED?   “I AM A REGISTERED VOTER IN CORPUS CHRISTI, BUT THE LADY AT THE VOTER REGISTRAR’S OFFICE SAID I COULD VOTE A PROVISIONAL BALLOT”  HE HAD NOT MOVED HERE, HE HAS NEVER LIVED HERE, HE WAS WORKING HERE TEMPORARILY. I CALLED LEGAL WITH HIM IN MY OFFICE.  I HAVE CALLED LEGAL IN THE PAST PRESIDENTIAL ELECTIONS WHEN I HAD A TRANSIT WORKER BEING TOLD THEY COULD VOTE HERE.  CHUCK, AT LEGAL, TOLD ME NOT TO TURN ANYONE AWAY WHO WANTED TO VOTE PROVISIONALLY, I ASK CHUCK TO ASK ANOTHER LAWYER, BECAUSE THIS IS NOT WHAT I HAVE BEEN TOLD DURING PAST PRESIDENTIAL ELECTIONS.  HE CHECKED AND TOLD ME THEY ALL AGREED.  THIS LED TO LOVING COUNTY BEING USED AS A STATEWIDE POLLING LOCATION DURING THE NOVEMBER 5TH, 2024 GENERAL ELECTION.  WE WERE FORTUNATE THAT MORE DID NOT COME IN TO VOTE PROVISIONALLY.  WE ARE IN THE PERMIAN BASIN WITH HEAVY (THOUSANDS) OILFIELD TRAFFIC IN AND THROUGH LOVING COUNTY HOURLY/DAILY.  LOVING COUNTY COULD NOT HAVE HANDLED ALL OF THE TRANSIT VOTERS HAD THEY ALL BEEN TOLD THEY COULD VOTE IN LOVING COUNTY PROVISIONALLY.

C1Comments: 1. WI DOES NOT ALLOW VOTERS WITH A RETURNED ABSENTEE BALLOT TO SPOIL IT AND INSTEAD VOTE A BALLOT ON ELECTION DAY. F1Comments: WI DOES NOT HAVE ANY PRECINCTS/JURISDICTIONS THAT ARE 100% VOTE BY MAIL.  SOME DATA IN OTHER SECTIONS WILL NOT MATCH WITH THEIR EQUIVALENT IN SECTION F FOR THE FOLLOWING REASONS.  IN CASES WHERE TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER, THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER. OR, BECAUSE IN WI PROVISISIONAL BALLOT DATA HAS TO BE RECORDED INTO THE DATABASE ON ELECTION NIGHT. VOTERS WHO REGISTER ON ELECTION DAY ARE USUALLY NOT ENTERED UNTIL AFTER ELECTION DAY. THESE TWO RECORDS CANNOT BE LINKED IN OUR DATABASE, SINCE VOTER RECORDS MAY BE CREATED AFTER ELECTION DAY, AND ARE THEREFORE NOT ALWAYS CONNECTED TO THEIR PROVISIONAL BALLOT RECORD.
F3_F8Comments: WI DOES NOT ALLOW USE OF DRE'S THAT DO NOT INCLUDE A VVPAT. WE DO NOT TRACK THE NUMBER OF MACHINES DEPLOYED.  IF ANY YES/NO QUESTIONS IN THIS SECTION ARE BLANK, THIS MEANS THE DATA WAS NOT AVAILABLE OR WE DO NOT USE.

POLL BOOKS (ELECTRONIC AND PAPER) WILL INDICATE THE STATUS OF AN ABSENTEE BALLOT FOR A VOTER AS OF THE TIME THE POLL BOOK FILE WAS GENERATED. CHANGES AFTER THE FILE IS GENERATED WOULD NOT BE REFLECTED IN THE POLL BOOK.

A10Comments: WI IS NVRA EXEMPT. WI SENDS ERIC MAILING NOTICES AND NOTICES TO VOTERS WHO DO NOT VOTE IN A 4-YEAR PERIOD. WI ALSO SENDS MAILINGS TO VOTERS WHO REGISTER OR UPDATE THEIR REGISTRATION ONLINE, BY MAIL, OR ON ELECTION DAY, BUT ONLY ELECTION DAY NOTICES ARE TRACKED, AND ONLY IF THEY COME BACK UNDELIVERABLE. C1Comments: 1. WI DOES NOT ALLOW VOTERS WITH A RETURNED ABSENTEE BALLOT TO SPOIL IT AND INSTEAD VOTE A BALLOT ON ELECTION DAY. A VOTER SENT AN ABSENTEE BALLOT THEY NEVER RETURNED CAN CHOOSE TO INSTEAD VOTE ON ELECTION DAY WITHOUT SURRENDERING THEIR UNVOTED BALLOT; THE UNVOTED BALLOT IS CONSIDERED NOT RETURNED.  2. VOTER INELIGIBLE ARE BALLOTS NOT RETURNED AND CANCELLED BECAUSE THE VOTER WAS NOT ELIGIBLE TO VOTE THE BALLOT  3. VOTER REFUSED ARE BALLOTS FOR VOTERS ON THE PERMANENT ABSENTEE LIST WHO REFUSED A BALLOT FOR THIS ELECTION AND DID NOT REQUEST A REPLACEMENT  4. NOT RETURNED, SENT TO VOTER FOR RESOLUTION ARE BALLOTS FOR VOTERS WHO RETURNED THEIR ABSENTEE BALLOT BUT BALLOT CERTIFICATE WAS INCOMPLETE SO BALLOT AND CERTIFICATE WERE SENT BACK TO VOTER TO RESOLVE THE ISSUE AND THEY NEVER RESUBMITTED IT
C2Comments: VOTERS WHO ARE INDEFINITELY CONFINED DUE TO AGE, ILLNESS, INFIRMITY OR DISABILITY CAN REQUEST ABSENTEE BALLOTS BY MAIL FOR ALL FUTURE ELECTIONS
C3Comments: IN WISCONSIN, DROP BOX AVAILABILITY IS DETERMINED BY THE INDIVIDUAL JURISDICTIONS ON WHETHER THEY WILL PROVIDE THEM AS AN OPTION AND WHEN OR WHERE THEY CAN BE USED. COMPLETE DATA IS NOT COLLECTED ON DROP BOXES BY THE STATE AND THEREFORE UNAVAILABLE FOR REPORTING.
C7Comments: WI DOES NOT GATHER DATA ON IF OR HOW ABSENTEE BALLOTS MAY HAVE BEEN RECEIVED BACK BY THE CLERK WITH MISSING DATA OR IF THIS MISSING DATA WAS CURED.
C8Comments: DATA IN C8A WILL NOT MATCH EXACTLY WITH DATA IN F1D DUE TO HOW VOTER RECORD MERGES HAPPEN IN OUR DATABASE. WHEN TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER AND IN SECTION C WE LOOK ONLY AT ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORDS WHILE IN SECTION F WE LOOK FOR ELECTION PARTICIPATION AND AN ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD. THOSE VOTERS NOT PICKED UP IN SECTION F1D ARE HOWEVER PICKED UP IN SECTION F1H
C9t_Other: REJECTIONS REASONS NOT LISTED ABOVE:  1. NO POI ENCLOSED AND NO CERTIFICATION FROM CARE FACILITY REPRESENTATIVE WHEN VOTER RESIDES IN AN SVD-ELIGIBLE FACILITY NOT VISITED BY SVDS  2. ELECTION OFFICIAL ERROR  3. SUPERSEDING BALLOT RECEIVED  4. SUPERSEDING BALLOT RETURNED  5. REJECTION EXPLANATION NULL (NOT PROVIDED IN DATA)
C9Comments: C9N INCLUDES VOTERS WHOSE BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THEY ALREADY VOTED VIA ANOTHER MEANS, BUT NOT NECESSARILY IN PERSON. A BALLOT NOT RECEIVED ON TIME OR THAT MISSES THE DEADLINE IS NOT COUNTED NOR FORMALLY REJECTED IN WI. WE DID INCLUDE THEM IN C9A AND C9B HOWEVER, TO ACCOUNT FOR THOSE BALLOTS STATUS.  WI USES A REJECTION REASON OF SUPERSEDING BALLOT ACCEPTED IN SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES WHERE A VOTER HAD TO BE SENT A SECOND ABSENTEE BALLOT BECAUSE THE ORIGINAL BALLOT CONTAINED A PRINTING ERROR AND THE FIRST BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THE VOTER RETURNED THE SECOND BALLOT WHICH WAS COUNTED. DATA FOR NO VOTER SIGNATURE, NO WITNESS SIGNATURE, AND NO RESIDENT ADDRESS ON ENVELOPE WOULD ALL FALL INTO OUR REASON OF CERTIFICATION INSUFFICIENT.

C1Comments: 1. WI DOES NOT ALLOW VOTERS WITH A RETURNED ABSENTEE BALLOT TO SPOIL IT AND INSTEAD VOTE A BALLOT ON ELECTION DAY. A VOTER SENT AN ABSENTEE BALLOT THEY NEVER RETURNED CAN CHOOSE TO INSTEAD VOTE ON ELECTION DAY WITHOUT SURRENDERING THEIR UNVOTED BALLOT; THE UNVOTED BALLOT IS CONSIDERED NOT RETURNED.  2. VOTER INELIGIBLE ARE BALLOTS NOT RETURNED AND CANCELLED BECAUSE THE VOTER WAS NOT ELIGIBLE TO VOTE THE BALLOT  3. VOTER REFUSED ARE BALLOTS FOR VOTERS ON THE PERMANENT ABSENTEE LIST WHO REFUSED A BALLOT FOR THIS ELECTION AND DID NOT REQUEST A REPLACEMENT  4. NOT RETURNED, SENT TO VOTER FOR RESOLUTION ARE BALLOTS FOR VOTERS WHO RETURNED THEIR ABSENTEE BALLOT BUT BALLOT CERTIFICATE WAS INCOMPLETE SO BALLOT AND CERTIFICATE WERE SENT BACK TO VOTER TO RESOLVE THE ISSUE AND THEY NEVER RESUBMITTED IT
C2Comments: VOTERS WHO ARE INDEFINITELY CONFINED DUE TO AGE, ILLNESS, INFIRMITY OR DISABILITY CAN REQUEST ABSENTEE BALLOTS BY MAIL FOR ALL FUTURE ELECTIONS
C3Comments: IN WISCONSIN, DROP BOX AVAILABILITY IS DETERMINED BY THE INDIVIDUAL JURISDICTIONS ON WHETHER THEY WILL PROVIDE THEM AS AN OPTION AND WHEN OR WHERE THEY CAN BE USED. COMPLETE DATA IS NOT COLLECTED ON DROP BOXES BY THE STATE AND THEREFORE UNAVAILABLE FOR REPORTING.

C8Comments: DATA IN C8A WILL NOT MATCH EXACTLY WITH DATA IN F1D DUE TO HOW VOTER RECORD MERGES HAPPEN IN OUR DATABASE. WHEN TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER AND IN SECTION C WE LOOK ONLY AT ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORDS WHILE IN SECTION F WE LOOK FOR ELECTION PARTICIPATION AND AN ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD. THOSE VOTERS NOT PICKED UP IN SECTION F1D ARE HOWEVER PICKED UP IN SECTION F1H

ELECTION OFFICIAL ERROR  3. SUPERSEDING BALLOT RECEIVED  4. SUPERSEDING BALLOT RETURNED  5. REJECTION EXPLANATION NULL (NOT PROVIDED IN DATA)
C9Comments: C9N INCLUDES VOTERS WHOSE BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THEY ALREADY VOTED VIA ANOTHER MEANS, BUT NOT NECESSARILY IN PERSON. A BALLOT NOT RECEIVED ON TIME OR THAT MISSES THE DEADLINE IS NOT COUNTED NOR FORMALLY REJECTED IN WI. WE DID INCLUDE THEM IN C9A AND C9B HOWEVER, TO ACCOUNT FOR THOSE BALLOTS STATUS.  IN THE PAST WE HAD DATA FOR C9O, HOWEVER NOW WI REQUIRES A VOTER TO PROVIDE PROOF OF RESIDENCE AT TIME OF REGISTERING AND WOULD NOT RECEIVE A BALLOT WITHOUT A VALID COMPLETED REGISTRATION. WI USES A REJECTION REASON OF SUPERSEDING BALLOT ACCEPTED IN SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES WHERE A VOTER HAD TO BE SENT A SECOND ABSENTEE BALLOT BECAUSE THE ORIGINAL BALLOT CONTAINED A PRINTING ERROR AND THE FIRST BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THE VOTER RETURNED THE SECOND BALLOT WHICH WAS COUNTED. DATA FOR NO VOTER SIGNATURE, NO WITNESS SIGNATURE, AND NO RESIDENT ADDRESS ON ENVELOPE WOULD ALL FALL INTO OUR REASON OF CERTIFICATION INSUFFICIENT.

OUR SYSTEM DOES NOT DISTINGUISH WHETHER AN IN-PERSON ABSENTEE VOTING LOCATION IS AN ELECTION OFFICE OR ANOTHER LOCATION.

E2Comments: WI HAS ELECTION DAY REGISTRATION AND THEREFORE DOES NOT ISSUE PROVISIONAL BALLOTS DUE TO THE VOTER NOT BEING ON THE REGISTRATION LIST OR BEING AT THE WRONG POLLING PLACE. PROVISIONAL BALLOTS ARE ISSUED FOR ONLY TWO REASONS: 1. VOTER IS UNABLE OR UNWILLING TO PROVIDE PROOF OF IDENTIFICATION, OR 2. VOTER IS REGISTERING ON ELECTION DAY AND IS UNABLE OR UNWILLING TO PROVIDE THEIR WI DRIVERS' LICENSE OR STATE ID CARD NUMBER.

E3Comments: IF THE VOTER DOES NOT PROVIDE THE APPROPRIATE DOCUMENTATION BY 4PM ON THE FRIDAY AFTER THE ELECTION, THEIR BALLOT IS REJECTED. IF THEY PROVIDE DOCUMENTATION BUT IT IS INSUFFICIENT, THEIR BALLOT IS REJECTED.
F1Comments: WI DOES NOT HAVE ANY PRECINCTS/JURISDICTIONS THAT ARE 100% VOTE BY MAIL.  SOME DATA IN OTHER SECTIONS WILL NOT MATCH WITH THEIR EQUIVALENT IN SECTION F FOR THE FOLLOWING REASONS.  IN CASES WHERE TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER, THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER. OR, BECAUSE IN WI PROVISISIONAL BALLOT DATA HAS TO BE RECORDED INTO THE DATABASE ON ELECTION NIGHT. VOTERS WHO REGISTER ON ELECTION DAY ARE USUALLY NOT ENTERED UNTIL AFTER ELECTION DAY. THESE TWO RECORDS CANNOT BE LINKED IN OUR DATABASE, SINCE VOTER RECORDS MAY BE CREATED AFTER ELECTION DAY, AND ARE THEREFORE NOT ALWAYS CONNECTED TO THEIR PROVISIONAL BALLOT RECORD.
F3_F8Comments: WI DOES NOT ALLOW USE OF DRE'S THAT DO NOT INCLUDE A VVPAT. WE DO NOT TRACK THE NUMBER OF MACHINES DEPLOYED.  IF ANY YES/NO QUESTIONS IN THIS SECTION ARE BLANK, THIS MEANS THE DATA WAS NOT AVAILABLE OR WE DO NOT USE.
F9_F10Comments: IN WI ELECTRONIC POLL BOOKS CAN ROUTE VOTERS TO CORRECT POLLING PLACES IF THERE IS AN ACTIVE VOTER RECORD IN THE SYSTEM AT THE ADDRESS WHERE THEY LIVE OR IF THEY DO NOT HAVE AN ACTIVE RECORD, BUT THE ADDRESS ALREADY EXISTS IN THE DATABASE. POLL BOOKS (ELECTRONIC AND PAPER) WILL INDICATE THE STATUS OF AN ABSENTEE BALLOT FOR A VOTER AS OF THE TIME THE POLL BOOK FILE WAS GENERATED. CHANGES AFTER THE FILE IS GENERATED WOULD NOT BE REFLECTED IN THE POLL BOOK.

WI ALSO SENDS MAILINGS TO VOTERS WHO REGISTER OR UPDATE THEIR REGISTRATION ONLINE, BY MAIL, OR ON ELECTION DAY, BUT ONLY ELECTION DAY NOTICES ARE TRACKED, AND ONLY IF THEY COME BACK UNDELIVERABLE. THE STATE SENDS THESE NOTICES ON BEHALF OF MUNICIPAL CLERKS. CLERKS MAY SEND ADDITIONAL CONFIRMATION NOTICES THAT ARE NOT TRACKED IN THE DATABASE.

DATA IN B30A AND F1C WILL NOT MATCH DUE TO HOW OUR SYSTEM HANDLES MERGING OF VOTER RECORDS IN OUR DATABASE. C1Comments: 1. WI DOES NOT ALLOW VOTERS WITH A RETURNED ABSENTEE BALLOT TO SPOIL IT AND INSTEAD VOTE A BALLOT ON ELECTION DAY. A VOTER SENT AN ABSENTEE BALLOT THEY NEVER RETURNED CAN CHOOSE TO INSTEAD VOTE ON ELECTION DAY WITHOUT SURRENDERING THEIR UNVOTED BALLOT; THE UNVOTED BALLOT IS CONSIDERED NOT RETURNED.  2. VOTER INELIGIBLE ARE BALLOTS NOT RETURNED AND CANCELLED BECAUSE THE VOTER WAS NOT ELIGIBLE TO VOTE THE BALLOT  3. VOTER REFUSED ARE BALLOTS FOR VOTERS ON THE PERMANENT ABSENTEE LIST WHO REFUSED A BALLOT FOR THIS ELECTION AND DID NOT REQUEST A REPLACEMENT  4. NOT RETURNED, SENT TO VOTER FOR RESOLUTION ARE BALLOTS FOR VOTERS WHO RETURNED THEIR ABSENTEE BALLOT BUT BALLOT CERTIFICATE WAS INCOMPLETE SO BALLOT AND CERTIFICATE WERE SENT BACK TO VOTER TO RESOLVE THE ISSUE AND THEY NEVER RESUBMITTED IT
C2Comments: VOTERS WHO ARE INDEFINITELY CONFINED DUE TO AGE, ILLNESS, INFIRMITY OR DISABILITY CAN REQUEST ABSENTEE BALLOTS BY MAIL FOR ALL FUTURE ELECTIONS
C3Comments: IN WISCONSIN, DROP BOX AVAILABILITY IS DETERMINED BY THE INDIVIDUAL JURISDICTIONS ON WHETHER THEY WILL PROVIDE THEM AS AN OPTION AND WHEN OR WHERE THEY CAN BE USED. COMPLETE DATA IS NOT COLLECTED ON DROP BOXES BY THE STATE AND THEREFORE UNAVAILABLE FOR REPORTING.
C7Comments: WI DOES NOT GATHER DATA ON IF OR HOW ABSENTEE BALLOTS MAY HAVE BEEN RECEIVED BACK BY THE CLERK WITH MISSING DATA OR IF THIS MISSING DATA WAS CURED.
C8Comments: DATA IN C8A WILL NOT MATCH EXACTLY WITH DATA IN F1D DUE TO HOW VOTER RECORD MERGES HAPPEN IN OUR DATABASE. WHEN TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER AND IN SECTION C WE LOOK ONLY AT ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORDS WHILE IN SECTION F WE LOOK FOR ELECTION PARTICIPATION AND AN ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD. THOSE VOTERS NOT PICKED UP IN SECTION F1D ARE HOWEVER PICKED UP IN SECTION F1H
C9t_Other: REJECTIONS REASONS NOT LISTED ABOVE:  1. NO POI ENCLOSED AND NO CERTIFICATION FROM CARE FACILITY REPRESENTATIVE WHEN VOTER RESIDES IN AN SVD-ELIGIBLE FACILITY NOT VISITED BY SVDS  2. ELECTION OFFICIAL ERROR  3. SUPERSEDING BALLOT RECEIVED  4. SUPERSEDING BALLOT RETURNED  5. REJECTION EXPLANATION NULL (NOT PROVIDED IN DATA)
C9Comments: C9N INCLUDES VOTERS WHOSE BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THEY ALREADY VOTED VIA ANOTHER MEANS, BUT NOT NECESSARILY IN PERSON. A BALLOT NOT RECEIVED ON TIME OR THAT MISSES THE DEADLINE IS NOT COUNTED NOR FORMALLY REJECTED IN WI. WE DID INCLUDE THEM IN C9A AND C9B HOWEVER, TO ACCOUNT FOR THOSE BALLOTS STATUS.  IN THE PAST WE HAD DATA FOR C9O, HOWEVER NOW WI REQUIRES A VOTER TO PROVIDE PROOF OF RESIDENCE AT TIME OF REGISTERING AND WOULD NOT RECEIVE A BALLOT WITHOUT A VALID COMPLETED REGISTRATION. WI USES A REJECTION REASON OF SUPERSEDING BALLOT ACCEPTED IN SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES WHERE A VOTER HAD TO BE SENT A SECOND ABSENTEE BALLOT BECAUSE THE ORIGINAL BALLOT CONTAINED A PRINTING ERROR AND THE FIRST BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THE VOTER RETURNED THE SECOND BALLOT WHICH WAS COUNTED. DATA FOR NO VOTER SIGNATURE, NO WITNESS SIGNATURE, AND NO RESIDENT ADDRESS ON ENVELOPE WOULD ALL FALL INTO OUR REASON OF CERTIFICATION INSUFFICIENT.
D3_D4Comments: ELECTION DAY POLLING PLACES CANNOT BE LOCATED IN ELECTION OFFICES. MUNICIPALITIES MAY SHARE INFORMATION ABOUT IN-PERSON ABSENTEE VOTING LOCATIONS WITH THE STATE, HOWEVER THEY ARE NOT REQUIRED TO DO SO. THEREFORE, DATA CANNOT BE PROVIDED FOR ALL MUNICIPALITIES. OUR SYSTEM DOES NOT DISTINGUISH WHETHER AN IN-PERSON ABSENTEE VOTING LOCATION IS AN ELECTION OFFICE OR ANOTHER LOCATION.

F1Comments: WI DOES NOT HAVE ANY PRECINCTS/JURISDICTIONS THAT ARE 100% VOTE BY MAIL.  SOME DATA IN OTHER SECTIONS WILL NOT MATCH WITH THEIR EQUIVALENT IN SECTION F FOR THE FOLLOWING REASONS.  IN CASES WHERE TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER, THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER. OR, BECAUSE IN WI PROVISISIONAL BALLOT DATA HAS TO BE RECORDED INTO THE DATABASE ON ELECTION NIGHT. C1Comments: 1. WI DOES NOT ALLOW VOTERS WITH A RETURNED ABSENTEE BALLOT TO SPOIL IT AND INSTEAD VOTE A BALLOT ON ELECTION DAY. A VOTER SENT AN ABSENTEE BALLOT THEY NEVER RETURNED CAN CHOOSE TO INSTEAD VOTE ON ELECTION DAY WITHOUT SURRENDERING THEIR UNVOTED BALLOT; THE UNVOTED BALLOT IS CONSIDERED NOT RETURNED.  2. VOTER INELIGIBLE ARE BALLOTS NOT RETURNED AND CANCELLED BECAUSE THE VOTER WAS NOT ELIGIBLE TO VOTE THE BALLOT  3. VOTER REFUSED ARE BALLOTS FOR VOTERS ON THE PERMANENT ABSENTEE LIST WHO REFUSED A BALLOT FOR THIS ELECTION AND DID NOT REQUEST A REPLACEMENT  4. NOT RETURNED, SENT TO VOTER FOR RESOLUTION ARE BALLOTS FOR VOTERS WHO RETURNED THEIR ABSENTEE BALLOT BUT BALLOT CERTIFICATE WAS INCOMPLETE SO BALLOT AND CERTIFICATE WERE SENT BACK TO VOTER TO RESOLVE THE ISSUE AND THEY NEVER RESUBMITTED IT
C2Comments: VOTERS WHO ARE INDEFINITELY CONFINED DUE TO AGE, ILLNESS, INFIRMITY OR DISABILITY CAN REQUEST ABSENTEE BALLOTS BY MAIL FOR ALL FUTURE ELECTIONS

C7Comments: WI DOES NOT GATHER DATA ON IF OR HOW ABSENTEE BALLOTS MAY HAVE BEEN RECEIVED BACK BY THE CLERK WITH MISSING DATA OR IF THIS MISSING DATA WAS CURED.
C8Comments: DATA IN C8A WILL NOT MATCH EXACTLY WITH DATA IN F1D DUE TO HOW VOTER RECORD MERGES HAPPEN IN OUR DATABASE. WHEN TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER AND IN SECTION C WE LOOK ONLY AT ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORDS WHILE IN SECTION F WE LOOK FOR ELECTION PARTICIPATION AND AN ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD. THOSE VOTERS NOT PICKED UP IN SECTION F1D ARE HOWEVER PICKED UP IN SECTION F1H

C9Comments: C9N INCLUDES VOTERS WHOSE BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THEY ALREADY VOTED VIA ANOTHER MEANS, BUT NOT NECESSARILY IN PERSON. A BALLOT NOT RECEIVED ON TIME OR THAT MISSES THE DEADLINE IS NOT COUNTED NOR FORMALLY REJECTED IN WI. WE DID INCLUDE THEM IN C9A AND C9B HOWEVER, TO ACCOUNT FOR THOSE BALLOTS STATUS.  WI USES A REJECTION REASON OF SUPERSEDING BALLOT ACCEPTED IN SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES WHERE A VOTER HAD TO BE SENT A SECOND ABSENTEE BALLOT BECAUSE THE ORIGINAL BALLOT CONTAINED A PRINTING ERROR AND THE FIRST BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THE VOTER RETURNED THE SECOND BALLOT WHICH WAS COUNTED. DATA FOR NO VOTER SIGNATURE, NO WITNESS SIGNATURE, AND NO RESIDENT ADDRESS ON ENVELOPE WOULD ALL FALL INTO OUR REASON OF CERTIFICATION INSUFFICIENT.

C9Comments: C9N INCLUDES VOTERS WHOSE BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THEY ALREADY VOTED VIA ANOTHER MEANS, BUT NOT NECESSARILY IN PERSON. A BALLOT NOT RECEIVED ON TIME OR THAT MISSES THE DEADLINE IS NOT COUNTED NOR FORMALLY REJECTED IN WI. WE DID INCLUDE THEM IN C9A AND C9B HOWEVER, TO ACCOUNT FOR THOSE BALLOTS STATUS. DATA FOR NO VOTER SIGNATURE, NO WITNESS SIGNATURE, AND NO RESIDENT ADDRESS ON ENVELOPE WOULD ALL FALL INTO OUR REASON OF CERTIFICATION INSUFFICIENT.

C1Comments: 1. WI DOES NOT ALLOW VOTERS WITH A RETURNED ABSENTEE BALLOT TO SPOIL IT AND INSTEAD VOTE A BALLOT ON ELECTION DAY. A VOTER SENT AN ABSENTEE BALLOT THEY NEVER RETURNED CAN CHOOSE TO INSTEAD VOTE ON ELECTION DAY WITHOUT SURRENDERING THEIR UNVOTED BALLOT; THE UNVOTED BALLOT IS CONSIDERED NOT RETURNED.  2. VOTER INELIGIBLE ARE BALLOTS NOT RETURNED AND CANCELLED BECAUSE THE VOTER WAS NOT ELIGIBLE TO VOTE THE BALLOT  3. VOTER REFUSED ARE BALLOTS FOR VOTERS ON THE PERMANENT ABSENTEE LIST WHO REFUSED A BALLOT FOR THIS ELECTION AND DID NOT REQUEST A REPLACEMENT  4. NOT RETURNED, SENT TO VOTER FOR RESOLUTION ARE BALLOTS FOR VOTERS WHO RETURNED THEIR ABSENTEE BALLOT BUT BALLOT CERTIFICATE WAS INCOMPLETE SO BALLOT AND CERTIFICATE WERE SENT BACK TO VOTER TO RESOLVE THE ISSUE AND THEY NEVER RESUBMITTED IT

C7Comments: WI DOES NOT GATHER DATA ON IF OR HOW ABSENTEE BALLOTS MAY HAVE BEEN RECEIVED BACK BY THE CLERK WITH MISSING DATA OR IF THIS MISSING DATA WAS CURED.
C8Comments: DATA IN C8A WILL NOT MATCH EXACTLY WITH DATA IN F1D DUE TO HOW VOTER RECORD MERGES HAPPEN IN OUR DATABASE. WHEN TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER AND IN SECTION C WE LOOK ONLY AT ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORDS WHILE IN SECTION F WE LOOK FOR ELECTION PARTICIPATION AND AN ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD. THOSE VOTERS NOT PICKED UP IN SECTION F1D ARE HOWEVER PICKED UP IN SECTION F1H

C9Comments: C9N INCLUDES VOTERS WHOSE BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THEY ALREADY VOTED VIA ANOTHER MEANS, BUT NOT NECESSARILY IN PERSON. A BALLOT NOT RECEIVED ON TIME OR THAT MISSES THE DEADLINE IS NOT COUNTED NOR FORMALLY REJECTED IN WI. WE DID INCLUDE THEM IN C9A AND C9B HOWEVER, TO ACCOUNT FOR THOSE BALLOTS STATUS.  IN THE PAST WE HAD DATA FOR C9O, HOWEVER NOW WI REQUIRES A VOTER TO PROVIDE PROOF OF RESIDENCE AT TIME OF REGISTERING AND WOULD NOT RECEIVE A BALLOT WITHOUT A VALID COMPLETED REGISTRATION. WI USES A REJECTION REASON OF SUPERSEDING BALLOT ACCEPTED IN SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES WHERE A VOTER HAD TO BE SENT A SECOND ABSENTEE BALLOT BECAUSE THE ORIGINAL BALLOT CONTAINED A PRINTING ERROR AND THE FIRST BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THE VOTER RETURNED THE SECOND BALLOT WHICH WAS COUNTED. DATA FOR NO VOTER SIGNATURE, NO WITNESS SIGNATURE, AND NO RESIDENT ADDRESS ON ENVELOPE WOULD ALL FALL INTO OUR REASON OF CERTIFICATION INSUFFICIENT.

C1Comments: 1. WI DOES NOT ALLOW VOTERS WITH A RETURNED ABSENTEE BALLOT TO SPOIL IT AND INSTEAD VOTE A BALLOT ON ELECTION DAY. A VOTER SENT AN ABSENTEE BALLOT THEY NEVER RETURNED CAN CHOOSE TO INSTEAD VOTE ON ELECTION DAY WITHOUT SURRENDERING THEIR UNVOTED BALLOT; THE UNVOTED BALLOT IS CONSIDERED NOT RETURNED.  2. VOTER INELIGIBLE ARE BALLOTS NOT RETURNED AND CANCELLED BECAUSE THE VOTER WAS NOT ELIGIBLE TO VOTE THE BALLOT  3. VOTER REFUSED ARE BALLOTS FOR VOTERS ON THE PERMANENT ABSENTEE LIST WHO REFUSED A BALLOT FOR THIS ELECTION AND DID NOT REQUEST A REPLACEMENT  4. NOT RETURNED, SENT TO VOTER FOR RESOLUTION ARE BALLOTS FOR VOTERS WHO RETURNED THEIR ABSENTEE BALLOT BUT BALLOT CERTIFICATE WAS INCOMPLETE SO BALLOT AND CERTIFICATE WERE SENT BACK TO VOTER TO RESOLVE THE ISSUE AND THEY NEVER RESUBMITTED IT
C2Comments: VOTERS WHO ARE INDEFINITELY CONFINED DUE TO AGE, ILLNESS, INFIRMITY OR DISABILITY CAN REQUEST ABSENTEE BALLOTS BY MAIL FOR ALL FUTURE ELECTIONS
C3Comments: IN WISCONSIN, DROP BOX AVAILABILITY IS DETERMINED BY THE INDIVIDUAL JURISDICTIONS ON WHETHER THEY WILL PROVIDE THEM AS AN OPTION AND WHEN OR WHERE THEY CAN BE USED. COMPLETE DATA IS NOT COLLECTED ON DROP BOXES BY THE STATE AND THEREFORE UNAVAILABLE FOR REPORTING.
C7Comments: WI DOES NOT GATHER DATA ON IF OR HOW ABSENTEE BALLOTS MAY HAVE BEEN RECEIVED BACK BY THE CLERK WITH MISSING DATA OR IF THIS MISSING DATA WAS CURED.
C8Comments: DATA IN C8A WILL NOT MATCH EXACTLY WITH DATA IN F1D DUE TO HOW VOTER RECORD MERGES HAPPEN IN OUR DATABASE. WHEN TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER AND IN SECTION C WE LOOK ONLY AT ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORDS WHILE IN SECTION F WE LOOK FOR ELECTION PARTICIPATION AND AN ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD. THOSE VOTERS NOT PICKED UP IN SECTION F1D ARE HOWEVER PICKED UP IN SECTION F1H
C9t_Other: REJECTIONS REASONS NOT LISTED ABOVE:  1. NO POI ENCLOSED AND NO CERTIFICATION FROM CARE FACILITY REPRESENTATIVE WHEN VOTER RESIDES IN AN SVD-ELIGIBLE FACILITY NOT VISITED BY SVDS  2. ELECTION OFFICIAL ERROR  3. SUPERSEDING BALLOT RECEIVED  4. SUPERSEDING BALLOT RETURNED  5. REJECTION EXPLANATION NULL (NOT PROVIDED IN DATA)
C9Comments: C9N INCLUDES VOTERS WHOSE BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THEY ALREADY VOTED VIA ANOTHER MEANS, BUT NOT NECESSARILY IN PERSON. A BALLOT NOT RECEIVED ON TIME OR THAT MISSES THE DEADLINE IS NOT COUNTED NOR FORMALLY REJECTED IN WI. WE DID INCLUDE THEM IN C9A AND C9B HOWEVER, TO ACCOUNT FOR THOSE BALLOTS STATUS.  WI USES A REJECTION REASON OF SUPERSEDING BALLOT ACCEPTED IN SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES WHERE A VOTER HAD TO BE SENT A SECOND ABSENTEE BALLOT BECAUSE THE ORIGINAL BALLOT CONTAINED A PRINTING ERROR AND THE FIRST BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THE VOTER RETURNED THE SECOND BALLOT WHICH WAS COUNTED. DATA FOR NO VOTER SIGNATURE, NO WITNESS SIGNATURE, AND NO RESIDENT ADDRESS ON ENVELOPE WOULD ALL FALL INTO OUR REASON OF CERTIFICATION INSUFFICIENT.

VOTER INELIGIBLE ARE BALLOTS NOT RETURNED AND CANCELLED BECAUSE THE VOTER WAS NOT ELIGIBLE TO VOTE THE BALLOT  3. VOTER REFUSED ARE BALLOTS FOR VOTERS ON THE PERMANENT ABSENTEE LIST WHO REFUSED A BALLOT FOR THIS ELECTION AND DID NOT REQUEST A REPLACEMENT  4. NOT RETURNED, SENT TO VOTER FOR RESOLUTION ARE BALLOTS FOR VOTERS WHO RETURNED THEIR ABSENTEE BALLOT BUT BALLOT CERTIFICATE WAS INCOMPLETE SO BALLOT AND CERTIFICATE WERE SENT BACK TO VOTER TO RESOLVE THE ISSUE AND THEY NEVER RESUBMITTED IT

C7Comments: WI DOES NOT GATHER DATA ON IF OR HOW ABSENTEE BALLOTS MAY HAVE BEEN RECEIVED BACK BY THE CLERK WITH MISSING DATA OR IF THIS MISSING DATA WAS CURED.
C8Comments: DATA IN C8A WILL NOT MATCH EXACTLY WITH DATA IN F1D DUE TO HOW VOTER RECORD MERGES HAPPEN IN OUR DATABASE. WHEN TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER AND IN SECTION C WE LOOK ONLY AT ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORDS WHILE IN SECTION F WE LOOK FOR ELECTION PARTICIPATION AND AN ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD. THOSE VOTERS NOT PICKED UP IN SECTION F1D ARE HOWEVER PICKED UP IN SECTION F1H

WI USES A REJECTION REASON OF SUPERSEDING BALLOT ACCEPTED IN SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES WHERE A VOTER HAD TO BE SENT A SECOND ABSENTEE BALLOT BECAUSE THE ORIGINAL BALLOT CONTAINED A PRINTING ERROR AND THE FIRST BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THE VOTER RETURNED THE SECOND BALLOT WHICH WAS COUNTED. NOT RETURNED, SENT TO VOTER FOR RESOLUTION ARE BALLOTS FOR VOTERS WHO RETURNED THEIR ABSENTEE BALLOT BUT BALLOT CERTIFICATE WAS INCOMPLETE SO BALLOT AND CERTIFICATE WERE SENT BACK TO VOTER TO RESOLVE THE ISSUE AND THEY NEVER RESUBMITTED IT

WHEN TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER AND IN SECTION C WE LOOK ONLY AT ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORDS WHILE IN SECTION F WE LOOK FOR ELECTION PARTICIPATION AND AN ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD. THOSE VOTERS NOT PICKED UP IN SECTION F1D ARE HOWEVER PICKED UP IN SECTION F1H

C1Comments: 1. WI DOES NOT ALLOW VOTERS WITH A RETURNED ABSENTEE BALLOT TO SPOIL IT AND INSTEAD VOTE A BALLOT ON ELECTION DAY. A VOTER SENT AN ABSENTEE BALLOT THEY NEVER RETURNED CAN CHOOSE TO INSTEAD VOTE ON ELECTION DAY WITHOUT SURRENDERING THEIR UNVOTED BALLOT; THE UNVOTED BALLOT IS CONSIDERED NOT RETURNED.  2. VOTER INELIGIBLE ARE BALLOTS NOT RETURNED AND CANCELLED BECAUSE THE VOTER WAS NOT ELIGIBLE TO VOTE THE BALLOT  3. VOTER REFUSED ARE BALLOTS FOR VOTERS ON THE PERMANENT ABSENTEE LIST WHO REFUSED A BALLOT FOR THIS ELECTION AND DID NOT REQUEST A REPLACEMENT  4. NOT RETURNED, SENT TO VOTER FOR RESOLUTION ARE BALLOTS FOR VOTERS WHO RETURNED THEIR ABSENTEE BALLOT BUT BALLOT CERTIFICATE WAS INCOMPLETE SO BALLOT AND CERTIFICATE WERE SENT BACK TO VOTER TO RESOLVE THE ISSUE AND THEY NEVER RESUBMITTED IT
C2Comments: VOTERS WHO ARE INDEFINITELY CONFINED DUE TO AGE, ILLNESS, INFIRMITY OR DISABILITY CAN REQUEST ABSENTEE BALLOTS BY MAIL FOR ALL FUTURE ELECTIONS
C3Comments: IN WISCONSIN, DROP BOX AVAILABILITY IS DETERMINED BY THE INDIVIDUAL JURISDICTIONS ON WHETHER THEY WILL PROVIDE THEM AS AN OPTION AND WHEN OR WHERE THEY CAN BE USED. COMPLETE DATA IS NOT COLLECTED ON DROP BOXES BY THE STATE AND THEREFORE UNAVAILABLE FOR REPORTING.
C7Comments: WI DOES NOT GATHER DATA ON IF OR HOW ABSENTEE BALLOTS MAY HAVE BEEN RECEIVED BACK BY THE CLERK WITH MISSING DATA OR IF THIS MISSING DATA WAS CURED.
C8Comments: DATA IN C8A WILL NOT MATCH EXACTLY WITH DATA IN F1D DUE TO HOW VOTER RECORD MERGES HAPPEN IN OUR DATABASE. WHEN TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER AND IN SECTION C WE LOOK ONLY AT ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORDS WHILE IN SECTION F WE LOOK FOR ELECTION PARTICIPATION AND AN ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD. THOSE VOTERS NOT PICKED UP IN SECTION F1D ARE HOWEVER PICKED UP IN SECTION F1H

C9Comments: C9N INCLUDES VOTERS WHOSE BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THEY ALREADY VOTED VIA ANOTHER MEANS, BUT NOT NECESSARILY IN PERSON. A BALLOT NOT RECEIVED ON TIME OR THAT MISSES THE DEADLINE IS NOT COUNTED NOR FORMALLY REJECTED IN WI. WE DID INCLUDE THEM IN C9A AND C9B HOWEVER, TO ACCOUNT FOR THOSE BALLOTS STATUS.  WI USES A REJECTION REASON OF SUPERSEDING BALLOT ACCEPTED IN SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES WHERE A VOTER HAD TO BE SENT A SECOND ABSENTEE BALLOT BECAUSE THE ORIGINAL BALLOT CONTAINED A PRINTING ERROR AND THE FIRST BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THE VOTER RETURNED THE SECOND BALLOT WHICH WAS COUNTED. DATA FOR NO VOTER SIGNATURE, NO WITNESS SIGNATURE, AND NO RESIDENT ADDRESS ON ENVELOPE WOULD ALL FALL INTO OUR REASON OF CERTIFICATION INSUFFICIENT.

C7Comments: WI DOES NOT GATHER DATA ON IF OR HOW ABSENTEE BALLOTS MAY HAVE BEEN RECEIVED BACK BY THE CLERK WITH MISSING DATA OR IF THIS MISSING DATA WAS CURED.
C8Comments: DATA IN C8A WILL NOT MATCH EXACTLY WITH DATA IN F1D DUE TO HOW VOTER RECORD MERGES HAPPEN IN OUR DATABASE. WHEN TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER AND IN SECTION C WE LOOK ONLY AT ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORDS WHILE IN SECTION F WE LOOK FOR ELECTION PARTICIPATION AND AN ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD. THOSE VOTERS NOT PICKED UP IN SECTION F1D ARE HOWEVER PICKED UP IN SECTION F1H

C9Comments: C9N INCLUDES VOTERS WHOSE BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THEY ALREADY VOTED VIA ANOTHER MEANS, BUT NOT NECESSARILY IN PERSON. IN THE PAST WE HAD DATA FOR C9O, HOWEVER NOW WI REQUIRES A VOTER TO PROVIDE PROOF OF RESIDENCE AT TIME OF REGISTERING AND WOULD NOT RECEIVE A BALLOT WITHOUT A VALID COMPLETED REGISTRATION. WI USES A REJECTION REASON OF SUPERSEDING BALLOT ACCEPTED IN SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES WHERE A VOTER HAD TO BE SENT A SECOND ABSENTEE BALLOT BECAUSE THE ORIGINAL BALLOT CONTAINED A PRINTING ERROR AND THE FIRST BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THE VOTER RETURNED THE SECOND BALLOT WHICH WAS COUNTED. C1Comments: 1. WI DOES NOT ALLOW VOTERS WITH A RETURNED ABSENTEE BALLOT TO SPOIL IT AND INSTEAD VOTE A BALLOT ON ELECTION DAY. A VOTER SENT AN ABSENTEE BALLOT THEY NEVER RETURNED CAN CHOOSE TO INSTEAD VOTE ON ELECTION DAY WITHOUT SURRENDERING THEIR UNVOTED BALLOT; THE UNVOTED BALLOT IS CONSIDERED NOT RETURNED.  2. VOTER INELIGIBLE ARE BALLOTS NOT RETURNED AND CANCELLED BECAUSE THE VOTER WAS NOT ELIGIBLE TO VOTE THE BALLOT  3. VOTER REFUSED ARE BALLOTS FOR VOTERS ON THE PERMANENT ABSENTEE LIST WHO REFUSED A BALLOT FOR THIS ELECTION AND DID NOT REQUEST A REPLACEMENT  4. NOT RETURNED, SENT TO VOTER FOR RESOLUTION ARE BALLOTS FOR VOTERS WHO RETURNED THEIR ABSENTEE BALLOT BUT BALLOT CERTIFICATE WAS INCOMPLETE SO BALLOT AND CERTIFICATE WERE SENT BACK TO VOTER TO RESOLVE THE ISSUE AND THEY NEVER RESUBMITTED IT

C7Comments: WI DOES NOT GATHER DATA ON IF OR HOW ABSENTEE BALLOTS MAY HAVE BEEN RECEIVED BACK BY THE CLERK WITH MISSING DATA OR IF THIS MISSING DATA WAS CURED.
C8Comments: DATA IN C8A WILL NOT MATCH EXACTLY WITH DATA IN F1D DUE TO HOW VOTER RECORD MERGES HAPPEN IN OUR DATABASE. WHEN TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER AND IN SECTION C WE LOOK ONLY AT ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORDS WHILE IN SECTION F WE LOOK FOR ELECTION PARTICIPATION AND AN ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD. THOSE VOTERS NOT PICKED UP IN SECTION F1D ARE HOWEVER PICKED UP IN SECTION F1H

C9Comments: C9N INCLUDES VOTERS WHOSE BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THEY ALREADY VOTED VIA ANOTHER MEANS, BUT NOT NECESSARILY IN PERSON. A BALLOT NOT RECEIVED ON TIME OR THAT MISSES THE DEADLINE IS NOT COUNTED NOR FORMALLY REJECTED IN WI. WE DID INCLUDE THEM IN C9A AND C9B HOWEVER, TO ACCOUNT FOR THOSE BALLOTS STATUS.  IN THE PAST WE HAD DATA FOR C9O, HOWEVER NOW WI REQUIRES A VOTER TO PROVIDE PROOF OF RESIDENCE AT TIME OF REGISTERING AND WOULD NOT RECEIVE A BALLOT WITHOUT A VALID COMPLETED REGISTRATION. WI USES A REJECTION REASON OF SUPERSEDING BALLOT ACCEPTED IN SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES WHERE A VOTER HAD TO BE SENT A SECOND ABSENTEE BALLOT BECAUSE THE ORIGINAL BALLOT CONTAINED A PRINTING ERROR AND THE FIRST BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THE VOTER RETURNED THE SECOND BALLOT WHICH WAS COUNTED. DATA FOR NO VOTER SIGNATURE, NO WITNESS SIGNATURE, AND NO RESIDENT ADDRESS ON ENVELOPE WOULD ALL FALL INTO OUR REASON OF CERTIFICATION INSUFFICIENT.

C1Comments: 1. WI DOES NOT ALLOW VOTERS WITH A RETURNED ABSENTEE BALLOT TO SPOIL IT AND INSTEAD VOTE A BALLOT ON ELECTION DAY. A VOTER SENT AN ABSENTEE BALLOT THEY NEVER RETURNED CAN CHOOSE TO INSTEAD VOTE ON ELECTION DAY WITHOUT SURRENDERING THEIR UNVOTED BALLOT; THE UNVOTED BALLOT IS CONSIDERED NOT RETURNED.  2. VOTER INELIGIBLE ARE BALLOTS NOT RETURNED AND CANCELLED BECAUSE THE VOTER WAS NOT ELIGIBLE TO VOTE THE BALLOT  3. VOTER REFUSED ARE BALLOTS FOR VOTERS ON THE PERMANENT ABSENTEE LIST WHO REFUSED A BALLOT FOR THIS ELECTION AND DID NOT REQUEST A REPLACEMENT  4. NOT RETURNED, SENT TO VOTER FOR RESOLUTION ARE BALLOTS FOR VOTERS WHO RETURNED THEIR ABSENTEE BALLOT BUT BALLOT CERTIFICATE WAS INCOMPLETE SO BALLOT AND CERTIFICATE WERE SENT BACK TO VOTER TO RESOLVE THE ISSUE AND THEY NEVER RESUBMITTED IT
C2Comments: VOTERS WHO ARE INDEFINITELY CONFINED DUE TO AGE, ILLNESS, INFIRMITY OR DISABILITY CAN REQUEST ABSENTEE BALLOTS BY MAIL FOR ALL FUTURE ELECTIONS
C3Comments: IN WISCONSIN, DROP BOX AVAILABILITY IS DETERMINED BY THE INDIVIDUAL JURISDICTIONS ON WHETHER THEY WILL PROVIDE THEM AS AN OPTION AND WHEN OR WHERE THEY CAN BE USED. COMPLETE DATA IS NOT COLLECTED ON DROP BOXES BY THE STATE AND THEREFORE UNAVAILABLE FOR REPORTING.
C7Comments: WI DOES NOT GATHER DATA ON IF OR HOW ABSENTEE BALLOTS MAY HAVE BEEN RECEIVED BACK BY THE CLERK WITH MISSING DATA OR IF THIS MISSING DATA WAS CURED.
C8Comments: DATA IN C8A WILL NOT MATCH EXACTLY WITH DATA IN F1D DUE TO HOW VOTER RECORD MERGES HAPPEN IN OUR DATABASE. WHEN TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER AND IN SECTION C WE LOOK ONLY AT ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORDS WHILE IN SECTION F WE LOOK FOR ELECTION PARTICIPATION AND AN ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD. THOSE VOTERS NOT PICKED UP IN SECTION F1D ARE HOWEVER PICKED UP IN SECTION F1H
C9t_Other: REJECTIONS REASONS NOT LISTED ABOVE:  1. NO POI ENCLOSED AND NO CERTIFICATION FROM CARE FACILITY REPRESENTATIVE WHEN VOTER RESIDES IN AN SVD-ELIGIBLE FACILITY NOT VISITED BY SVDS  2. ELECTION OFFICIAL ERROR  3. SUPERSEDING BALLOT RECEIVED  4. SUPERSEDING BALLOT RETURNED  5. REJECTION EXPLANATION NULL (NOT PROVIDED IN DATA)
C9Comments: C9N INCLUDES VOTERS WHOSE BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THEY ALREADY VOTED VIA ANOTHER MEANS, BUT NOT NECESSARILY IN PERSON. A BALLOT NOT RECEIVED ON TIME OR THAT MISSES THE DEADLINE IS NOT COUNTED NOR FORMALLY REJECTED IN WI. WE DID INCLUDE THEM IN C9A AND C9B HOWEVER, TO ACCOUNT FOR THOSE BALLOTS STATUS.  WI USES A REJECTION REASON OF SUPERSEDING BALLOT ACCEPTED IN SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES WHERE A VOTER HAD TO BE SENT A SECOND ABSENTEE BALLOT BECAUSE THE ORIGINAL BALLOT CONTAINED A PRINTING ERROR AND THE FIRST BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THE VOTER RETURNED THE SECOND BALLOT WHICH WAS COUNTED. DATA FOR NO VOTER SIGNATURE, NO WITNESS SIGNATURE, AND NO RESIDENT ADDRESS ON ENVELOPE WOULD ALL FALL INTO OUR REASON OF CERTIFICATION INSUFFICIENT.

C1Comments: 1. WI DOES NOT ALLOW VOTERS WITH A RETURNED ABSENTEE BALLOT TO SPOIL IT AND INSTEAD VOTE A BALLOT ON ELECTION DAY. C7Comments: WI DOES NOT GATHER DATA ON IF OR HOW ABSENTEE BALLOTS MAY HAVE BEEN RECEIVED BACK BY THE CLERK WITH MISSING DATA OR IF THIS MISSING DATA WAS CURED.
C8Comments: DATA IN C8A WILL NOT MATCH EXACTLY WITH DATA IN F1D DUE TO HOW VOTER RECORD MERGES HAPPEN IN OUR DATABASE. WHEN TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER AND IN SECTION C WE LOOK ONLY AT ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORDS WHILE IN SECTION F WE LOOK FOR ELECTION PARTICIPATION AND AN ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD. THOSE VOTERS NOT PICKED UP IN SECTION F1D ARE HOWEVER PICKED UP IN SECTION F1H

C9Comments: C9N INCLUDES VOTERS WHOSE BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THEY ALREADY VOTED VIA ANOTHER MEANS, BUT NOT NECESSARILY IN PERSON. A BALLOT NOT RECEIVED ON TIME OR THAT MISSES THE DEADLINE IS NOT COUNTED NOR FORMALLY REJECTED IN WI. WE DID INCLUDE THEM IN C9A AND C9B HOWEVER, TO ACCOUNT FOR THOSE BALLOTS STATUS.  IN THE PAST WE HAD DATA FOR C9O, HOWEVER NOW WI REQUIRES A VOTER TO PROVIDE PROOF OF RESIDENCE AT TIME OF REGISTERING AND WOULD NOT RECEIVE A BALLOT WITHOUT A VALID COMPLETED REGISTRATION. WI USES A REJECTION REASON OF SUPERSEDING BALLOT ACCEPTED IN SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES WHERE A VOTER HAD TO BE SENT A SECOND ABSENTEE BALLOT BECAUSE THE ORIGINAL BALLOT CONTAINED A PRINTING ERROR AND THE FIRST BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THE VOTER RETURNED THE SECOND BALLOT WHICH WAS COUNTED. DATA FOR NO VOTER SIGNATURE, NO WITNESS SIGNATURE, AND NO RESIDENT ADDRESS ON ENVELOPE WOULD ALL FALL INTO OUR REASON OF CERTIFICATION INSUFFICIENT.

C1Comments: 1. WI DOES NOT ALLOW VOTERS WITH A RETURNED ABSENTEE BALLOT TO SPOIL IT AND INSTEAD VOTE A BALLOT ON ELECTION DAY. A VOTER SENT AN ABSENTEE BALLOT THEY NEVER RETURNED CAN CHOOSE TO INSTEAD VOTE ON ELECTION DAY WITHOUT SURRENDERING THEIR UNVOTED BALLOT; THE UNVOTED BALLOT IS CONSIDERED NOT RETURNED.  2. VOTER INELIGIBLE ARE BALLOTS NOT RETURNED AND CANCELLED BECAUSE THE VOTER WAS NOT ELIGIBLE TO VOTE THE BALLOT  3. VOTER REFUSED ARE BALLOTS FOR VOTERS ON THE PERMANENT ABSENTEE LIST WHO REFUSED A BALLOT FOR THIS ELECTION AND DID NOT REQUEST A REPLACEMENT  4. NOT RETURNED, SENT TO VOTER FOR RESOLUTION ARE BALLOTS FOR VOTERS WHO RETURNED THEIR ABSENTEE BALLOT BUT BALLOT CERTIFICATE WAS INCOMPLETE SO BALLOT AND CERTIFICATE WERE SENT BACK TO VOTER TO RESOLVE THE ISSUE AND THEY NEVER RESUBMITTED IT
C2Comments: VOTERS WHO ARE INDEFINITELY CONFINED DUE TO AGE, ILLNESS, INFIRMITY OR DISABILITY CAN REQUEST ABSENTEE BALLOTS BY MAIL FOR ALL FUTURE ELECTIONS
C3Comments: IN WISCONSIN, DROP BOX AVAILABILITY IS DETERMINED BY THE INDIVIDUAL JURISDICTIONS ON WHETHER THEY WILL PROVIDE THEM AS AN OPTION AND WHEN OR WHERE THEY CAN BE USED. COMPLETE DATA IS NOT COLLECTED ON DROP BOXES BY THE STATE AND THEREFORE UNAVAILABLE FOR REPORTING.
C7Comments: WI DOES NOT GATHER DATA ON IF OR HOW ABSENTEE BALLOTS MAY HAVE BEEN RECEIVED BACK BY THE CLERK WITH MISSING DATA OR IF THIS MISSING DATA WAS CURED.
C8Comments: DATA IN C8A WILL NOT MATCH EXACTLY WITH DATA IN F1D DUE TO HOW VOTER RECORD MERGES HAPPEN IN OUR DATABASE. WHEN TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER AND IN SECTION C WE LOOK ONLY AT ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORDS WHILE IN SECTION F WE LOOK FOR ELECTION PARTICIPATION AND AN ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD. THOSE VOTERS NOT PICKED UP IN SECTION F1D ARE HOWEVER PICKED UP IN SECTION F1H
C9t_Other: REJECTIONS REASONS NOT LISTED ABOVE:  1. NO POI ENCLOSED AND NO CERTIFICATION FROM CARE FACILITY REPRESENTATIVE WHEN VOTER RESIDES IN AN SVD-ELIGIBLE FACILITY NOT VISITED BY SVDS  2. ELECTION OFFICIAL ERROR  3. SUPERSEDING BALLOT RECEIVED  4. SUPERSEDING BALLOT RETURNED  5. REJECTION EXPLANATION NULL (NOT PROVIDED IN DATA)
C9Comments: C9N INCLUDES VOTERS WHOSE BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THEY ALREADY VOTED VIA ANOTHER MEANS, BUT NOT NECESSARILY IN PERSON. A BALLOT NOT RECEIVED ON TIME OR THAT MISSES THE DEADLINE IS NOT COUNTED NOR FORMALLY REJECTED IN WI. WE DID INCLUDE THEM IN C9A AND C9B HOWEVER, TO ACCOUNT FOR THOSE BALLOTS STATUS.  WI USES A REJECTION REASON OF SUPERSEDING BALLOT ACCEPTED IN SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES WHERE A VOTER HAD TO BE SENT A SECOND ABSENTEE BALLOT BECAUSE THE ORIGINAL BALLOT CONTAINED A PRINTING ERROR AND THE FIRST BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THE VOTER RETURNED THE SECOND BALLOT WHICH WAS COUNTED. DATA FOR NO VOTER SIGNATURE, NO WITNESS SIGNATURE, AND NO RESIDENT ADDRESS ON ENVELOPE WOULD ALL FALL INTO OUR REASON OF CERTIFICATION INSUFFICIENT.

THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER AND IN SECTION C WE LOOK ONLY AT ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORDS WHILE IN SECTION F WE LOOK FOR ELECTION PARTICIPATION AND AN ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD. THOSE VOTERS NOT PICKED UP IN SECTION F1D ARE HOWEVER PICKED UP IN SECTION F1H

A VOTER SENT AN ABSENTEE BALLOT THEY NEVER RETURNED CAN CHOOSE TO INSTEAD VOTE ON ELECTION DAY WITHOUT SURRENDERING THEIR UNVOTED BALLOT; THE UNVOTED BALLOT IS CONSIDERED NOT RETURNED.  2. VOTER INELIGIBLE ARE BALLOTS NOT RETURNED AND CANCELLED BECAUSE THE VOTER WAS NOT ELIGIBLE TO VOTE THE BALLOT  3. VOTER REFUSED ARE BALLOTS FOR VOTERS ON THE PERMANENT ABSENTEE LIST WHO REFUSED A BALLOT FOR THIS ELECTION AND DID NOT REQUEST A REPLACEMENT  4. NOT RETURNED, SENT TO VOTER FOR RESOLUTION ARE BALLOTS FOR VOTERS WHO RETURNED THEIR ABSENTEE BALLOT BUT BALLOT CERTIFICATE WAS INCOMPLETE SO BALLOT AND CERTIFICATE WERE SENT BACK TO VOTER TO RESOLVE THE ISSUE AND THEY NEVER RESUBMITTED IT
C2Comments: VOTERS WHO ARE INDEFINITELY CONFINED DUE TO AGE, ILLNESS, INFIRMITY OR DISABILITY CAN REQUEST ABSENTEE BALLOTS BY MAIL FOR ALL FUTURE ELECTIONS
C3Comments: IN WISCONSIN, DROP BOX AVAILABILITY IS DETERMINED BY THE INDIVIDUAL JURISDICTIONS ON WHETHER THEY WILL PROVIDE THEM AS AN OPTION AND WHEN OR WHERE THEY CAN BE USED. COMPLETE DATA IS NOT COLLECTED ON DROP BOXES BY THE STATE AND THEREFORE UNAVAILABLE FOR REPORTING.
C7Comments: WI DOES NOT GATHER DATA ON IF OR HOW ABSENTEE BALLOTS MAY HAVE BEEN RECEIVED BACK BY THE CLERK WITH MISSING DATA OR IF THIS MISSING DATA WAS CURED.
C8Comments: DATA IN C8A WILL NOT MATCH EXACTLY WITH DATA IN F1D DUE TO HOW VOTER RECORD MERGES HAPPEN IN OUR DATABASE. WHEN TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER AND IN SECTION C WE LOOK ONLY AT ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORDS WHILE IN SECTION F WE LOOK FOR ELECTION PARTICIPATION AND AN ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD. THOSE VOTERS NOT PICKED UP IN SECTION F1D ARE HOWEVER PICKED UP IN SECTION F1H
C9t_Other: REJECTIONS REASONS NOT LISTED ABOVE:  1. NO POI ENCLOSED AND NO CERTIFICATION FROM CARE FACILITY REPRESENTATIVE WHEN VOTER RESIDES IN AN SVD-ELIGIBLE FACILITY NOT VISITED BY SVDS  2. ELECTION OFFICIAL ERROR  3. SUPERSEDING BALLOT RECEIVED  4. SUPERSEDING BALLOT RETURNED  5. REJECTION EXPLANATION NULL (NOT PROVIDED IN DATA)
C9Comments: C9N INCLUDES VOTERS WHOSE BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THEY ALREADY VOTED VIA ANOTHER MEANS, BUT NOT NECESSARILY IN PERSON. A BALLOT NOT RECEIVED ON TIME OR THAT MISSES THE DEADLINE IS NOT COUNTED NOR FORMALLY REJECTED IN WI. WE DID INCLUDE THEM IN C9A AND C9B HOWEVER, TO ACCOUNT FOR THOSE BALLOTS STATUS.  IN THE PAST WE HAD DATA FOR C9O, HOWEVER NOW WI REQUIRES A VOTER TO PROVIDE PROOF OF RESIDENCE AT TIME OF REGISTERING AND WOULD NOT RECEIVE A BALLOT WITHOUT A VALID COMPLETED REGISTRATION. WI USES A REJECTION REASON OF SUPERSEDING BALLOT ACCEPTED IN SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES WHERE A VOTER HAD TO BE SENT A SECOND ABSENTEE BALLOT BECAUSE THE ORIGINAL BALLOT CONTAINED A PRINTING ERROR AND THE FIRST BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THE VOTER RETURNED THE SECOND BALLOT WHICH WAS COUNTED. DATA FOR NO VOTER SIGNATURE, NO WITNESS SIGNATURE, AND NO RESIDENT ADDRESS ON ENVELOPE WOULD ALL FALL INTO OUR REASON OF CERTIFICATION INSUFFICIENT.
D3_D4Comments: ELECTION DAY POLLING PLACES CANNOT BE LOCATED IN ELECTION OFFICES. MUNICIPALITIES MAY SHARE INFORMATION ABOUT IN-PERSON ABSENTEE VOTING LOCATIONS WITH THE STATE, HOWEVER THEY ARE NOT REQUIRED TO DO SO. THEREFORE, DATA CANNOT BE PROVIDED FOR ALL MUNICIPALITIES. OUR SYSTEM DOES NOT DISTINGUISH WHETHER AN IN-PERSON ABSENTEE VOTING LOCATION IS AN ELECTION OFFICE OR ANOTHER LOCATION.

F1Comments: WI DOES NOT HAVE ANY PRECINCTS/JURISDICTIONS THAT ARE 100% VOTE BY MAIL.  SOME DATA IN OTHER SECTIONS WILL NOT MATCH WITH THEIR EQUIVALENT IN SECTION F FOR THE FOLLOWING REASONS.  IN CASES WHERE TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER, THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER. OR, BECAUSE IN WI PROVISISIONAL BALLOT DATA HAS TO BE RECORDED INTO THE DATABASE ON ELECTION NIGHT. THESE TWO RECORDS CANNOT BE LINKED IN OUR DATABASE, SINCE VOTER RECORDS MAY BE CREATED AFTER ELECTION DAY, AND ARE THEREFORE NOT ALWAYS CONNECTED TO THEIR PROVISIONAL BALLOT RECORD.

F9_F10Comments: IN WI ELECTRONIC POLL BOOKS CAN ROUTE VOTERS TO CORRECT POLLING PLACES IF THERE IS AN ACTIVE VOTER RECORD IN THE SYSTEM AT THE ADDRESS WHERE THEY LIVE OR IF THEY DO NOT HAVE AN ACTIVE RECORD, BUT THE ADDRESS ALREADY EXISTS IN THE DATABASE. POLL BOOKS (ELECTRONIC AND PAPER) WILL INDICATE THE STATUS OF AN ABSENTEE BALLOT FOR A VOTER AS OF THE TIME THE POLL BOOK FILE WAS GENERATED. CHANGES AFTER THE FILE IS GENERATED WOULD NOT BE REFLECTED IN THE POLL BOOK.

WI USES A REJECTION REASON OF SUPERSEDING BALLOT ACCEPTED IN SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES WHERE A VOTER HAD TO BE SENT A SECOND ABSENTEE BALLOT BECAUSE THE ORIGINAL BALLOT CONTAINED A PRINTING ERROR AND THE FIRST BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THE VOTER RETURNED THE SECOND BALLOT WHICH WAS COUNTED. C7Comments: WI DOES NOT GATHER DATA ON IF OR HOW ABSENTEE BALLOTS MAY HAVE BEEN RECEIVED BACK BY THE CLERK WITH MISSING DATA OR IF THIS MISSING DATA WAS CURED.
C8Comments: DATA IN C8A WILL NOT MATCH EXACTLY WITH DATA IN F1D DUE TO HOW VOTER RECORD MERGES HAPPEN IN OUR DATABASE. WHEN TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER AND IN SECTION C WE LOOK ONLY AT ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORDS WHILE IN SECTION F WE LOOK FOR ELECTION PARTICIPATION AND AN ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD. THOSE VOTERS NOT PICKED UP IN SECTION F1D ARE HOWEVER PICKED UP IN SECTION F1H

C9Comments: C9N INCLUDES VOTERS WHOSE BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THEY ALREADY VOTED VIA ANOTHER MEANS, BUT NOT NECESSARILY IN PERSON. A BALLOT NOT RECEIVED ON TIME OR THAT MISSES THE DEADLINE IS NOT COUNTED NOR FORMALLY REJECTED IN WI. WE DID INCLUDE THEM IN C9A AND C9B HOWEVER, TO ACCOUNT FOR THOSE BALLOTS STATUS.  IN THE PAST WE HAD DATA FOR C9O, HOWEVER NOW WI REQUIRES A VOTER TO PROVIDE PROOF OF RESIDENCE AT TIME OF REGISTERING AND WOULD NOT RECEIVE A BALLOT WITHOUT A VALID COMPLETED REGISTRATION. WI USES A REJECTION REASON OF SUPERSEDING BALLOT ACCEPTED IN SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES WHERE A VOTER HAD TO BE SENT A SECOND ABSENTEE BALLOT BECAUSE THE ORIGINAL BALLOT CONTAINED A PRINTING ERROR AND THE FIRST BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THE VOTER RETURNED THE SECOND BALLOT WHICH WAS COUNTED. DATA FOR NO VOTER SIGNATURE, NO WITNESS SIGNATURE, AND NO RESIDENT ADDRESS ON ENVELOPE WOULD ALL FALL INTO OUR REASON OF CERTIFICATION INSUFFICIENT.

VOTER INELIGIBLE ARE BALLOTS NOT RETURNED AND CANCELLED BECAUSE THE VOTER WAS NOT ELIGIBLE TO VOTE THE BALLOT  3. VOTER REFUSED ARE BALLOTS FOR VOTERS ON THE PERMANENT ABSENTEE LIST WHO REFUSED A BALLOT FOR THIS ELECTION AND DID NOT REQUEST A REPLACEMENT  4. NOT RETURNED, SENT TO VOTER FOR RESOLUTION ARE BALLOTS FOR VOTERS WHO RETURNED THEIR ABSENTEE BALLOT BUT BALLOT CERTIFICATE WAS INCOMPLETE SO BALLOT AND CERTIFICATE WERE SENT BACK TO VOTER TO RESOLVE THE ISSUE AND THEY NEVER RESUBMITTED IT

C7Comments: WI DOES NOT GATHER DATA ON IF OR HOW ABSENTEE BALLOTS MAY HAVE BEEN RECEIVED BACK BY THE CLERK WITH MISSING DATA OR IF THIS MISSING DATA WAS CURED.
C8Comments: DATA IN C8A WILL NOT MATCH EXACTLY WITH DATA IN F1D DUE TO HOW VOTER RECORD MERGES HAPPEN IN OUR DATABASE. WHEN TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER AND IN SECTION C WE LOOK ONLY AT ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORDS WHILE IN SECTION F WE LOOK FOR ELECTION PARTICIPATION AND AN ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD. THOSE VOTERS NOT PICKED UP IN SECTION F1D ARE HOWEVER PICKED UP IN SECTION F1H

THOSE VOTERS NOT PICKED UP IN SECTION F1D ARE HOWEVER PICKED UP IN SECTION F1H

WI USES A REJECTION REASON OF SUPERSEDING BALLOT ACCEPTED IN SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES WHERE A VOTER HAD TO BE SENT A SECOND ABSENTEE BALLOT BECAUSE THE ORIGINAL BALLOT CONTAINED A PRINTING ERROR AND THE FIRST BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THE VOTER RETURNED THE SECOND BALLOT WHICH WAS COUNTED. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER AND IN SECTION C WE LOOK ONLY AT ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORDS WHILE IN SECTION F WE LOOK FOR ELECTION PARTICIPATION AND AN ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD. THOSE VOTERS NOT PICKED UP IN SECTION F1D ARE HOWEVER PICKED UP IN SECTION F1H

C1Comments: 1. WI DOES NOT ALLOW VOTERS WITH A RETURNED ABSENTEE BALLOT TO SPOIL IT AND INSTEAD VOTE A BALLOT ON ELECTION DAY. A VOTER SENT AN ABSENTEE BALLOT THEY NEVER RETURNED CAN CHOOSE TO INSTEAD VOTE ON ELECTION DAY WITHOUT SURRENDERING THEIR UNVOTED BALLOT; THE UNVOTED BALLOT IS CONSIDERED NOT RETURNED.  2. VOTER INELIGIBLE ARE BALLOTS NOT RETURNED AND CANCELLED BECAUSE THE VOTER WAS NOT ELIGIBLE TO VOTE THE BALLOT  3. VOTER REFUSED ARE BALLOTS FOR VOTERS ON THE PERMANENT ABSENTEE LIST WHO REFUSED A BALLOT FOR THIS ELECTION AND DID NOT REQUEST A REPLACEMENT  4. NOT RETURNED, SENT TO VOTER FOR RESOLUTION ARE BALLOTS FOR VOTERS WHO RETURNED THEIR ABSENTEE BALLOT BUT BALLOT CERTIFICATE WAS INCOMPLETE SO BALLOT AND CERTIFICATE WERE SENT BACK TO VOTER TO RESOLVE THE ISSUE AND THEY NEVER RESUBMITTED IT

C7Comments: WI DOES NOT GATHER DATA ON IF OR HOW ABSENTEE BALLOTS MAY HAVE BEEN RECEIVED BACK BY THE CLERK WITH MISSING DATA OR IF THIS MISSING DATA WAS CURED.
C8Comments: DATA IN C8A WILL NOT MATCH EXACTLY WITH DATA IN F1D DUE TO HOW VOTER RECORD MERGES HAPPEN IN OUR DATABASE. WHEN TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER AND IN SECTION C WE LOOK ONLY AT ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORDS WHILE IN SECTION F WE LOOK FOR ELECTION PARTICIPATION AND AN ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD. THOSE VOTERS NOT PICKED UP IN SECTION F1D ARE HOWEVER PICKED UP IN SECTION F1H

C9Comments: C9N INCLUDES VOTERS WHOSE BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THEY ALREADY VOTED VIA ANOTHER MEANS, BUT NOT NECESSARILY IN PERSON. A BALLOT NOT RECEIVED ON TIME OR THAT MISSES THE DEADLINE IS NOT COUNTED NOR FORMALLY REJECTED IN WI. WE DID INCLUDE THEM IN C9A AND C9B HOWEVER, TO ACCOUNT FOR THOSE BALLOTS STATUS.  WI USES A REJECTION REASON OF SUPERSEDING BALLOT ACCEPTED IN SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES WHERE A VOTER HAD TO BE SENT A SECOND ABSENTEE BALLOT BECAUSE THE ORIGINAL BALLOT CONTAINED A PRINTING ERROR AND THE FIRST BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THE VOTER RETURNED THE SECOND BALLOT WHICH WAS COUNTED. DATA FOR NO VOTER SIGNATURE, NO WITNESS SIGNATURE, AND NO RESIDENT ADDRESS ON ENVELOPE WOULD ALL FALL INTO OUR REASON OF CERTIFICATION INSUFFICIENT.
