C1Comments: 1. WI DOES NOT ALLOW VOTERS WITH A RETURNED ABSENTEE BALLOT TO SPOIL IT AND INSTEAD VOTE A BALLOT ON ELECTION DAY. A VOTER SENT AN ABSENTEE BALLOT THEY NEVER RETURNED CAN CHOOSE TO INSTEAD VOTE ON ELECTION DAY WITHOUT SURRENDERING THEIR UNVOTED BALLOT; THE UNVOTED BALLOT IS CONSIDERED NOT RETURNED.  2. VOTER INELIGIBLE ARE BALLOTS NOT RETURNED AND CANCELLED BECAUSE THE VOTER WAS NOT ELIGIBLE TO VOTE THE BALLOT  3. VOTER REFUSED ARE BALLOTS FOR VOTERS ON THE PERMANENT ABSENTEE LIST WHO REFUSED A BALLOT FOR THIS ELECTION AND DID NOT REQUEST A REPLACEMENT  4. NOT RETURNED, SENT TO VOTER FOR RESOLUTION ARE BALLOTS FOR VOTERS WHO RETURNED THEIR ABSENTEE BALLOT BUT BALLOT CERTIFICATE WAS INCOMPLETE SO BALLOT AND CERTIFICATE WERE SENT BACK TO VOTER TO RESOLVE THE ISSUE AND THEY NEVER RESUBMITTED IT
C2Comments: VOTERS WHO ARE INDEFINITELY CONFINED DUE TO AGE, ILLNESS, INFIRMITY OR DISABILITY CAN REQUEST ABSENTEE BALLOTS BY MAIL FOR ALL FUTURE ELECTIONS

C8Comments: DATA IN C8A WILL NOT MATCH EXACTLY WITH DATA IN F1D DUE TO HOW VOTER RECORD MERGES HAPPEN IN OUR DATABASE. WHEN TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER AND IN SECTION C WE LOOK ONLY AT ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORDS WHILE IN SECTION F WE LOOK FOR ELECTION PARTICIPATION AND AN ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD. THOSE VOTERS NOT PICKED UP IN SECTION F1D ARE HOWEVER PICKED UP IN SECTION F1H

C9Comments: C9N INCLUDES VOTERS WHOSE BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THEY ALREADY VOTED VIA ANOTHER MEANS, BUT NOT NECESSARILY IN PERSON. A BALLOT NOT RECEIVED ON TIME OR THAT MISSES THE DEADLINE IS NOT COUNTED NOR FORMALLY REJECTED IN WI. WE DID INCLUDE THEM IN C9A AND C9B HOWEVER, TO ACCOUNT FOR THOSE BALLOTS STATUS.  WI USES A REJECTION REASON OF SUPERSEDING BALLOT ACCEPTED IN SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES WHERE A VOTER HAD TO BE SENT A SECOND ABSENTEE BALLOT BECAUSE THE ORIGINAL BALLOT CONTAINED A PRINTING ERROR AND THE FIRST BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THE VOTER RETURNED THE SECOND BALLOT WHICH WAS COUNTED. DATA FOR NO VOTER SIGNATURE, NO WITNESS SIGNATURE, AND NO RESIDENT ADDRESS ON ENVELOPE WOULD ALL FALL INTO OUR REASON OF CERTIFICATION INSUFFICIENT.

C1Comments: 1. WI DOES NOT ALLOW VOTERS WITH A RETURNED ABSENTEE BALLOT TO SPOIL IT AND INSTEAD VOTE A BALLOT ON ELECTION DAY. A VOTER SENT AN ABSENTEE BALLOT THEY NEVER RETURNED CAN CHOOSE TO INSTEAD VOTE ON ELECTION DAY WITHOUT SURRENDERING THEIR UNVOTED BALLOT; THE UNVOTED BALLOT IS CONSIDERED NOT RETURNED.  2. VOTER INELIGIBLE ARE BALLOTS NOT RETURNED AND CANCELLED BECAUSE THE VOTER WAS NOT ELIGIBLE TO VOTE THE BALLOT  3. VOTER REFUSED ARE BALLOTS FOR VOTERS ON THE PERMANENT ABSENTEE LIST WHO REFUSED A BALLOT FOR THIS ELECTION AND DID NOT REQUEST A REPLACEMENT  4. NOT RETURNED, SENT TO VOTER FOR RESOLUTION ARE BALLOTS FOR VOTERS WHO RETURNED THEIR ABSENTEE BALLOT BUT BALLOT CERTIFICATE WAS INCOMPLETE SO BALLOT AND CERTIFICATE WERE SENT BACK TO VOTER TO RESOLVE THE ISSUE AND THEY NEVER RESUBMITTED IT
C2Comments: VOTERS WHO ARE INDEFINITELY CONFINED DUE TO AGE, ILLNESS, INFIRMITY OR DISABILITY CAN REQUEST ABSENTEE BALLOTS BY MAIL FOR ALL FUTURE ELECTIONS
C3Comments: IN WISCONSIN, DROP BOX AVAILABILITY IS DETERMINED BY THE INDIVIDUAL JURISDICTIONS ON WHETHER THEY WILL PROVIDE THEM AS AN OPTION AND WHEN OR WHERE THEY CAN BE USED. COMPLETE DATA IS NOT COLLECTED ON DROP BOXES BY THE STATE AND THEREFORE UNAVAILABLE FOR REPORTING.
C7Comments: WI DOES NOT GATHER DATA ON IF OR HOW ABSENTEE BALLOTS MAY HAVE BEEN RECEIVED BACK BY THE CLERK WITH MISSING DATA OR IF THIS MISSING DATA WAS CURED.
C8Comments: DATA IN C8A WILL NOT MATCH EXACTLY WITH DATA IN F1D DUE TO HOW VOTER RECORD MERGES HAPPEN IN OUR DATABASE. WHEN TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER AND IN SECTION C WE LOOK ONLY AT ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORDS WHILE IN SECTION F WE LOOK FOR ELECTION PARTICIPATION AND AN ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD. THOSE VOTERS NOT PICKED UP IN SECTION F1D ARE HOWEVER PICKED UP IN SECTION F1H
C9t_Other: REJECTIONS REASONS NOT LISTED ABOVE:  1. NO POI ENCLOSED AND NO CERTIFICATION FROM CARE FACILITY REPRESENTATIVE WHEN VOTER RESIDES IN AN SVD-ELIGIBLE FACILITY NOT VISITED BY SVDS  2. ELECTION OFFICIAL ERROR  3. SUPERSEDING BALLOT RECEIVED  4. SUPERSEDING BALLOT RETURNED  5. REJECTION EXPLANATION NULL (NOT PROVIDED IN DATA)
C9Comments: C9N INCLUDES VOTERS WHOSE BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THEY ALREADY VOTED VIA ANOTHER MEANS, BUT NOT NECESSARILY IN PERSON. A BALLOT NOT RECEIVED ON TIME OR THAT MISSES THE DEADLINE IS NOT COUNTED NOR FORMALLY REJECTED IN WI. WE DID INCLUDE THEM IN C9A AND C9B HOWEVER, TO ACCOUNT FOR THOSE BALLOTS STATUS.  WI USES A REJECTION REASON OF SUPERSEDING BALLOT ACCEPTED IN SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES WHERE A VOTER HAD TO BE SENT A SECOND ABSENTEE BALLOT BECAUSE THE ORIGINAL BALLOT CONTAINED A PRINTING ERROR AND THE FIRST BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THE VOTER RETURNED THE SECOND BALLOT WHICH WAS COUNTED. DATA FOR NO VOTER SIGNATURE, NO WITNESS SIGNATURE, AND NO RESIDENT ADDRESS ON ENVELOPE WOULD ALL FALL INTO OUR REASON OF CERTIFICATION INSUFFICIENT.

F1Comments: WI DOES NOT HAVE ANY PRECINCTS/JURISDICTIONS THAT ARE 100% VOTE BY MAIL.  SOME DATA IN OTHER SECTIONS WILL NOT MATCH WITH THEIR EQUIVALENT IN SECTION F FOR THE FOLLOWING REASONS.  IN CASES WHERE TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER, THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER. OR, BECAUSE IN WI PROVISISIONAL BALLOT DATA HAS TO BE RECORDED INTO THE DATABASE ON ELECTION NIGHT. VOTERS WHO REGISTER ON ELECTION DAY ARE USUALLY NOT ENTERED UNTIL AFTER ELECTION DAY. THESE TWO RECORDS CANNOT BE LINKED IN OUR DATABASE, SINCE VOTER RECORDS MAY BE CREATED AFTER ELECTION DAY, AND ARE THEREFORE NOT ALWAYS CONNECTED TO THEIR PROVISIONAL BALLOT RECORD.
F3_F8Comments: WI DOES NOT ALLOW USE OF DRE'S THAT DO NOT INCLUDE A VVPAT. WE DO NOT TRACK THE NUMBER OF MACHINES DEPLOYED.  IF ANY YES/NO QUESTIONS IN THIS SECTION ARE BLANK, THIS MEANS THE DATA WAS NOT AVAILABLE OR WE DO NOT USE.
F9_F10Comments: IN WI ELECTRONIC POLL BOOKS CAN ROUTE VOTERS TO CORRECT POLLING PLACES IF THERE IS AN ACTIVE VOTER RECORD IN THE SYSTEM AT THE ADDRESS WHERE THEY LIVE OR IF THEY DO NOT HAVE AN ACTIVE RECORD, BUT THE ADDRESS ALREADY EXISTS IN THE DATABASE. POLL BOOKS (ELECTRONIC AND PAPER) WILL INDICATE THE STATUS OF AN ABSENTEE BALLOT FOR A VOTER AS OF THE TIME THE POLL BOOK FILE WAS GENERATED. CHANGES AFTER THE FILE IS GENERATED WOULD NOT BE REFLECTED IN THE POLL BOOK.

C1Comments: 1. WI DOES NOT ALLOW VOTERS WITH A RETURNED ABSENTEE BALLOT TO SPOIL IT AND INSTEAD VOTE A BALLOT ON ELECTION DAY. A VOTER SENT AN ABSENTEE BALLOT THEY NEVER RETURNED CAN CHOOSE TO INSTEAD VOTE ON ELECTION DAY WITHOUT SURRENDERING THEIR UNVOTED BALLOT; THE UNVOTED BALLOT IS CONSIDERED NOT RETURNED.  2. VOTER INELIGIBLE ARE BALLOTS NOT RETURNED AND CANCELLED BECAUSE THE VOTER WAS NOT ELIGIBLE TO VOTE THE BALLOT  3. VOTER REFUSED ARE BALLOTS FOR VOTERS ON THE PERMANENT ABSENTEE LIST WHO REFUSED A BALLOT FOR THIS ELECTION AND DID NOT REQUEST A REPLACEMENT  4. NOT RETURNED, SENT TO VOTER FOR RESOLUTION ARE BALLOTS FOR VOTERS WHO RETURNED THEIR ABSENTEE BALLOT BUT BALLOT CERTIFICATE WAS INCOMPLETE SO BALLOT AND CERTIFICATE WERE SENT BACK TO VOTER TO RESOLVE THE ISSUE AND THEY NEVER RESUBMITTED IT

C7Comments: WI DOES NOT GATHER DATA ON IF OR HOW ABSENTEE BALLOTS MAY HAVE BEEN RECEIVED BACK BY THE CLERK WITH MISSING DATA OR IF THIS MISSING DATA WAS CURED.
C8Comments: DATA IN C8A WILL NOT MATCH EXACTLY WITH DATA IN F1D DUE TO HOW VOTER RECORD MERGES HAPPEN IN OUR DATABASE. WHEN TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER AND IN SECTION C WE LOOK ONLY AT ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORDS WHILE IN SECTION F WE LOOK FOR ELECTION PARTICIPATION AND AN ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD. THOSE VOTERS NOT PICKED UP IN SECTION F1D ARE HOWEVER PICKED UP IN SECTION F1H

C9Comments: C9N INCLUDES VOTERS WHOSE BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THEY ALREADY VOTED VIA ANOTHER MEANS, BUT NOT NECESSARILY IN PERSON. A BALLOT NOT RECEIVED ON TIME OR THAT MISSES THE DEADLINE IS NOT COUNTED NOR FORMALLY REJECTED IN WI. WE DID INCLUDE THEM IN C9A AND C9B HOWEVER, TO ACCOUNT FOR THOSE BALLOTS STATUS.  WI USES A REJECTION REASON OF SUPERSEDING BALLOT ACCEPTED IN SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES WHERE A VOTER HAD TO BE SENT A SECOND ABSENTEE BALLOT BECAUSE THE ORIGINAL BALLOT CONTAINED A PRINTING ERROR AND THE FIRST BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THE VOTER RETURNED THE SECOND BALLOT WHICH WAS COUNTED. DATA FOR NO VOTER SIGNATURE, NO WITNESS SIGNATURE, AND NO RESIDENT ADDRESS ON ENVELOPE WOULD ALL FALL INTO OUR REASON OF CERTIFICATION INSUFFICIENT.

OUR SYSTEM DOES NOT DISTINGUISH WHETHER AN IN-PERSON ABSENTEE VOTING LOCATION IS AN ELECTION OFFICE OR ANOTHER LOCATION.

C1Comments: 1. WI DOES NOT ALLOW VOTERS WITH A RETURNED ABSENTEE BALLOT TO SPOIL IT AND INSTEAD VOTE A BALLOT ON ELECTION DAY. A VOTER SENT AN ABSENTEE BALLOT THEY NEVER RETURNED CAN CHOOSE TO INSTEAD VOTE ON ELECTION DAY WITHOUT SURRENDERING THEIR UNVOTED BALLOT; THE UNVOTED BALLOT IS CONSIDERED NOT RETURNED.  2. VOTER INELIGIBLE ARE BALLOTS NOT RETURNED AND CANCELLED BECAUSE THE VOTER WAS NOT ELIGIBLE TO VOTE THE BALLOT  3. VOTER REFUSED ARE BALLOTS FOR VOTERS ON THE PERMANENT ABSENTEE LIST WHO REFUSED A BALLOT FOR THIS ELECTION AND DID NOT REQUEST A REPLACEMENT  4. NOT RETURNED, SENT TO VOTER FOR RESOLUTION ARE BALLOTS FOR VOTERS WHO RETURNED THEIR ABSENTEE BALLOT BUT BALLOT CERTIFICATE WAS INCOMPLETE SO BALLOT AND CERTIFICATE WERE SENT BACK TO VOTER TO RESOLVE THE ISSUE AND THEY NEVER RESUBMITTED IT

C7Comments: WI DOES NOT GATHER DATA ON IF OR HOW ABSENTEE BALLOTS MAY HAVE BEEN RECEIVED BACK BY THE CLERK WITH MISSING DATA OR IF THIS MISSING DATA WAS CURED.
C8Comments: DATA IN C8A WILL NOT MATCH EXACTLY WITH DATA IN F1D DUE TO HOW VOTER RECORD MERGES HAPPEN IN OUR DATABASE. WHEN TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER AND IN SECTION C WE LOOK ONLY AT ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORDS WHILE IN SECTION F WE LOOK FOR ELECTION PARTICIPATION AND AN ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD. THOSE VOTERS NOT PICKED UP IN SECTION F1D ARE HOWEVER PICKED UP IN SECTION F1H

C9Comments: C9N INCLUDES VOTERS WHOSE BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THEY ALREADY VOTED VIA ANOTHER MEANS, BUT NOT NECESSARILY IN PERSON. A BALLOT NOT RECEIVED ON TIME OR THAT MISSES THE DEADLINE IS NOT COUNTED NOR FORMALLY REJECTED IN WI. WE DID INCLUDE THEM IN C9A AND C9B HOWEVER, TO ACCOUNT FOR THOSE BALLOTS STATUS.  IN THE PAST WE HAD DATA FOR C9O, HOWEVER NOW WI REQUIRES A VOTER TO PROVIDE PROOF OF RESIDENCE AT TIME OF REGISTERING AND WOULD NOT RECEIVE A BALLOT WITHOUT A VALID COMPLETED REGISTRATION. WI USES A REJECTION REASON OF SUPERSEDING BALLOT ACCEPTED IN SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES WHERE A VOTER HAD TO BE SENT A SECOND ABSENTEE BALLOT BECAUSE THE ORIGINAL BALLOT CONTAINED A PRINTING ERROR AND THE FIRST BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THE VOTER RETURNED THE SECOND BALLOT WHICH WAS COUNTED. DATA FOR NO VOTER SIGNATURE, NO WITNESS SIGNATURE, AND NO RESIDENT ADDRESS ON ENVELOPE WOULD ALL FALL INTO OUR REASON OF CERTIFICATION INSUFFICIENT.

VOTER INELIGIBLE ARE BALLOTS NOT RETURNED AND CANCELLED BECAUSE THE VOTER WAS NOT ELIGIBLE TO VOTE THE BALLOT  3. C8Comments: DATA IN C8A WILL NOT MATCH EXACTLY WITH DATA IN F1D DUE TO HOW VOTER RECORD MERGES HAPPEN IN OUR DATABASE. WHEN TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER AND IN SECTION C WE LOOK ONLY AT ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORDS WHILE IN SECTION F WE LOOK FOR ELECTION PARTICIPATION AND AN ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD. THOSE VOTERS NOT PICKED UP IN SECTION F1D ARE HOWEVER PICKED UP IN SECTION F1H

WI USES A REJECTION REASON OF SUPERSEDING BALLOT ACCEPTED IN SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES WHERE A VOTER HAD TO BE SENT A SECOND ABSENTEE BALLOT BECAUSE THE ORIGINAL BALLOT CONTAINED A PRINTING ERROR AND THE FIRST BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THE VOTER RETURNED THE SECOND BALLOT WHICH WAS COUNTED. C8Comments: DATA IN C8A WILL NOT MATCH EXACTLY WITH DATA IN F1D DUE TO HOW VOTER RECORD MERGES HAPPEN IN OUR DATABASE. WHEN TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER AND IN SECTION C WE LOOK ONLY AT ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORDS WHILE IN SECTION F WE LOOK FOR ELECTION PARTICIPATION AND AN ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD. THOSE VOTERS NOT PICKED UP IN SECTION F1D ARE HOWEVER PICKED UP IN SECTION F1H

WI USES A REJECTION REASON OF SUPERSEDING BALLOT ACCEPTED IN SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES WHERE A VOTER HAD TO BE SENT A SECOND ABSENTEE BALLOT BECAUSE THE ORIGINAL BALLOT CONTAINED A PRINTING ERROR AND THE FIRST BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THE VOTER RETURNED THE SECOND BALLOT WHICH WAS COUNTED. C1Comments: 1. WI DOES NOT ALLOW VOTERS WITH A RETURNED ABSENTEE BALLOT TO SPOIL IT AND INSTEAD VOTE A BALLOT ON ELECTION DAY. A VOTER SENT AN ABSENTEE BALLOT THEY NEVER RETURNED CAN CHOOSE TO INSTEAD VOTE ON ELECTION DAY WITHOUT SURRENDERING THEIR UNVOTED BALLOT; THE UNVOTED BALLOT IS CONSIDERED NOT RETURNED.  2. VOTER INELIGIBLE ARE BALLOTS NOT RETURNED AND CANCELLED BECAUSE THE VOTER WAS NOT ELIGIBLE TO VOTE THE BALLOT  3. VOTER REFUSED ARE BALLOTS FOR VOTERS ON THE PERMANENT ABSENTEE LIST WHO REFUSED A BALLOT FOR THIS ELECTION AND DID NOT REQUEST A REPLACEMENT  4. NOT RETURNED, SENT TO VOTER FOR RESOLUTION ARE BALLOTS FOR VOTERS WHO RETURNED THEIR ABSENTEE BALLOT BUT BALLOT CERTIFICATE WAS INCOMPLETE SO BALLOT AND CERTIFICATE WERE SENT BACK TO VOTER TO RESOLVE THE ISSUE AND THEY NEVER RESUBMITTED IT

C7Comments: WI DOES NOT GATHER DATA ON IF OR HOW ABSENTEE BALLOTS MAY HAVE BEEN RECEIVED BACK BY THE CLERK WITH MISSING DATA OR IF THIS MISSING DATA WAS CURED.
C8Comments: DATA IN C8A WILL NOT MATCH EXACTLY WITH DATA IN F1D DUE TO HOW VOTER RECORD MERGES HAPPEN IN OUR DATABASE. WHEN TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER AND IN SECTION C WE LOOK ONLY AT ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORDS WHILE IN SECTION F WE LOOK FOR ELECTION PARTICIPATION AND AN ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD. THOSE VOTERS NOT PICKED UP IN SECTION F1D ARE HOWEVER PICKED UP IN SECTION F1H

C9Comments: C9N INCLUDES VOTERS WHOSE BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THEY ALREADY VOTED VIA ANOTHER MEANS, BUT NOT NECESSARILY IN PERSON. A BALLOT NOT RECEIVED ON TIME OR THAT MISSES THE DEADLINE IS NOT COUNTED NOR FORMALLY REJECTED IN WI. WE DID INCLUDE THEM IN C9A AND C9B HOWEVER, TO ACCOUNT FOR THOSE BALLOTS STATUS.  WI USES A REJECTION REASON OF SUPERSEDING BALLOT ACCEPTED IN SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES WHERE A VOTER HAD TO BE SENT A SECOND ABSENTEE BALLOT BECAUSE THE ORIGINAL BALLOT CONTAINED A PRINTING ERROR AND THE FIRST BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THE VOTER RETURNED THE SECOND BALLOT WHICH WAS COUNTED. THOSE VOTERS NOT PICKED UP IN SECTION F1D ARE HOWEVER PICKED UP IN SECTION F1H

VOTER INELIGIBLE ARE BALLOTS NOT RETURNED AND CANCELLED BECAUSE THE VOTER WAS NOT ELIGIBLE TO VOTE THE BALLOT  3. VOTER REFUSED ARE BALLOTS FOR VOTERS ON THE PERMANENT ABSENTEE LIST WHO REFUSED A BALLOT FOR THIS ELECTION AND DID NOT REQUEST A REPLACEMENT  4. NOT RETURNED, SENT TO VOTER FOR RESOLUTION ARE BALLOTS FOR VOTERS WHO RETURNED THEIR ABSENTEE BALLOT BUT BALLOT CERTIFICATE WAS INCOMPLETE SO BALLOT AND CERTIFICATE WERE SENT BACK TO VOTER TO RESOLVE THE ISSUE AND THEY NEVER RESUBMITTED IT
C2Comments: VOTERS WHO ARE INDEFINITELY CONFINED DUE TO AGE, ILLNESS, INFIRMITY OR DISABILITY CAN REQUEST ABSENTEE BALLOTS BY MAIL FOR ALL FUTURE ELECTIONS
C3Comments: IN WISCONSIN, DROP BOX AVAILABILITY IS DETERMINED BY THE INDIVIDUAL JURISDICTIONS ON WHETHER THEY WILL PROVIDE THEM AS AN OPTION AND WHEN OR WHERE THEY CAN BE USED. COMPLETE DATA IS NOT COLLECTED ON DROP BOXES BY THE STATE AND THEREFORE UNAVAILABLE FOR REPORTING.
C7Comments: WI DOES NOT GATHER DATA ON IF OR HOW ABSENTEE BALLOTS MAY HAVE BEEN RECEIVED BACK BY THE CLERK WITH MISSING DATA OR IF THIS MISSING DATA WAS CURED.
C8Comments: DATA IN C8A WILL NOT MATCH EXACTLY WITH DATA IN F1D DUE TO HOW VOTER RECORD MERGES HAPPEN IN OUR DATABASE. WHEN TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER AND IN SECTION C WE LOOK ONLY AT ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORDS WHILE IN SECTION F WE LOOK FOR ELECTION PARTICIPATION AND AN ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD. THOSE VOTERS NOT PICKED UP IN SECTION F1D ARE HOWEVER PICKED UP IN SECTION F1H

C9Comments: C9N INCLUDES VOTERS WHOSE BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THEY ALREADY VOTED VIA ANOTHER MEANS, BUT NOT NECESSARILY IN PERSON. A BALLOT NOT RECEIVED ON TIME OR THAT MISSES THE DEADLINE IS NOT COUNTED NOR FORMALLY REJECTED IN WI. WE DID INCLUDE THEM IN C9A AND C9B HOWEVER, TO ACCOUNT FOR THOSE BALLOTS STATUS.  IN THE PAST WE HAD DATA FOR C9O, HOWEVER NOW WI REQUIRES A VOTER TO PROVIDE PROOF OF RESIDENCE AT TIME OF REGISTERING AND WOULD NOT RECEIVE A BALLOT WITHOUT A VALID COMPLETED REGISTRATION. WI USES A REJECTION REASON OF SUPERSEDING BALLOT ACCEPTED IN SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES WHERE A VOTER HAD TO BE SENT A SECOND ABSENTEE BALLOT BECAUSE THE ORIGINAL BALLOT CONTAINED A PRINTING ERROR AND THE FIRST BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THE VOTER RETURNED THE SECOND BALLOT WHICH WAS COUNTED. E3Comments: IF THE VOTER DOES NOT PROVIDE THE APPROPRIATE DOCUMENTATION BY 4PM ON THE FRIDAY AFTER THE ELECTION, THEIR BALLOT IS REJECTED. IF THEY PROVIDE DOCUMENTATION BUT IT IS INSUFFICIENT, THEIR BALLOT IS REJECTED.
F1Comments: WI DOES NOT HAVE ANY PRECINCTS/JURISDICTIONS THAT ARE 100% VOTE BY MAIL.  SOME DATA IN OTHER SECTIONS WILL NOT MATCH WITH THEIR EQUIVALENT IN SECTION F FOR THE FOLLOWING REASONS.  IN CASES WHERE TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER, THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER. OR, BECAUSE IN WI PROVISISIONAL BALLOT DATA HAS TO BE RECORDED INTO THE DATABASE ON ELECTION NIGHT. VOTERS WHO REGISTER ON ELECTION DAY ARE USUALLY NOT ENTERED UNTIL AFTER ELECTION DAY. THESE TWO RECORDS CANNOT BE LINKED IN OUR DATABASE, SINCE VOTER RECORDS MAY BE CREATED AFTER ELECTION DAY, AND ARE THEREFORE NOT ALWAYS CONNECTED TO THEIR PROVISIONAL BALLOT RECORD.

C1Comments: 1. WI DOES NOT ALLOW VOTERS WITH A RETURNED ABSENTEE BALLOT TO SPOIL IT AND INSTEAD VOTE A BALLOT ON ELECTION DAY. C7Comments: WI DOES NOT GATHER DATA ON IF OR HOW ABSENTEE BALLOTS MAY HAVE BEEN RECEIVED BACK BY THE CLERK WITH MISSING DATA OR IF THIS MISSING DATA WAS CURED.
C8Comments: DATA IN C8A WILL NOT MATCH EXACTLY WITH DATA IN F1D DUE TO HOW VOTER RECORD MERGES HAPPEN IN OUR DATABASE. C9Comments: C9N INCLUDES VOTERS WHOSE BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THEY ALREADY VOTED VIA ANOTHER MEANS, BUT NOT NECESSARILY IN PERSON. WI USES A REJECTION REASON OF SUPERSEDING BALLOT ACCEPTED IN SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES WHERE A VOTER HAD TO BE SENT A SECOND ABSENTEE BALLOT BECAUSE THE ORIGINAL BALLOT CONTAINED A PRINTING ERROR AND THE FIRST BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THE VOTER RETURNED THE SECOND BALLOT WHICH WAS COUNTED. C1Comments: 1. WI DOES NOT ALLOW VOTERS WITH A RETURNED ABSENTEE BALLOT TO SPOIL IT AND INSTEAD VOTE A BALLOT ON ELECTION DAY. F1Comments: WI DOES NOT HAVE ANY PRECINCTS/JURISDICTIONS THAT ARE 100% VOTE BY MAIL.  SOME DATA IN OTHER SECTIONS WILL NOT MATCH WITH THEIR EQUIVALENT IN SECTION F FOR THE FOLLOWING REASONS.  IN CASES WHERE TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER, THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER. OR, BECAUSE IN WI PROVISISIONAL BALLOT DATA HAS TO BE RECORDED INTO THE DATABASE ON ELECTION NIGHT. VOTERS WHO REGISTER ON ELECTION DAY ARE USUALLY NOT ENTERED UNTIL AFTER ELECTION DAY. THESE TWO RECORDS CANNOT BE LINKED IN OUR DATABASE, SINCE VOTER RECORDS MAY BE CREATED AFTER ELECTION DAY, AND ARE THEREFORE NOT ALWAYS CONNECTED TO THEIR PROVISIONAL BALLOT RECORD.

F9_F10Comments: IN WI ELECTRONIC POLL BOOKS CAN ROUTE VOTERS TO CORRECT POLLING PLACES IF THERE IS AN ACTIVE VOTER RECORD IN THE SYSTEM AT THE ADDRESS WHERE THEY LIVE OR IF THEY DO NOT HAVE AN ACTIVE RECORD, BUT THE ADDRESS ALREADY EXISTS IN THE DATABASE. POLL BOOKS (ELECTRONIC AND PAPER) WILL INDICATE THE STATUS OF AN ABSENTEE BALLOT FOR A VOTER AS OF THE TIME THE POLL BOOK FILE WAS GENERATED. CHANGES AFTER THE FILE IS GENERATED WOULD NOT BE REFLECTED IN THE POLL BOOK.

C1Comments: 1. WI DOES NOT ALLOW VOTERS WITH A RETURNED ABSENTEE BALLOT TO SPOIL IT AND INSTEAD VOTE A BALLOT ON ELECTION DAY. A VOTER SENT AN ABSENTEE BALLOT THEY NEVER RETURNED CAN CHOOSE TO INSTEAD VOTE ON ELECTION DAY WITHOUT SURRENDERING THEIR UNVOTED BALLOT; THE UNVOTED BALLOT IS CONSIDERED NOT RETURNED.  2. VOTER INELIGIBLE ARE BALLOTS NOT RETURNED AND CANCELLED BECAUSE THE VOTER WAS NOT ELIGIBLE TO VOTE THE BALLOT  3. VOTER REFUSED ARE BALLOTS FOR VOTERS ON THE PERMANENT ABSENTEE LIST WHO REFUSED A BALLOT FOR THIS ELECTION AND DID NOT REQUEST A REPLACEMENT  4. NOT RETURNED, SENT TO VOTER FOR RESOLUTION ARE BALLOTS FOR VOTERS WHO RETURNED THEIR ABSENTEE BALLOT BUT BALLOT CERTIFICATE WAS INCOMPLETE SO BALLOT AND CERTIFICATE WERE SENT BACK TO VOTER TO RESOLVE THE ISSUE AND THEY NEVER RESUBMITTED IT
C2Comments: VOTERS WHO ARE INDEFINITELY CONFINED DUE TO AGE, ILLNESS, INFIRMITY OR DISABILITY CAN REQUEST ABSENTEE BALLOTS BY MAIL FOR ALL FUTURE ELECTIONS
C3Comments: IN WISCONSIN, DROP BOX AVAILABILITY IS DETERMINED BY THE INDIVIDUAL JURISDICTIONS ON WHETHER THEY WILL PROVIDE THEM AS AN OPTION AND WHEN OR WHERE THEY CAN BE USED. COMPLETE DATA IS NOT COLLECTED ON DROP BOXES BY THE STATE AND THEREFORE UNAVAILABLE FOR REPORTING.
C7Comments: WI DOES NOT GATHER DATA ON IF OR HOW ABSENTEE BALLOTS MAY HAVE BEEN RECEIVED BACK BY THE CLERK WITH MISSING DATA OR IF THIS MISSING DATA WAS CURED.
C8Comments: DATA IN C8A WILL NOT MATCH EXACTLY WITH DATA IN F1D DUE TO HOW VOTER RECORD MERGES HAPPEN IN OUR DATABASE. WHEN TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER AND IN SECTION C WE LOOK ONLY AT ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORDS WHILE IN SECTION F WE LOOK FOR ELECTION PARTICIPATION AND AN ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD. THOSE VOTERS NOT PICKED UP IN SECTION F1D ARE HOWEVER PICKED UP IN SECTION F1H
C9t_Other: REJECTIONS REASONS NOT LISTED ABOVE:  1. NO POI ENCLOSED AND NO CERTIFICATION FROM CARE FACILITY REPRESENTATIVE WHEN VOTER RESIDES IN AN SVD-ELIGIBLE FACILITY NOT VISITED BY SVDS  2. ELECTION OFFICIAL ERROR  3. SUPERSEDING BALLOT RECEIVED  4. SUPERSEDING BALLOT RETURNED  5. REJECTION EXPLANATION NULL (NOT PROVIDED IN DATA)
C9Comments: C9N INCLUDES VOTERS WHOSE BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THEY ALREADY VOTED VIA ANOTHER MEANS, BUT NOT NECESSARILY IN PERSON. A BALLOT NOT RECEIVED ON TIME OR THAT MISSES THE DEADLINE IS NOT COUNTED NOR FORMALLY REJECTED IN WI. WE DID INCLUDE THEM IN C9A AND C9B HOWEVER, TO ACCOUNT FOR THOSE BALLOTS STATUS.  WI USES A REJECTION REASON OF SUPERSEDING BALLOT ACCEPTED IN SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES WHERE A VOTER HAD TO BE SENT A SECOND ABSENTEE BALLOT BECAUSE THE ORIGINAL BALLOT CONTAINED A PRINTING ERROR AND THE FIRST BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THE VOTER RETURNED THE SECOND BALLOT WHICH WAS COUNTED. DATA FOR NO VOTER SIGNATURE, NO WITNESS SIGNATURE, AND NO RESIDENT ADDRESS ON ENVELOPE WOULD ALL FALL INTO OUR REASON OF CERTIFICATION INSUFFICIENT.

A VOTER SENT AN ABSENTEE BALLOT THEY NEVER RETURNED CAN CHOOSE TO INSTEAD VOTE ON ELECTION DAY WITHOUT SURRENDERING THEIR UNVOTED BALLOT; THE UNVOTED BALLOT IS CONSIDERED NOT RETURNED.  2. VOTER INELIGIBLE ARE BALLOTS NOT RETURNED AND CANCELLED BECAUSE THE VOTER WAS NOT ELIGIBLE TO VOTE THE BALLOT  3. VOTER REFUSED ARE BALLOTS FOR VOTERS ON THE PERMANENT ABSENTEE LIST WHO REFUSED A BALLOT FOR THIS ELECTION AND DID NOT REQUEST A REPLACEMENT  4. NOT RETURNED, SENT TO VOTER FOR RESOLUTION ARE BALLOTS FOR VOTERS WHO RETURNED THEIR ABSENTEE BALLOT BUT BALLOT CERTIFICATE WAS INCOMPLETE SO BALLOT AND CERTIFICATE WERE SENT BACK TO VOTER TO RESOLVE THE ISSUE AND THEY NEVER RESUBMITTED IT
C2Comments: VOTERS WHO ARE INDEFINITELY CONFINED DUE TO AGE, ILLNESS, INFIRMITY OR DISABILITY CAN REQUEST ABSENTEE BALLOTS BY MAIL FOR ALL FUTURE ELECTIONS
C3Comments: IN WISCONSIN, DROP BOX AVAILABILITY IS DETERMINED BY THE INDIVIDUAL JURISDICTIONS ON WHETHER THEY WILL PROVIDE THEM AS AN OPTION AND WHEN OR WHERE THEY CAN BE USED. COMPLETE DATA IS NOT COLLECTED ON DROP BOXES BY THE STATE AND THEREFORE UNAVAILABLE FOR REPORTING.
C7Comments: WI DOES NOT GATHER DATA ON IF OR HOW ABSENTEE BALLOTS MAY HAVE BEEN RECEIVED BACK BY THE CLERK WITH MISSING DATA OR IF THIS MISSING DATA WAS CURED.
C8Comments: DATA IN C8A WILL NOT MATCH EXACTLY WITH DATA IN F1D DUE TO HOW VOTER RECORD MERGES HAPPEN IN OUR DATABASE. WHEN TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER AND IN SECTION C WE LOOK ONLY AT ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORDS WHILE IN SECTION F WE LOOK FOR ELECTION PARTICIPATION AND AN ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD. THOSE VOTERS NOT PICKED UP IN SECTION F1D ARE HOWEVER PICKED UP IN SECTION F1H
C9t_Other: REJECTIONS REASONS NOT LISTED ABOVE:  1. NO POI ENCLOSED AND NO CERTIFICATION FROM CARE FACILITY REPRESENTATIVE WHEN VOTER RESIDES IN AN SVD-ELIGIBLE FACILITY NOT VISITED BY SVDS  2. ELECTION OFFICIAL ERROR  3. SUPERSEDING BALLOT RECEIVED  4. SUPERSEDING BALLOT RETURNED  5. REJECTION EXPLANATION NULL (NOT PROVIDED IN DATA)
C9Comments: C9N INCLUDES VOTERS WHOSE BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THEY ALREADY VOTED VIA ANOTHER MEANS, BUT NOT NECESSARILY IN PERSON. A BALLOT NOT RECEIVED ON TIME OR THAT MISSES THE DEADLINE IS NOT COUNTED NOR FORMALLY REJECTED IN WI. WE DID INCLUDE THEM IN C9A AND C9B HOWEVER, TO ACCOUNT FOR THOSE BALLOTS STATUS.  WI USES A REJECTION REASON OF SUPERSEDING BALLOT ACCEPTED IN SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES WHERE A VOTER HAD TO BE SENT A SECOND ABSENTEE BALLOT BECAUSE THE ORIGINAL BALLOT CONTAINED A PRINTING ERROR AND THE FIRST BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THE VOTER RETURNED THE SECOND BALLOT WHICH WAS COUNTED. DATA FOR NO VOTER SIGNATURE, NO WITNESS SIGNATURE, AND NO RESIDENT ADDRESS ON ENVELOPE WOULD ALL FALL INTO OUR REASON OF CERTIFICATION INSUFFICIENT.

OUR SYSTEM DOES NOT DISTINGUISH WHETHER AN IN-PERSON ABSENTEE VOTING LOCATION IS AN ELECTION OFFICE OR ANOTHER LOCATION.

F1Comments: WI DOES NOT HAVE ANY PRECINCTS/JURISDICTIONS THAT ARE 100% VOTE BY MAIL.  SOME DATA IN OTHER SECTIONS WILL NOT MATCH WITH THEIR EQUIVALENT IN SECTION F FOR THE FOLLOWING REASONS.  IN CASES WHERE TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER, THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER. OR, BECAUSE IN WI PROVISISIONAL BALLOT DATA HAS TO BE RECORDED INTO THE DATABASE ON ELECTION NIGHT. VOTERS WHO REGISTER ON ELECTION DAY ARE USUALLY NOT ENTERED UNTIL AFTER ELECTION DAY. THESE TWO RECORDS CANNOT BE LINKED IN OUR DATABASE, SINCE VOTER RECORDS MAY BE CREATED AFTER ELECTION DAY, AND ARE THEREFORE NOT ALWAYS CONNECTED TO THEIR PROVISIONAL BALLOT RECORD.
F3_F8Comments: WI DOES NOT ALLOW USE OF DRE'S THAT DO NOT INCLUDE A VVPAT. WE DO NOT TRACK THE NUMBER OF MACHINES DEPLOYED.  IF ANY YES/NO QUESTIONS IN THIS SECTION ARE BLANK, THIS MEANS THE DATA WAS NOT AVAILABLE OR WE DO NOT USE.
F9_F10Comments: IN WI ELECTRONIC POLL BOOKS CAN ROUTE VOTERS TO CORRECT POLLING PLACES IF THERE IS AN ACTIVE VOTER RECORD IN THE SYSTEM AT THE ADDRESS WHERE THEY LIVE OR IF THEY DO NOT HAVE AN ACTIVE RECORD, BUT THE ADDRESS ALREADY EXISTS IN THE DATABASE. POLL BOOKS (ELECTRONIC AND PAPER) WILL INDICATE THE STATUS OF AN ABSENTEE BALLOT FOR A VOTER AS OF THE TIME THE POLL BOOK FILE WAS GENERATED. CHANGES AFTER THE FILE IS GENERATED WOULD NOT BE REFLECTED IN THE POLL BOOK.

A10Comments: WI IS NVRA EXEMPT. WI SENDS ERIC MAILING NOTICES AND NOTICES TO VOTERS WHO DO NOT VOTE IN A 4-YEAR PERIOD. THE STATE SENDS THESE NOTICES ON BEHALF OF MUNICIPAL CLERKS. CLERKS MAY SEND ADDITIONAL CONFIRMATION NOTICES THAT ARE NOT TRACKED IN THE DATABASE.

C7Comments: WI DOES NOT GATHER DATA ON IF OR HOW ABSENTEE BALLOTS MAY HAVE BEEN RECEIVED BACK BY THE CLERK WITH MISSING DATA OR IF THIS MISSING DATA WAS CURED.
C8Comments: DATA IN C8A WILL NOT MATCH EXACTLY WITH DATA IN F1D DUE TO HOW VOTER RECORD MERGES HAPPEN IN OUR DATABASE. WHEN TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER AND IN SECTION C WE LOOK ONLY AT ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORDS WHILE IN SECTION F WE LOOK FOR ELECTION PARTICIPATION AND AN ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD. THOSE VOTERS NOT PICKED UP IN SECTION F1D ARE HOWEVER PICKED UP IN SECTION F1H

C9Comments: C9N INCLUDES VOTERS WHOSE BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THEY ALREADY VOTED VIA ANOTHER MEANS, BUT NOT NECESSARILY IN PERSON. A BALLOT NOT RECEIVED ON TIME OR THAT MISSES THE DEADLINE IS NOT COUNTED NOR FORMALLY REJECTED IN WI. WE DID INCLUDE THEM IN C9A AND C9B HOWEVER, TO ACCOUNT FOR THOSE BALLOTS STATUS.  IN THE PAST WE HAD DATA FOR C9O, HOWEVER NOW WI REQUIRES A VOTER TO PROVIDE PROOF OF RESIDENCE AT TIME OF REGISTERING AND WOULD NOT RECEIVE A BALLOT WITHOUT A VALID COMPLETED REGISTRATION. WI USES A REJECTION REASON OF SUPERSEDING BALLOT ACCEPTED IN SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES WHERE A VOTER HAD TO BE SENT A SECOND ABSENTEE BALLOT BECAUSE THE ORIGINAL BALLOT CONTAINED A PRINTING ERROR AND THE FIRST BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THE VOTER RETURNED THE SECOND BALLOT WHICH WAS COUNTED. DATA FOR NO VOTER SIGNATURE, NO WITNESS SIGNATURE, AND NO RESIDENT ADDRESS ON ENVELOPE WOULD ALL FALL INTO OUR REASON OF CERTIFICATION INSUFFICIENT.

C8Comments: DATA IN C8A WILL NOT MATCH EXACTLY WITH DATA IN F1D DUE TO HOW VOTER RECORD MERGES HAPPEN IN OUR DATABASE. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER AND IN SECTION C WE LOOK ONLY AT ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORDS WHILE IN SECTION F WE LOOK FOR ELECTION PARTICIPATION AND AN ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD. THOSE VOTERS NOT PICKED UP IN SECTION F1D ARE HOWEVER PICKED UP IN SECTION F1H

WI USES A REJECTION REASON OF SUPERSEDING BALLOT ACCEPTED IN SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES WHERE A VOTER HAD TO BE SENT A SECOND ABSENTEE BALLOT BECAUSE THE ORIGINAL BALLOT CONTAINED A PRINTING ERROR AND THE FIRST BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THE VOTER RETURNED THE SECOND BALLOT WHICH WAS COUNTED. C7Comments: WI DOES NOT GATHER DATA ON IF OR HOW ABSENTEE BALLOTS MAY HAVE BEEN RECEIVED BACK BY THE CLERK WITH MISSING DATA OR IF THIS MISSING DATA WAS CURED.
C8Comments: DATA IN C8A WILL NOT MATCH EXACTLY WITH DATA IN F1D DUE TO HOW VOTER RECORD MERGES HAPPEN IN OUR DATABASE. WHEN TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER AND IN SECTION C WE LOOK ONLY AT ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORDS WHILE IN SECTION F WE LOOK FOR ELECTION PARTICIPATION AND AN ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD. THOSE VOTERS NOT PICKED UP IN SECTION F1D ARE HOWEVER PICKED UP IN SECTION F1H

C9Comments: C9N INCLUDES VOTERS WHOSE BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THEY ALREADY VOTED VIA ANOTHER MEANS, BUT NOT NECESSARILY IN PERSON. A BALLOT NOT RECEIVED ON TIME OR THAT MISSES THE DEADLINE IS NOT COUNTED NOR FORMALLY REJECTED IN WI. WE DID INCLUDE THEM IN C9A AND C9B HOWEVER, TO ACCOUNT FOR THOSE BALLOTS STATUS.  WI USES A REJECTION REASON OF SUPERSEDING BALLOT ACCEPTED IN SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES WHERE A VOTER HAD TO BE SENT A SECOND ABSENTEE BALLOT BECAUSE THE ORIGINAL BALLOT CONTAINED A PRINTING ERROR AND THE FIRST BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THE VOTER RETURNED THE SECOND BALLOT WHICH WAS COUNTED. C1Comments: 1. WI DOES NOT ALLOW VOTERS WITH A RETURNED ABSENTEE BALLOT TO SPOIL IT AND INSTEAD VOTE A BALLOT ON ELECTION DAY. C7Comments: WI DOES NOT GATHER DATA ON IF OR HOW ABSENTEE BALLOTS MAY HAVE BEEN RECEIVED BACK BY THE CLERK WITH MISSING DATA OR IF THIS MISSING DATA WAS CURED.
C8Comments: DATA IN C8A WILL NOT MATCH EXACTLY WITH DATA IN F1D DUE TO HOW VOTER RECORD MERGES HAPPEN IN OUR DATABASE. WHEN TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER AND IN SECTION C WE LOOK ONLY AT ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORDS WHILE IN SECTION F WE LOOK FOR ELECTION PARTICIPATION AND AN ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD. THOSE VOTERS NOT PICKED UP IN SECTION F1D ARE HOWEVER PICKED UP IN SECTION F1H

C9Comments: C9N INCLUDES VOTERS WHOSE BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THEY ALREADY VOTED VIA ANOTHER MEANS, BUT NOT NECESSARILY IN PERSON. A BALLOT NOT RECEIVED ON TIME OR THAT MISSES THE DEADLINE IS NOT COUNTED NOR FORMALLY REJECTED IN WI. WE DID INCLUDE THEM IN C9A AND C9B HOWEVER, TO ACCOUNT FOR THOSE BALLOTS STATUS.  WI USES A REJECTION REASON OF SUPERSEDING BALLOT ACCEPTED IN SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES WHERE A VOTER HAD TO BE SENT A SECOND ABSENTEE BALLOT BECAUSE THE ORIGINAL BALLOT CONTAINED A PRINTING ERROR AND THE FIRST BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THE VOTER RETURNED THE SECOND BALLOT WHICH WAS COUNTED. DATA FOR NO VOTER SIGNATURE, NO WITNESS SIGNATURE, AND NO RESIDENT ADDRESS ON ENVELOPE WOULD ALL FALL INTO OUR REASON OF CERTIFICATION INSUFFICIENT.

C7Comments: WI DOES NOT GATHER DATA ON IF OR HOW ABSENTEE BALLOTS MAY HAVE BEEN RECEIVED BACK BY THE CLERK WITH MISSING DATA OR IF THIS MISSING DATA WAS CURED.
C8Comments: DATA IN C8A WILL NOT MATCH EXACTLY WITH DATA IN F1D DUE TO HOW VOTER RECORD MERGES HAPPEN IN OUR DATABASE. WHEN TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER AND IN SECTION C WE LOOK ONLY AT ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORDS WHILE IN SECTION F WE LOOK FOR ELECTION PARTICIPATION AND AN ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD. THOSE VOTERS NOT PICKED UP IN SECTION F1D ARE HOWEVER PICKED UP IN SECTION F1H

C7Comments: WI DOES NOT GATHER DATA ON IF OR HOW ABSENTEE BALLOTS MAY HAVE BEEN RECEIVED BACK BY THE CLERK WITH MISSING DATA OR IF THIS MISSING DATA WAS CURED.
C8Comments: DATA IN C8A WILL NOT MATCH EXACTLY WITH DATA IN F1D DUE TO HOW VOTER RECORD MERGES HAPPEN IN OUR DATABASE. WHEN TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER AND IN SECTION C WE LOOK ONLY AT ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORDS WHILE IN SECTION F WE LOOK FOR ELECTION PARTICIPATION AND AN ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD. THOSE VOTERS NOT PICKED UP IN SECTION F1D ARE HOWEVER PICKED UP IN SECTION F1H

IN THE PAST WE HAD DATA FOR C9O, HOWEVER NOW WI REQUIRES A VOTER TO PROVIDE PROOF OF RESIDENCE AT TIME OF REGISTERING AND WOULD NOT RECEIVE A BALLOT WITHOUT A VALID COMPLETED REGISTRATION. WI USES A REJECTION REASON OF SUPERSEDING BALLOT ACCEPTED IN SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES WHERE A VOTER HAD TO BE SENT A SECOND ABSENTEE BALLOT BECAUSE THE ORIGINAL BALLOT CONTAINED A PRINTING ERROR AND THE FIRST BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THE VOTER RETURNED THE SECOND BALLOT WHICH WAS COUNTED. VOTER INELIGIBLE ARE BALLOTS NOT RETURNED AND CANCELLED BECAUSE THE VOTER WAS NOT ELIGIBLE TO VOTE THE BALLOT  3. WHEN TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER AND IN SECTION C WE LOOK ONLY AT ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORDS WHILE IN SECTION F WE LOOK FOR ELECTION PARTICIPATION AND AN ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD. THOSE VOTERS NOT PICKED UP IN SECTION F1D ARE HOWEVER PICKED UP IN SECTION F1H

WI USES A REJECTION REASON OF SUPERSEDING BALLOT ACCEPTED IN SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES WHERE A VOTER HAD TO BE SENT A SECOND ABSENTEE BALLOT BECAUSE THE ORIGINAL BALLOT CONTAINED A PRINTING ERROR AND THE FIRST BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THE VOTER RETURNED THE SECOND BALLOT WHICH WAS COUNTED. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER. OR, BECAUSE IN WI PROVISISIONAL BALLOT DATA HAS TO BE RECORDED INTO THE DATABASE ON ELECTION NIGHT. VOTERS WHO REGISTER ON ELECTION DAY ARE USUALLY NOT ENTERED UNTIL AFTER ELECTION DAY. THESE TWO RECORDS CANNOT BE LINKED IN OUR DATABASE, SINCE VOTER RECORDS MAY BE CREATED AFTER ELECTION DAY, AND ARE THEREFORE NOT ALWAYS CONNECTED TO THEIR PROVISIONAL BALLOT RECORD.
F3_F8Comments: WI DOES NOT ALLOW USE OF DRE'S THAT DO NOT INCLUDE A VVPAT. WE DO NOT TRACK THE NUMBER OF MACHINES DEPLOYED.  IF ANY YES/NO QUESTIONS IN THIS SECTION ARE BLANK, THIS MEANS THE DATA WAS NOT AVAILABLE OR WE DO NOT USE.
F9_F10Comments: IN WI ELECTRONIC POLL BOOKS CAN ROUTE VOTERS TO CORRECT POLLING PLACES IF THERE IS AN ACTIVE VOTER RECORD IN THE SYSTEM AT THE ADDRESS WHERE THEY LIVE OR IF THEY DO NOT HAVE AN ACTIVE RECORD, BUT THE ADDRESS ALREADY EXISTS IN THE DATABASE. POLL BOOKS (ELECTRONIC AND PAPER) WILL INDICATE THE STATUS OF AN ABSENTEE BALLOT FOR A VOTER AS OF THE TIME THE POLL BOOK FILE WAS GENERATED. CHANGES AFTER THE FILE IS GENERATED WOULD NOT BE REFLECTED IN THE POLL BOOK.

A10Comments: WI IS NVRA EXEMPT. WI SENDS ERIC MAILING NOTICES AND NOTICES TO VOTERS WHO DO NOT VOTE IN A 4-YEAR PERIOD. C1Comments: 1. WI DOES NOT ALLOW VOTERS WITH A RETURNED ABSENTEE BALLOT TO SPOIL IT AND INSTEAD VOTE A BALLOT ON ELECTION DAY. A VOTER SENT AN ABSENTEE BALLOT THEY NEVER RETURNED CAN CHOOSE TO INSTEAD VOTE ON ELECTION DAY WITHOUT SURRENDERING THEIR UNVOTED BALLOT; THE UNVOTED BALLOT IS CONSIDERED NOT RETURNED.  2. VOTER INELIGIBLE ARE BALLOTS NOT RETURNED AND CANCELLED BECAUSE THE VOTER WAS NOT ELIGIBLE TO VOTE THE BALLOT  3. VOTER REFUSED ARE BALLOTS FOR VOTERS ON THE PERMANENT ABSENTEE LIST WHO REFUSED A BALLOT FOR THIS ELECTION AND DID NOT REQUEST A REPLACEMENT  4. NOT RETURNED, SENT TO VOTER FOR RESOLUTION ARE BALLOTS FOR VOTERS WHO RETURNED THEIR ABSENTEE BALLOT BUT BALLOT CERTIFICATE WAS INCOMPLETE SO BALLOT AND CERTIFICATE WERE SENT BACK TO VOTER TO RESOLVE THE ISSUE AND THEY NEVER RESUBMITTED IT

C7Comments: WI DOES NOT GATHER DATA ON IF OR HOW ABSENTEE BALLOTS MAY HAVE BEEN RECEIVED BACK BY THE CLERK WITH MISSING DATA OR IF THIS MISSING DATA WAS CURED.
C8Comments: DATA IN C8A WILL NOT MATCH EXACTLY WITH DATA IN F1D DUE TO HOW VOTER RECORD MERGES HAPPEN IN OUR DATABASE. WHEN TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER AND IN SECTION C WE LOOK ONLY AT ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORDS WHILE IN SECTION F WE LOOK FOR ELECTION PARTICIPATION AND AN ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD. THOSE VOTERS NOT PICKED UP IN SECTION F1D ARE HOWEVER PICKED UP IN SECTION F1H

C9Comments: C9N INCLUDES VOTERS WHOSE BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THEY ALREADY VOTED VIA ANOTHER MEANS, BUT NOT NECESSARILY IN PERSON. A BALLOT NOT RECEIVED ON TIME OR THAT MISSES THE DEADLINE IS NOT COUNTED NOR FORMALLY REJECTED IN WI. WE DID INCLUDE THEM IN C9A AND C9B HOWEVER, TO ACCOUNT FOR THOSE BALLOTS STATUS.  WI USES A REJECTION REASON OF SUPERSEDING BALLOT ACCEPTED IN SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES WHERE A VOTER HAD TO BE SENT A SECOND ABSENTEE BALLOT BECAUSE THE ORIGINAL BALLOT CONTAINED A PRINTING ERROR AND THE FIRST BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THE VOTER RETURNED THE SECOND BALLOT WHICH WAS COUNTED. DATA FOR NO VOTER SIGNATURE, NO WITNESS SIGNATURE, AND NO RESIDENT ADDRESS ON ENVELOPE WOULD ALL FALL INTO OUR REASON OF CERTIFICATION INSUFFICIENT.

VOTER INELIGIBLE ARE BALLOTS NOT RETURNED AND CANCELLED BECAUSE THE VOTER WAS NOT ELIGIBLE TO VOTE THE BALLOT  3. NOT RETURNED, SENT TO VOTER FOR RESOLUTION ARE BALLOTS FOR VOTERS WHO RETURNED THEIR ABSENTEE BALLOT BUT BALLOT CERTIFICATE WAS INCOMPLETE SO BALLOT AND CERTIFICATE WERE SENT BACK TO VOTER TO RESOLVE THE ISSUE AND THEY NEVER RESUBMITTED IT

C7Comments: WI DOES NOT GATHER DATA ON IF OR HOW ABSENTEE BALLOTS MAY HAVE BEEN RECEIVED BACK BY THE CLERK WITH MISSING DATA OR IF THIS MISSING DATA WAS CURED.
C8Comments: DATA IN C8A WILL NOT MATCH EXACTLY WITH DATA IN F1D DUE TO HOW VOTER RECORD MERGES HAPPEN IN OUR DATABASE. WHEN TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER AND IN SECTION C WE LOOK ONLY AT ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORDS WHILE IN SECTION F WE LOOK FOR ELECTION PARTICIPATION AND AN ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD. THOSE VOTERS NOT PICKED UP IN SECTION F1D ARE HOWEVER PICKED UP IN SECTION F1H

C9Comments: C9N INCLUDES VOTERS WHOSE BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THEY ALREADY VOTED VIA ANOTHER MEANS, BUT NOT NECESSARILY IN PERSON. A BALLOT NOT RECEIVED ON TIME OR THAT MISSES THE DEADLINE IS NOT COUNTED NOR FORMALLY REJECTED IN WI. WE DID INCLUDE THEM IN C9A AND C9B HOWEVER, TO ACCOUNT FOR THOSE BALLOTS STATUS.  IN THE PAST WE HAD DATA FOR C9O, HOWEVER NOW WI REQUIRES A VOTER TO PROVIDE PROOF OF RESIDENCE AT TIME OF REGISTERING AND WOULD NOT RECEIVE A BALLOT WITHOUT A VALID COMPLETED REGISTRATION. WI USES A REJECTION REASON OF SUPERSEDING BALLOT ACCEPTED IN SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES WHERE A VOTER HAD TO BE SENT A SECOND ABSENTEE BALLOT BECAUSE THE ORIGINAL BALLOT CONTAINED A PRINTING ERROR AND THE FIRST BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THE VOTER RETURNED THE SECOND BALLOT WHICH WAS COUNTED. DATA FOR NO VOTER SIGNATURE, NO WITNESS SIGNATURE, AND NO RESIDENT ADDRESS ON ENVELOPE WOULD ALL FALL INTO OUR REASON OF CERTIFICATION INSUFFICIENT.

E3Comments: IF THE VOTER DOES NOT PROVIDE THE APPROPRIATE DOCUMENTATION BY 4PM ON THE FRIDAY AFTER THE ELECTION, THEIR BALLOT IS REJECTED. IF THEY PROVIDE DOCUMENTATION BUT IT IS INSUFFICIENT, THEIR BALLOT IS REJECTED.
F1Comments: WI DOES NOT HAVE ANY PRECINCTS/JURISDICTIONS THAT ARE 100% VOTE BY MAIL.  SOME DATA IN OTHER SECTIONS WILL NOT MATCH WITH THEIR EQUIVALENT IN SECTION F FOR THE FOLLOWING REASONS.  IN CASES WHERE TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER, THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER. OR, BECAUSE IN WI PROVISISIONAL BALLOT DATA HAS TO BE RECORDED INTO THE DATABASE ON ELECTION NIGHT. THESE TWO RECORDS CANNOT BE LINKED IN OUR DATABASE, SINCE VOTER RECORDS MAY BE CREATED AFTER ELECTION DAY, AND ARE THEREFORE NOT ALWAYS CONNECTED TO THEIR PROVISIONAL BALLOT RECORD.

F9_F10Comments: IN WI ELECTRONIC POLL BOOKS CAN ROUTE VOTERS TO CORRECT POLLING PLACES IF THERE IS AN ACTIVE VOTER RECORD IN THE SYSTEM AT THE ADDRESS WHERE THEY LIVE OR IF THEY DO NOT HAVE AN ACTIVE RECORD, BUT THE ADDRESS ALREADY EXISTS IN THE DATABASE. POLL BOOKS (ELECTRONIC AND PAPER) WILL INDICATE THE STATUS OF AN ABSENTEE BALLOT FOR A VOTER AS OF THE TIME THE POLL BOOK FILE WAS GENERATED. CHANGES AFTER THE FILE IS GENERATED WOULD NOT BE REFLECTED IN THE POLL BOOK.

C1Comments: 1. WI DOES NOT ALLOW VOTERS WITH A RETURNED ABSENTEE BALLOT TO SPOIL IT AND INSTEAD VOTE A BALLOT ON ELECTION DAY. A VOTER SENT AN ABSENTEE BALLOT THEY NEVER RETURNED CAN CHOOSE TO INSTEAD VOTE ON ELECTION DAY WITHOUT SURRENDERING THEIR UNVOTED BALLOT; THE UNVOTED BALLOT IS CONSIDERED NOT RETURNED.  2. VOTER INELIGIBLE ARE BALLOTS NOT RETURNED AND CANCELLED BECAUSE THE VOTER WAS NOT ELIGIBLE TO VOTE THE BALLOT  3. C3Comments: IN WISCONSIN, DROP BOX AVAILABILITY IS DETERMINED BY THE INDIVIDUAL JURISDICTIONS ON WHETHER THEY WILL PROVIDE THEM AS AN OPTION AND WHEN OR WHERE THEY CAN BE USED. COMPLETE DATA IS NOT COLLECTED ON DROP BOXES BY THE STATE AND THEREFORE UNAVAILABLE FOR REPORTING.
C7Comments: WI DOES NOT GATHER DATA ON IF OR HOW ABSENTEE BALLOTS MAY HAVE BEEN RECEIVED BACK BY THE CLERK WITH MISSING DATA OR IF THIS MISSING DATA WAS CURED.
C8Comments: DATA IN C8A WILL NOT MATCH EXACTLY WITH DATA IN F1D DUE TO HOW VOTER RECORD MERGES HAPPEN IN OUR DATABASE. WHEN TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER AND IN SECTION C WE LOOK ONLY AT ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORDS WHILE IN SECTION F WE LOOK FOR ELECTION PARTICIPATION AND AN ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD. THOSE VOTERS NOT PICKED UP IN SECTION F1D ARE HOWEVER PICKED UP IN SECTION F1H
C9t_Other: REJECTIONS REASONS NOT LISTED ABOVE:  1. NO POI ENCLOSED AND NO CERTIFICATION FROM CARE FACILITY REPRESENTATIVE WHEN VOTER RESIDES IN AN SVD-ELIGIBLE FACILITY NOT VISITED BY SVDS  2. ELECTION OFFICIAL ERROR  3. SUPERSEDING BALLOT RECEIVED  4. SUPERSEDING BALLOT RETURNED  5. REJECTION EXPLANATION NULL (NOT PROVIDED IN DATA)
C9Comments: C9N INCLUDES VOTERS WHOSE BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THEY ALREADY VOTED VIA ANOTHER MEANS, BUT NOT NECESSARILY IN PERSON. A BALLOT NOT RECEIVED ON TIME OR THAT MISSES THE DEADLINE IS NOT COUNTED NOR FORMALLY REJECTED IN WI. WE DID INCLUDE THEM IN C9A AND C9B HOWEVER, TO ACCOUNT FOR THOSE BALLOTS STATUS.  IN THE PAST WE HAD DATA FOR C9O, HOWEVER NOW WI REQUIRES A VOTER TO PROVIDE PROOF OF RESIDENCE AT TIME OF REGISTERING AND WOULD NOT RECEIVE A BALLOT WITHOUT A VALID COMPLETED REGISTRATION. WI USES A REJECTION REASON OF SUPERSEDING BALLOT ACCEPTED IN SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES WHERE A VOTER HAD TO BE SENT A SECOND ABSENTEE BALLOT BECAUSE THE ORIGINAL BALLOT CONTAINED A PRINTING ERROR AND THE FIRST BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THE VOTER RETURNED THE SECOND BALLOT WHICH WAS COUNTED. DATA FOR NO VOTER SIGNATURE, NO WITNESS SIGNATURE, AND NO RESIDENT ADDRESS ON ENVELOPE WOULD ALL FALL INTO OUR REASON OF CERTIFICATION INSUFFICIENT.

IN CASES WHERE TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER, THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER. OR, BECAUSE IN WI PROVISISIONAL BALLOT DATA HAS TO BE RECORDED INTO THE DATABASE ON ELECTION NIGHT. THESE TWO RECORDS CANNOT BE LINKED IN OUR DATABASE, SINCE VOTER RECORDS MAY BE CREATED AFTER ELECTION DAY, AND ARE THEREFORE NOT ALWAYS CONNECTED TO THEIR PROVISIONAL BALLOT RECORD.

C1Comments: 1. WI DOES NOT ALLOW VOTERS WITH A RETURNED ABSENTEE BALLOT TO SPOIL IT AND INSTEAD VOTE A BALLOT ON ELECTION DAY. VOTER INELIGIBLE ARE BALLOTS NOT RETURNED AND CANCELLED BECAUSE THE VOTER WAS NOT ELIGIBLE TO VOTE THE BALLOT  3. NOT RETURNED, SENT TO VOTER FOR RESOLUTION ARE BALLOTS FOR VOTERS WHO RETURNED THEIR ABSENTEE BALLOT BUT BALLOT CERTIFICATE WAS INCOMPLETE SO BALLOT AND CERTIFICATE WERE SENT BACK TO VOTER TO RESOLVE THE ISSUE AND THEY NEVER RESUBMITTED IT

C7Comments: WI DOES NOT GATHER DATA ON IF OR HOW ABSENTEE BALLOTS MAY HAVE BEEN RECEIVED BACK BY THE CLERK WITH MISSING DATA OR IF THIS MISSING DATA WAS CURED.
C8Comments: DATA IN C8A WILL NOT MATCH EXACTLY WITH DATA IN F1D DUE TO HOW VOTER RECORD MERGES HAPPEN IN OUR DATABASE. WHEN TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER AND IN SECTION C WE LOOK ONLY AT ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORDS WHILE IN SECTION F WE LOOK FOR ELECTION PARTICIPATION AND AN ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD. THOSE VOTERS NOT PICKED UP IN SECTION F1D ARE HOWEVER PICKED UP IN SECTION F1H

ELECTION OFFICIAL ERROR  3. SUPERSEDING BALLOT RECEIVED  4. SUPERSEDING BALLOT RETURNED  5. REJECTION EXPLANATION NULL (NOT PROVIDED IN DATA)
C9Comments: C9N INCLUDES VOTERS WHOSE BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THEY ALREADY VOTED VIA ANOTHER MEANS, BUT NOT NECESSARILY IN PERSON. A BALLOT NOT RECEIVED ON TIME OR THAT MISSES THE DEADLINE IS NOT COUNTED NOR FORMALLY REJECTED IN WI. WE DID INCLUDE THEM IN C9A AND C9B HOWEVER, TO ACCOUNT FOR THOSE BALLOTS STATUS.  IN THE PAST WE HAD DATA FOR C9O, HOWEVER NOW WI REQUIRES A VOTER TO PROVIDE PROOF OF RESIDENCE AT TIME OF REGISTERING AND WOULD NOT RECEIVE A BALLOT WITHOUT A VALID COMPLETED REGISTRATION. WI USES A REJECTION REASON OF SUPERSEDING BALLOT ACCEPTED IN SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES WHERE A VOTER HAD TO BE SENT A SECOND ABSENTEE BALLOT BECAUSE THE ORIGINAL BALLOT CONTAINED A PRINTING ERROR AND THE FIRST BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THE VOTER RETURNED THE SECOND BALLOT WHICH WAS COUNTED. DATA FOR NO VOTER SIGNATURE, NO WITNESS SIGNATURE, AND NO RESIDENT ADDRESS ON ENVELOPE WOULD ALL FALL INTO OUR REASON OF CERTIFICATION INSUFFICIENT.

F1Comments: WI DOES NOT HAVE ANY PRECINCTS/JURISDICTIONS THAT ARE 100% VOTE BY MAIL.  SOME DATA IN OTHER SECTIONS WILL NOT MATCH WITH THEIR EQUIVALENT IN SECTION F FOR THE FOLLOWING REASONS.  IN CASES WHERE TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER, THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THESE TWO RECORDS CANNOT BE LINKED IN OUR DATABASE, SINCE VOTER RECORDS MAY BE CREATED AFTER ELECTION DAY, AND ARE THEREFORE NOT ALWAYS CONNECTED TO THEIR PROVISIONAL BALLOT RECORD.

POLL BOOKS (ELECTRONIC AND PAPER) WILL INDICATE THE STATUS OF AN ABSENTEE BALLOT FOR A VOTER AS OF THE TIME THE POLL BOOK FILE WAS GENERATED. CHANGES AFTER THE FILE IS GENERATED WOULD NOT BE REFLECTED IN THE POLL BOOK.

C7Comments: WI DOES NOT GATHER DATA ON IF OR HOW ABSENTEE BALLOTS MAY HAVE BEEN RECEIVED BACK BY THE CLERK WITH MISSING DATA OR IF THIS MISSING DATA WAS CURED.
C8Comments: DATA IN C8A WILL NOT MATCH EXACTLY WITH DATA IN F1D DUE TO HOW VOTER RECORD MERGES HAPPEN IN OUR DATABASE. WHEN TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER AND IN SECTION C WE LOOK ONLY AT ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORDS WHILE IN SECTION F WE LOOK FOR ELECTION PARTICIPATION AND AN ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD. THOSE VOTERS NOT PICKED UP IN SECTION F1D ARE HOWEVER PICKED UP IN SECTION F1H

C9Comments: C9N INCLUDES VOTERS WHOSE BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THEY ALREADY VOTED VIA ANOTHER MEANS, BUT NOT NECESSARILY IN PERSON. A BALLOT NOT RECEIVED ON TIME OR THAT MISSES THE DEADLINE IS NOT COUNTED NOR FORMALLY REJECTED IN WI. WE DID INCLUDE THEM IN C9A AND C9B HOWEVER, TO ACCOUNT FOR THOSE BALLOTS STATUS.  IN THE PAST WE HAD DATA FOR C9O, HOWEVER NOW WI REQUIRES A VOTER TO PROVIDE PROOF OF RESIDENCE AT TIME OF REGISTERING AND WOULD NOT RECEIVE A BALLOT WITHOUT A VALID COMPLETED REGISTRATION. WI USES A REJECTION REASON OF SUPERSEDING BALLOT ACCEPTED IN SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES WHERE A VOTER HAD TO BE SENT A SECOND ABSENTEE BALLOT BECAUSE THE ORIGINAL BALLOT CONTAINED A PRINTING ERROR AND THE FIRST BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THE VOTER RETURNED THE SECOND BALLOT WHICH WAS COUNTED. DATA FOR NO VOTER SIGNATURE, NO WITNESS SIGNATURE, AND NO RESIDENT ADDRESS ON ENVELOPE WOULD ALL FALL INTO OUR REASON OF CERTIFICATION INSUFFICIENT.

C1Comments: 1. WI DOES NOT ALLOW VOTERS WITH A RETURNED ABSENTEE BALLOT TO SPOIL IT AND INSTEAD VOTE A BALLOT ON ELECTION DAY. A VOTER SENT AN ABSENTEE BALLOT THEY NEVER RETURNED CAN CHOOSE TO INSTEAD VOTE ON ELECTION DAY WITHOUT SURRENDERING THEIR UNVOTED BALLOT; THE UNVOTED BALLOT IS CONSIDERED NOT RETURNED.  2. VOTER INELIGIBLE ARE BALLOTS NOT RETURNED AND CANCELLED BECAUSE THE VOTER WAS NOT ELIGIBLE TO VOTE THE BALLOT  3. VOTER REFUSED ARE BALLOTS FOR VOTERS ON THE PERMANENT ABSENTEE LIST WHO REFUSED A BALLOT FOR THIS ELECTION AND DID NOT REQUEST A REPLACEMENT  4. NOT RETURNED, SENT TO VOTER FOR RESOLUTION ARE BALLOTS FOR VOTERS WHO RETURNED THEIR ABSENTEE BALLOT BUT BALLOT CERTIFICATE WAS INCOMPLETE SO BALLOT AND CERTIFICATE WERE SENT BACK TO VOTER TO RESOLVE THE ISSUE AND THEY NEVER RESUBMITTED IT

C7Comments: WI DOES NOT GATHER DATA ON IF OR HOW ABSENTEE BALLOTS MAY HAVE BEEN RECEIVED BACK BY THE CLERK WITH MISSING DATA OR IF THIS MISSING DATA WAS CURED.
C8Comments: DATA IN C8A WILL NOT MATCH EXACTLY WITH DATA IN F1D DUE TO HOW VOTER RECORD MERGES HAPPEN IN OUR DATABASE. WHEN TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER AND IN SECTION C WE LOOK ONLY AT ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORDS WHILE IN SECTION F WE LOOK FOR ELECTION PARTICIPATION AND AN ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD. THOSE VOTERS NOT PICKED UP IN SECTION F1D ARE HOWEVER PICKED UP IN SECTION F1H

C9Comments: C9N INCLUDES VOTERS WHOSE BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THEY ALREADY VOTED VIA ANOTHER MEANS, BUT NOT NECESSARILY IN PERSON. A BALLOT NOT RECEIVED ON TIME OR THAT MISSES THE DEADLINE IS NOT COUNTED NOR FORMALLY REJECTED IN WI. WE DID INCLUDE THEM IN C9A AND C9B HOWEVER, TO ACCOUNT FOR THOSE BALLOTS STATUS.  WI USES A REJECTION REASON OF SUPERSEDING BALLOT ACCEPTED IN SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES WHERE A VOTER HAD TO BE SENT A SECOND ABSENTEE BALLOT BECAUSE THE ORIGINAL BALLOT CONTAINED A PRINTING ERROR AND THE FIRST BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THE VOTER RETURNED THE SECOND BALLOT WHICH WAS COUNTED. DATA FOR NO VOTER SIGNATURE, NO WITNESS SIGNATURE, AND NO RESIDENT ADDRESS ON ENVELOPE WOULD ALL FALL INTO OUR REASON OF CERTIFICATION INSUFFICIENT.

C8Comments: DATA IN C8A WILL NOT MATCH EXACTLY WITH DATA IN F1D DUE TO HOW VOTER RECORD MERGES HAPPEN IN OUR DATABASE. THOSE VOTERS NOT PICKED UP IN SECTION F1D ARE HOWEVER PICKED UP IN SECTION F1H

WI USES A REJECTION REASON OF SUPERSEDING BALLOT ACCEPTED IN SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES WHERE A VOTER HAD TO BE SENT A SECOND ABSENTEE BALLOT BECAUSE THE ORIGINAL BALLOT CONTAINED A PRINTING ERROR AND THE FIRST BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THE VOTER RETURNED THE SECOND BALLOT WHICH WAS COUNTED. VOTER INELIGIBLE ARE BALLOTS NOT RETURNED AND CANCELLED BECAUSE THE VOTER WAS NOT ELIGIBLE TO VOTE THE BALLOT  3. NOT RETURNED, SENT TO VOTER FOR RESOLUTION ARE BALLOTS FOR VOTERS WHO RETURNED THEIR ABSENTEE BALLOT BUT BALLOT CERTIFICATE WAS INCOMPLETE SO BALLOT AND CERTIFICATE WERE SENT BACK TO VOTER TO RESOLVE THE ISSUE AND THEY NEVER RESUBMITTED IT

C7Comments: WI DOES NOT GATHER DATA ON IF OR HOW ABSENTEE BALLOTS MAY HAVE BEEN RECEIVED BACK BY THE CLERK WITH MISSING DATA OR IF THIS MISSING DATA WAS CURED.
C8Comments: DATA IN C8A WILL NOT MATCH EXACTLY WITH DATA IN F1D DUE TO HOW VOTER RECORD MERGES HAPPEN IN OUR DATABASE. WHEN TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER AND IN SECTION C WE LOOK ONLY AT ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORDS WHILE IN SECTION F WE LOOK FOR ELECTION PARTICIPATION AND AN ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD. THOSE VOTERS NOT PICKED UP IN SECTION F1D ARE HOWEVER PICKED UP IN SECTION F1H

C9Comments: C9N INCLUDES VOTERS WHOSE BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THEY ALREADY VOTED VIA ANOTHER MEANS, BUT NOT NECESSARILY IN PERSON. WI USES A REJECTION REASON OF SUPERSEDING BALLOT ACCEPTED IN SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES WHERE A VOTER HAD TO BE SENT A SECOND ABSENTEE BALLOT BECAUSE THE ORIGINAL BALLOT CONTAINED A PRINTING ERROR AND THE FIRST BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THE VOTER RETURNED THE SECOND BALLOT WHICH WAS COUNTED. AN ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT MOVE TO THE MAIN RECORD WHEN RECORDS ARE MERGED AND THEREFORE THE SYSTEM CANNOT MATCH THE ABSENTEE AND THE PARTICIPATON RECORD TO SAME VOTER. VOTERS NOT PICKED UP IN F1D ARE HOWEVER IN F1H.

C1Comments: 1. WI DOES NOT ALLOW VOTERS WITH A RETURNED ABSENTEE BALLOT TO SPOIL IT AND INSTEAD VOTE A BALLOT ON ELECTION DAY. A VOTER SENT AN ABSENTEE BALLOT THEY NEVER RETURNED CAN CHOOSE TO INSTEAD VOTE ON ELECTION DAY WITHOUT SURRENDERING THEIR UNVOTED BALLOT; THE UNVOTED BALLOT IS CONSIDERED NOT RETURNED.  2. VOTER INELIGIBLE ARE BALLOTS NOT RETURNED AND CANCELLED BECAUSE THE VOTER WAS NOT ELIGIBLE TO VOTE THE BALLOT  3. VOTER REFUSED ARE BALLOTS FOR VOTERS ON THE PERMANENT ABSENTEE LIST WHO REFUSED A BALLOT FOR THIS ELECTION AND DID NOT REQUEST A REPLACEMENT  4. NOT RETURNED, SENT TO VOTER FOR RESOLUTION ARE BALLOTS FOR VOTERS WHO RETURNED THEIR ABSENTEE BALLOT BUT BALLOT CERTIFICATE WAS INCOMPLETE SO BALLOT AND CERTIFICATE WERE SENT BACK TO VOTER TO RESOLVE THE ISSUE AND THEY NEVER RESUBMITTED IT
C2Comments: VOTERS WHO ARE INDEFINITELY CONFINED DUE TO AGE, ILLNESS, INFIRMITY OR DISABILITY CAN REQUEST ABSENTEE BALLOTS BY MAIL FOR ALL FUTURE ELECTIONS
C3Comments: IN WISCONSIN, DROP BOX AVAILABILITY IS DETERMINED BY THE INDIVIDUAL JURISDICTIONS ON WHETHER THEY WILL PROVIDE THEM AS AN OPTION AND WHEN OR WHERE THEY CAN BE USED. COMPLETE DATA IS NOT COLLECTED ON DROP BOXES BY THE STATE AND THEREFORE UNAVAILABLE FOR REPORTING.
C7Comments: WI DOES NOT GATHER DATA ON IF OR HOW ABSENTEE BALLOTS MAY HAVE BEEN RECEIVED BACK BY THE CLERK WITH MISSING DATA OR IF THIS MISSING DATA WAS CURED.
C8Comments: DATA IN C8A WILL NOT MATCH EXACTLY WITH DATA IN F1D DUE TO HOW VOTER RECORD MERGES HAPPEN IN OUR DATABASE. WHEN TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER AND IN SECTION C WE LOOK ONLY AT ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORDS WHILE IN SECTION F WE LOOK FOR ELECTION PARTICIPATION AND AN ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD. THOSE VOTERS NOT PICKED UP IN SECTION F1D ARE HOWEVER PICKED UP IN SECTION F1H
C9t_Other: REJECTIONS REASONS NOT LISTED ABOVE:  1. NO POI ENCLOSED AND NO CERTIFICATION FROM CARE FACILITY REPRESENTATIVE WHEN VOTER RESIDES IN AN SVD-ELIGIBLE FACILITY NOT VISITED BY SVDS  2. ELECTION OFFICIAL ERROR  3. SUPERSEDING BALLOT RECEIVED  4. SUPERSEDING BALLOT RETURNED  5. REJECTION EXPLANATION NULL (NOT PROVIDED IN DATA)
C9Comments: C9N INCLUDES VOTERS WHOSE BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THEY ALREADY VOTED VIA ANOTHER MEANS, BUT NOT NECESSARILY IN PERSON. A BALLOT NOT RECEIVED ON TIME OR THAT MISSES THE DEADLINE IS NOT COUNTED NOR FORMALLY REJECTED IN WI. WE DID INCLUDE THEM IN C9A AND C9B HOWEVER, TO ACCOUNT FOR THOSE BALLOTS STATUS.  IN THE PAST WE HAD DATA FOR C9O, HOWEVER NOW WI REQUIRES A VOTER TO PROVIDE PROOF OF RESIDENCE AT TIME OF REGISTERING AND WOULD NOT RECEIVE A BALLOT WITHOUT A VALID COMPLETED REGISTRATION. WI USES A REJECTION REASON OF SUPERSEDING BALLOT ACCEPTED IN SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES WHERE A VOTER HAD TO BE SENT A SECOND ABSENTEE BALLOT BECAUSE THE ORIGINAL BALLOT CONTAINED A PRINTING ERROR AND THE FIRST BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THE VOTER RETURNED THE SECOND BALLOT WHICH WAS COUNTED. DATA FOR NO VOTER SIGNATURE, NO WITNESS SIGNATURE, AND NO RESIDENT ADDRESS ON ENVELOPE WOULD ALL FALL INTO OUR REASON OF CERTIFICATION INSUFFICIENT.

F1Comments: WI DOES NOT HAVE ANY PRECINCTS/JURISDICTIONS THAT ARE 100% VOTE BY MAIL.  SOME DATA IN OTHER SECTIONS WILL NOT MATCH WITH THEIR EQUIVALENT IN SECTION F FOR THE FOLLOWING REASONS.  IN CASES WHERE TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER, THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER. OR, BECAUSE IN WI PROVISISIONAL BALLOT DATA HAS TO BE RECORDED INTO THE DATABASE ON ELECTION NIGHT. VOTERS WHO REGISTER ON ELECTION DAY ARE USUALLY NOT ENTERED UNTIL AFTER ELECTION DAY. THESE TWO RECORDS CANNOT BE LINKED IN OUR DATABASE, SINCE VOTER RECORDS MAY BE CREATED AFTER ELECTION DAY, AND ARE THEREFORE NOT ALWAYS CONNECTED TO THEIR PROVISIONAL BALLOT RECORD.
F3_F8Comments: WI DOES NOT ALLOW USE OF DRE'S THAT DO NOT INCLUDE A VVPAT. WE DO NOT TRACK THE NUMBER OF MACHINES DEPLOYED.  IF ANY YES/NO QUESTIONS IN THIS SECTION ARE BLANK, THIS MEANS THE DATA WAS NOT AVAILABLE OR WE DO NOT USE.
F9_F10Comments: IN WI ELECTRONIC POLL BOOKS CAN ROUTE VOTERS TO CORRECT POLLING PLACES IF THERE IS AN ACTIVE VOTER RECORD IN THE SYSTEM AT THE ADDRESS WHERE THEY LIVE OR IF THEY DO NOT HAVE AN ACTIVE RECORD, BUT THE ADDRESS ALREADY EXISTS IN THE DATABASE. POLL BOOKS (ELECTRONIC AND PAPER) WILL INDICATE THE STATUS OF AN ABSENTEE BALLOT FOR A VOTER AS OF THE TIME THE POLL BOOK FILE WAS GENERATED. CHANGES AFTER THE FILE IS GENERATED WOULD NOT BE REFLECTED IN THE POLL BOOK.

NOT RETURNED, SENT TO VOTER FOR RESOLUTION ARE BALLOTS FOR VOTERS WHO RETURNED THEIR ABSENTEE BALLOT BUT BALLOT CERTIFICATE WAS INCOMPLETE SO BALLOT AND CERTIFICATE WERE SENT BACK TO VOTER TO RESOLVE THE ISSUE AND THEY NEVER RESUBMITTED IT

C8Comments: DATA IN C8A WILL NOT MATCH EXACTLY WITH DATA IN F1D DUE TO HOW VOTER RECORD MERGES HAPPEN IN OUR DATABASE. WI USES A REJECTION REASON OF SUPERSEDING BALLOT ACCEPTED IN SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES WHERE A VOTER HAD TO BE SENT A SECOND ABSENTEE BALLOT BECAUSE THE ORIGINAL BALLOT CONTAINED A PRINTING ERROR AND THE FIRST BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THE VOTER RETURNED THE SECOND BALLOT WHICH WAS COUNTED. WI USES A REJECTION REASON OF SUPERSEDING BALLOT ACCEPTED IN SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES WHERE A VOTER HAD TO BE SENT A SECOND ABSENTEE BALLOT BECAUSE THE ORIGINAL BALLOT CONTAINED A PRINTING ERROR AND THE FIRST BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THE VOTER RETURNED THE SECOND BALLOT WHICH WAS COUNTED. NOT RETURNED, SENT TO VOTER FOR RESOLUTION ARE BALLOTS FOR VOTERS WHO RETURNED THEIR ABSENTEE BALLOT BUT BALLOT CERTIFICATE WAS INCOMPLETE SO BALLOT AND CERTIFICATE WERE SENT BACK TO VOTER TO RESOLVE THE ISSUE AND THEY NEVER RESUBMITTED IT

VOTER INELIGIBLE ARE BALLOTS NOT RETURNED AND CANCELLED BECAUSE THE VOTER WAS NOT ELIGIBLE TO VOTE THE BALLOT  3. VOTER REFUSED ARE BALLOTS FOR VOTERS ON THE PERMANENT ABSENTEE LIST WHO REFUSED A BALLOT FOR THIS ELECTION AND DID NOT REQUEST A REPLACEMENT  4. NOT RETURNED, SENT TO VOTER FOR RESOLUTION ARE BALLOTS FOR VOTERS WHO RETURNED THEIR ABSENTEE BALLOT BUT BALLOT CERTIFICATE WAS INCOMPLETE SO BALLOT AND CERTIFICATE WERE SENT BACK TO VOTER TO RESOLVE THE ISSUE AND THEY NEVER RESUBMITTED IT
C2Comments: VOTERS WHO ARE INDEFINITELY CONFINED DUE TO AGE, ILLNESS, INFIRMITY OR DISABILITY CAN REQUEST ABSENTEE BALLOTS BY MAIL FOR ALL FUTURE ELECTIONS
C3Comments: IN WISCONSIN, DROP BOX AVAILABILITY IS DETERMINED BY THE INDIVIDUAL JURISDICTIONS ON WHETHER THEY WILL PROVIDE THEM AS AN OPTION AND WHEN OR WHERE THEY CAN BE USED. COMPLETE DATA IS NOT COLLECTED ON DROP BOXES BY THE STATE AND THEREFORE UNAVAILABLE FOR REPORTING.
C7Comments: WI DOES NOT GATHER DATA ON IF OR HOW ABSENTEE BALLOTS MAY HAVE BEEN RECEIVED BACK BY THE CLERK WITH MISSING DATA OR IF THIS MISSING DATA WAS CURED.
C8Comments: DATA IN C8A WILL NOT MATCH EXACTLY WITH DATA IN F1D DUE TO HOW VOTER RECORD MERGES HAPPEN IN OUR DATABASE. WHEN TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER AND IN SECTION C WE LOOK ONLY AT ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORDS WHILE IN SECTION F WE LOOK FOR ELECTION PARTICIPATION AND AN ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD. THOSE VOTERS NOT PICKED UP IN SECTION F1D ARE HOWEVER PICKED UP IN SECTION F1H
C9t_Other: REJECTIONS REASONS NOT LISTED ABOVE:  1. NO POI ENCLOSED AND NO CERTIFICATION FROM CARE FACILITY REPRESENTATIVE WHEN VOTER RESIDES IN AN SVD-ELIGIBLE FACILITY NOT VISITED BY SVDS  2. ELECTION OFFICIAL ERROR  3. SUPERSEDING BALLOT RECEIVED  4. SUPERSEDING BALLOT RETURNED  5. REJECTION EXPLANATION NULL (NOT PROVIDED IN DATA)
C9Comments: C9N INCLUDES VOTERS WHOSE BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THEY ALREADY VOTED VIA ANOTHER MEANS, BUT NOT NECESSARILY IN PERSON. A BALLOT NOT RECEIVED ON TIME OR THAT MISSES THE DEADLINE IS NOT COUNTED NOR FORMALLY REJECTED IN WI. WE DID INCLUDE THEM IN C9A AND C9B HOWEVER, TO ACCOUNT FOR THOSE BALLOTS STATUS.  WI USES A REJECTION REASON OF SUPERSEDING BALLOT ACCEPTED IN SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES WHERE A VOTER HAD TO BE SENT A SECOND ABSENTEE BALLOT BECAUSE THE ORIGINAL BALLOT CONTAINED A PRINTING ERROR AND THE FIRST BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THE VOTER RETURNED THE SECOND BALLOT WHICH WAS COUNTED. DATA FOR NO VOTER SIGNATURE, NO WITNESS SIGNATURE, AND NO RESIDENT ADDRESS ON ENVELOPE WOULD ALL FALL INTO OUR REASON OF CERTIFICATION INSUFFICIENT.

F1Comments: WI DOES NOT HAVE ANY PRECINCTS/JURISDICTIONS THAT ARE 100% VOTE BY MAIL.  SOME DATA IN OTHER SECTIONS WILL NOT MATCH WITH THEIR EQUIVALENT IN SECTION F FOR THE FOLLOWING REASONS.  IN CASES WHERE TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER, THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER. OR, BECAUSE IN WI PROVISISIONAL BALLOT DATA HAS TO BE RECORDED INTO THE DATABASE ON ELECTION NIGHT. VOTERS WHO REGISTER ON ELECTION DAY ARE USUALLY NOT ENTERED UNTIL AFTER ELECTION DAY. THESE TWO RECORDS CANNOT BE LINKED IN OUR DATABASE, SINCE VOTER RECORDS MAY BE CREATED AFTER ELECTION DAY, AND ARE THEREFORE NOT ALWAYS CONNECTED TO THEIR PROVISIONAL BALLOT RECORD.

POLL BOOKS (ELECTRONIC AND PAPER) WILL INDICATE THE STATUS OF AN ABSENTEE BALLOT FOR A VOTER AS OF THE TIME THE POLL BOOK FILE WAS GENERATED. CHANGES AFTER THE FILE IS GENERATED WOULD NOT BE REFLECTED IN THE POLL BOOK.

WI USES A REJECTION REASON OF SUPERSEDING BALLOT ACCEPTED IN SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES WHERE A VOTER HAD TO BE SENT A SECOND ABSENTEE BALLOT BECAUSE THE ORIGINAL BALLOT CONTAINED A PRINTING ERROR AND THE FIRST BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THE VOTER RETURNED THE SECOND BALLOT WHICH WAS COUNTED. WHEN TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER AND IN SECTION C WE LOOK ONLY AT ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORDS WHILE IN SECTION F WE LOOK FOR ELECTION PARTICIPATION AND AN ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD. THOSE VOTERS NOT PICKED UP IN SECTION F1D ARE HOWEVER PICKED UP IN SECTION F1H

C9Comments: C9N INCLUDES VOTERS WHOSE BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THEY ALREADY VOTED VIA ANOTHER MEANS, BUT NOT NECESSARILY IN PERSON. WI USES A REJECTION REASON OF SUPERSEDING BALLOT ACCEPTED IN SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES WHERE A VOTER HAD TO BE SENT A SECOND ABSENTEE BALLOT BECAUSE THE ORIGINAL BALLOT CONTAINED A PRINTING ERROR AND THE FIRST BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THE VOTER RETURNED THE SECOND BALLOT WHICH WAS COUNTED. C7Comments: WI DOES NOT GATHER DATA ON IF OR HOW ABSENTEE BALLOTS MAY HAVE BEEN RECEIVED BACK BY THE CLERK WITH MISSING DATA OR IF THIS MISSING DATA WAS CURED.
C8Comments: DATA IN C8A WILL NOT MATCH EXACTLY WITH DATA IN F1D DUE TO HOW VOTER RECORD MERGES HAPPEN IN OUR DATABASE. WHEN TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER AND IN SECTION C WE LOOK ONLY AT ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORDS WHILE IN SECTION F WE LOOK FOR ELECTION PARTICIPATION AND AN ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD. THOSE VOTERS NOT PICKED UP IN SECTION F1D ARE HOWEVER PICKED UP IN SECTION F1H

C9Comments: C9N INCLUDES VOTERS WHOSE BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THEY ALREADY VOTED VIA ANOTHER MEANS, BUT NOT NECESSARILY IN PERSON. A BALLOT NOT RECEIVED ON TIME OR THAT MISSES THE DEADLINE IS NOT COUNTED NOR FORMALLY REJECTED IN WI. WE DID INCLUDE THEM IN C9A AND C9B HOWEVER, TO ACCOUNT FOR THOSE BALLOTS STATUS.  IN THE PAST WE HAD DATA FOR C9O, HOWEVER NOW WI REQUIRES A VOTER TO PROVIDE PROOF OF RESIDENCE AT TIME OF REGISTERING AND WOULD NOT RECEIVE A BALLOT WITHOUT A VALID COMPLETED REGISTRATION. WI USES A REJECTION REASON OF SUPERSEDING BALLOT ACCEPTED IN SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES WHERE A VOTER HAD TO BE SENT A SECOND ABSENTEE BALLOT BECAUSE THE ORIGINAL BALLOT CONTAINED A PRINTING ERROR AND THE FIRST BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THE VOTER RETURNED THE SECOND BALLOT WHICH WAS COUNTED. DATA FOR NO VOTER SIGNATURE, NO WITNESS SIGNATURE, AND NO RESIDENT ADDRESS ON ENVELOPE WOULD ALL FALL INTO OUR REASON OF CERTIFICATION INSUFFICIENT.

C1Comments: 1. WI DOES NOT ALLOW VOTERS WITH A RETURNED ABSENTEE BALLOT TO SPOIL IT AND INSTEAD VOTE A BALLOT ON ELECTION DAY. A VOTER SENT AN ABSENTEE BALLOT THEY NEVER RETURNED CAN CHOOSE TO INSTEAD VOTE ON ELECTION DAY WITHOUT SURRENDERING THEIR UNVOTED BALLOT; THE UNVOTED BALLOT IS CONSIDERED NOT RETURNED.  2. VOTER INELIGIBLE ARE BALLOTS NOT RETURNED AND CANCELLED BECAUSE THE VOTER WAS NOT ELIGIBLE TO VOTE THE BALLOT  3. VOTER REFUSED ARE BALLOTS FOR VOTERS ON THE PERMANENT ABSENTEE LIST WHO REFUSED A BALLOT FOR THIS ELECTION AND DID NOT REQUEST A REPLACEMENT  4. NOT RETURNED, SENT TO VOTER FOR RESOLUTION ARE BALLOTS FOR VOTERS WHO RETURNED THEIR ABSENTEE BALLOT BUT BALLOT CERTIFICATE WAS INCOMPLETE SO BALLOT AND CERTIFICATE WERE SENT BACK TO VOTER TO RESOLVE THE ISSUE AND THEY NEVER RESUBMITTED IT

C7Comments: WI DOES NOT GATHER DATA ON IF OR HOW ABSENTEE BALLOTS MAY HAVE BEEN RECEIVED BACK BY THE CLERK WITH MISSING DATA OR IF THIS MISSING DATA WAS CURED.
C8Comments: DATA IN C8A WILL NOT MATCH EXACTLY WITH DATA IN F1D DUE TO HOW VOTER RECORD MERGES HAPPEN IN OUR DATABASE. WHEN TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER AND IN SECTION C WE LOOK ONLY AT ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORDS WHILE IN SECTION F WE LOOK FOR ELECTION PARTICIPATION AND AN ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD. THOSE VOTERS NOT PICKED UP IN SECTION F1D ARE HOWEVER PICKED UP IN SECTION F1H

C9Comments: C9N INCLUDES VOTERS WHOSE BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THEY ALREADY VOTED VIA ANOTHER MEANS, BUT NOT NECESSARILY IN PERSON. A BALLOT NOT RECEIVED ON TIME OR THAT MISSES THE DEADLINE IS NOT COUNTED NOR FORMALLY REJECTED IN WI. WE DID INCLUDE THEM IN C9A AND C9B HOWEVER, TO ACCOUNT FOR THOSE BALLOTS STATUS.  IN THE PAST WE HAD DATA FOR C9O, HOWEVER NOW WI REQUIRES A VOTER TO PROVIDE PROOF OF RESIDENCE AT TIME OF REGISTERING AND WOULD NOT RECEIVE A BALLOT WITHOUT A VALID COMPLETED REGISTRATION. WI USES A REJECTION REASON OF SUPERSEDING BALLOT ACCEPTED IN SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES WHERE A VOTER HAD TO BE SENT A SECOND ABSENTEE BALLOT BECAUSE THE ORIGINAL BALLOT CONTAINED A PRINTING ERROR AND THE FIRST BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THE VOTER RETURNED THE SECOND BALLOT WHICH WAS COUNTED. DATA FOR NO VOTER SIGNATURE, NO WITNESS SIGNATURE, AND NO RESIDENT ADDRESS ON ENVELOPE WOULD ALL FALL INTO OUR REASON OF CERTIFICATION INSUFFICIENT.

C1Comments: 1. WI DOES NOT ALLOW VOTERS WITH A RETURNED ABSENTEE BALLOT TO SPOIL IT AND INSTEAD VOTE A BALLOT ON ELECTION DAY. A VOTER SENT AN ABSENTEE BALLOT THEY NEVER RETURNED CAN CHOOSE TO INSTEAD VOTE ON ELECTION DAY WITHOUT SURRENDERING THEIR UNVOTED BALLOT; THE UNVOTED BALLOT IS CONSIDERED NOT RETURNED.  2. VOTER INELIGIBLE ARE BALLOTS NOT RETURNED AND CANCELLED BECAUSE THE VOTER WAS NOT ELIGIBLE TO VOTE THE BALLOT  3. NOT RETURNED, SENT TO VOTER FOR RESOLUTION ARE BALLOTS FOR VOTERS WHO RETURNED THEIR ABSENTEE BALLOT BUT BALLOT CERTIFICATE WAS INCOMPLETE SO BALLOT AND CERTIFICATE WERE SENT BACK TO VOTER TO RESOLVE THE ISSUE AND THEY NEVER RESUBMITTED IT

C7Comments: WI DOES NOT GATHER DATA ON IF OR HOW ABSENTEE BALLOTS MAY HAVE BEEN RECEIVED BACK BY THE CLERK WITH MISSING DATA OR IF THIS MISSING DATA WAS CURED.
C8Comments: DATA IN C8A WILL NOT MATCH EXACTLY WITH DATA IN F1D DUE TO HOW VOTER RECORD MERGES HAPPEN IN OUR DATABASE. WHEN TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER AND IN SECTION C WE LOOK ONLY AT ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORDS WHILE IN SECTION F WE LOOK FOR ELECTION PARTICIPATION AND AN ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD. THOSE VOTERS NOT PICKED UP IN SECTION F1D ARE HOWEVER PICKED UP IN SECTION F1H

C9Comments: C9N INCLUDES VOTERS WHOSE BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THEY ALREADY VOTED VIA ANOTHER MEANS, BUT NOT NECESSARILY IN PERSON. A BALLOT NOT RECEIVED ON TIME OR THAT MISSES THE DEADLINE IS NOT COUNTED NOR FORMALLY REJECTED IN WI. WE DID INCLUDE THEM IN C9A AND C9B HOWEVER, TO ACCOUNT FOR THOSE BALLOTS STATUS.  IN THE PAST WE HAD DATA FOR C9O, HOWEVER NOW WI REQUIRES A VOTER TO PROVIDE PROOF OF RESIDENCE AT TIME OF REGISTERING AND WOULD NOT RECEIVE A BALLOT WITHOUT A VALID COMPLETED REGISTRATION. WI USES A REJECTION REASON OF SUPERSEDING BALLOT ACCEPTED IN SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES WHERE A VOTER HAD TO BE SENT A SECOND ABSENTEE BALLOT BECAUSE THE ORIGINAL BALLOT CONTAINED A PRINTING ERROR AND THE FIRST BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THE VOTER RETURNED THE SECOND BALLOT WHICH WAS COUNTED. DATA FOR NO VOTER SIGNATURE, NO WITNESS SIGNATURE, AND NO RESIDENT ADDRESS ON ENVELOPE WOULD ALL FALL INTO OUR REASON OF CERTIFICATION INSUFFICIENT.

C1Comments: 1. WI DOES NOT ALLOW VOTERS WITH A RETURNED ABSENTEE BALLOT TO SPOIL IT AND INSTEAD VOTE A BALLOT ON ELECTION DAY. A VOTER SENT AN ABSENTEE BALLOT THEY NEVER RETURNED CAN CHOOSE TO INSTEAD VOTE ON ELECTION DAY WITHOUT SURRENDERING THEIR UNVOTED BALLOT; THE UNVOTED BALLOT IS CONSIDERED NOT RETURNED.  2. VOTER INELIGIBLE ARE BALLOTS NOT RETURNED AND CANCELLED BECAUSE THE VOTER WAS NOT ELIGIBLE TO VOTE THE BALLOT  3. VOTER REFUSED ARE BALLOTS FOR VOTERS ON THE PERMANENT ABSENTEE LIST WHO REFUSED A BALLOT FOR THIS ELECTION AND DID NOT REQUEST A REPLACEMENT  4. NOT RETURNED, SENT TO VOTER FOR RESOLUTION ARE BALLOTS FOR VOTERS WHO RETURNED THEIR ABSENTEE BALLOT BUT BALLOT CERTIFICATE WAS INCOMPLETE SO BALLOT AND CERTIFICATE WERE SENT BACK TO VOTER TO RESOLVE THE ISSUE AND THEY NEVER RESUBMITTED IT  5. SECTIONS C AND F WERE PULLED ON DIFFERENT DAYS, AND THE VILLAGE OF HAUGEN - BARRON COUNTY WAS STILL WORKING ON THEIR DATA UPDATES DURING THE TIMEFRAME IN WHICH WE WERE PULLING DATA RESULTING IN THE DATA NOT REFLECTING ACCURATELY BETWEEN QUESTIONS C1A AND F1D.
C2Comments: VOTERS WHO ARE INDEFINITELY CONFINED DUE TO AGE, ILLNESS, INFIRMITY OR DISABILITY CAN REQUEST ABSENTEE BALLOTS BY MAIL FOR ALL FUTURE ELECTIONS

C7Comments: WI DOES NOT GATHER DATA ON IF OR HOW ABSENTEE BALLOTS MAY HAVE BEEN RECEIVED BACK BY THE CLERK WITH MISSING DATA OR IF THIS MISSING DATA WAS CURED.

WHEN TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER AND IN SECTION C WE LOOK ONLY AT ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORDS WHILE IN SECTION F WE LOOK FOR ELECTION PARTICIPATION AND AN ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD. THOSE VOTERS NOT PICKED UP IN SECTION F1D ARE HOWEVER PICKED UP IN SECTION F1H

C9Comments: C9N INCLUDES VOTERS WHOSE BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THEY ALREADY VOTED VIA ANOTHER MEANS, BUT NOT NECESSARILY IN PERSON. WI USES A REJECTION REASON OF SUPERSEDING BALLOT ACCEPTED IN SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES WHERE A VOTER HAD TO BE SENT A SECOND ABSENTEE BALLOT BECAUSE THE ORIGINAL BALLOT CONTAINED A PRINTING ERROR AND THE FIRST BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THE VOTER RETURNED THE SECOND BALLOT WHICH WAS COUNTED. THOSE VOTERS NOT PICKED UP IN SECTION F1D ARE HOWEVER PICKED UP IN SECTION F1H

C9Comments: C9N INCLUDES VOTERS WHOSE BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THEY ALREADY VOTED VIA ANOTHER MEANS, BUT NOT NECESSARILY IN PERSON. WI USES A REJECTION REASON OF SUPERSEDING BALLOT ACCEPTED IN SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES WHERE A VOTER HAD TO BE SENT A SECOND ABSENTEE BALLOT BECAUSE THE ORIGINAL BALLOT CONTAINED A PRINTING ERROR AND THE FIRST BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THE VOTER RETURNED THE SECOND BALLOT WHICH WAS COUNTED. DATA FOR NO VOTER SIGNATURE, NO WITNESS SIGNATURE, AND NO RESIDENT ADDRESS ON ENVELOPE WOULD ALL FALL INTO OUR REASON OF CERTIFICATION INSUFFICIENT.

VOTER INELIGIBLE ARE BALLOTS NOT RETURNED AND CANCELLED BECAUSE THE VOTER WAS NOT ELIGIBLE TO VOTE THE BALLOT  3. WI USES A REJECTION REASON OF SUPERSEDING BALLOT ACCEPTED IN SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES WHERE A VOTER HAD TO BE SENT A SECOND ABSENTEE BALLOT BECAUSE THE ORIGINAL BALLOT CONTAINED A PRINTING ERROR AND THE FIRST BALLOT WAS REJECTED BECAUSE THE VOTER RETURNED THE SECOND BALLOT WHICH WAS COUNTED. VOTER INELIGIBLE ARE BALLOTS NOT RETURNED AND CANCELLED BECAUSE THE VOTER WAS NOT ELIGIBLE TO VOTE THE BALLOT  3. VOTER REFUSED ARE BALLOTS FOR VOTERS ON THE PERMANENT ABSENTEE LIST WHO REFUSED A BALLOT FOR THIS ELECTION AND DID NOT REQUEST A REPLACEMENT  4. NOT RETURNED, SENT TO VOTER FOR RESOLUTION ARE BALLOTS FOR VOTERS WHO RETURNED THEIR ABSENTEE BALLOT BUT BALLOT CERTIFICATE WAS INCOMPLETE SO BALLOT AND CERTIFICATE WERE SENT BACK TO VOTER TO RESOLVE THE ISSUE AND THEY NEVER RESUBMITTED IT
C2Comments: VOTERS WHO ARE INDEFINITELY CONFINED DUE TO AGE, ILLNESS, INFIRMITY OR DISABILITY CAN REQUEST ABSENTEE BALLOTS BY MAIL FOR ALL FUTURE ELECTIONS
C3Comments: IN WISCONSIN, DROP BOX AVAILABILITY IS DETERMINED BY THE INDIVIDUAL JURISDICTIONS ON WHETHER THEY WILL PROVIDE THEM AS AN OPTION AND WHEN OR WHERE THEY CAN BE USED. COMPLETE DATA IS NOT COLLECTED ON DROP BOXES BY THE STATE AND THEREFORE UNAVAILABLE FOR REPORTING.
C7Comments: WI DOES NOT GATHER DATA ON IF OR HOW ABSENTEE BALLOTS MAY HAVE BEEN RECEIVED BACK BY THE CLERK WITH MISSING DATA OR IF THIS MISSING DATA WAS CURED.
C8Comments: DATA IN C8A WILL NOT MATCH EXACTLY WITH DATA IN F1D DUE TO HOW VOTER RECORD MERGES HAPPEN IN OUR DATABASE. WHEN TWO VOTER RECORDS FOR THE SAME VOTER ARE MERGED TOGETHER THE ELECTION PARTICIPATION RECORD MOVES WITH THE MERGE, HOWEVER THE ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD DOES NOT. THE SYSTEM DOES NOT SEE THEM AS BEING ASSOCIATED TO THE SAME VOTER AND IN SECTION C WE LOOK ONLY AT ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORDS WHILE IN SECTION F WE LOOK FOR ELECTION PARTICIPATION AND AN ABSENTEE BALLOT RECORD. THOSE VOTERS NOT PICKED UP IN SECTION F1D ARE HOWEVER PICKED UP IN SECTION F1H
